Service: 11/10. The service is wonderful! The staff are very pleasant and not afraid to give you a smile. There's also this respectful mannerism that seems to just put the cherry on top too - kind of hard to explain, haha!

Ambience: Modern and... peaceful? I feel a bit more relaxed and at ease here for some reason. Anyways, I love the ambience - it's a beautiful restaurant!

Notes: It would be nice if there was an option for either rice and/or salad on some of the dishes. I might try asking next time.

Pros: Wonderful ambience and pleasant staff, refreshing and delicious food, amazing boba milk teas!
Cons: They run out of boba kind of early, usually by 8pm. Would be great if it were more reliably available.

TLDR; new spot with a relaxing vibe, wonderful staff, great food, and a superb place to get your boba fix too!

Pro tip: the Instagram pictures are not realistic presentation of what you will get.
Keep in mind: very large portion
Instagrammable: average, only the milk teas
Atmosphere: very trendy, but the music didn't mix with the decor
Service: average, they service you the food but you have to put your food away
Tasty: bland, the best part was the veggies
Why not 5 stars? Food was meh and the pictures were not realistic representation of their food. It was a disappointing foodie experience.
Celebrated my engagement with a brunch here! Loved the Mimosas and had an amazing experience sampling the different foods! I will definitely be back when Im back in SF

Best poached eggs in all of the San Francisco Bay Area!
The Thai milk tea French toast is also super tasty.
Been here a couple times and definitely going to be coming back soon. Everything I've had here has been fire (they even gave me a free cup of soup the second time I ordered) !

I would actually give this place a 3.5. I love their interior and how clean everything is. Their food presentation is also really good.
I ordered the steak pho, lava beef rice plate and thai tea with soy milk.

The steak in the pho was cooked to just my tasting- medium rareish and soft enough to melt in my mouth. However the pho itself was way too salty, the pho wasn't hot - it was lukewarm, and the noodles were all broken. Everytime I picked up the noodles with my chopsticks they were all super short- couldnt slurp at all.
The lava steak was really good, the seasoning/sauce was a bit too salty as well but the beef, side veggies and rice was a good combo.
The thai tea was good- I loved how there were milk alternatives, I ordered it with soy milk.

This place is fairly new so I hope they read this review and make some adjustments/improvements to their food! I really think they have potential, Ive heard good things about their brunch so I will be back!

A go-to brunch staple for me! The pandan waffle with sriracha bacon is a delicious twist on my usual brunch order, with a great balance of flavors--it's also equal in quality to places in the city which would charge twice as much. Service is always incredibly friendly, helpful, and attentive. I've eaten here many times now, both with friends and with a book, and every time I enjoy myself!

I was walking around downtown SF looking for a quick brunch spot for a solo diner and stumbled upon Mr. East. I usually don't like Asian fusion, but this is definitely an exception. The space is small, bright, and airy with a few tables and chairs on the left and right sides. You order first when you walk in you get a number. I like that they also have seating up against the windows.

I ordered the Thai Tea Pancakes - amazing! The slight bitterness from the tea worked well against the sweetness from the syrup and powdered sugar. The fruit on the side nicely cut through the richness of the pancakes. My only complaint was that it was too small, I would have loved to have more.

Service was quick, especially for a Sunday morning. Overall great place to visit if you want good food while skipping the brunch rush.

8/10 would most likely go again

We got brunch here (waffles and French toast) and I had to come here to leave a review. The visual presentation of the dishes was nice; amazing pops of color on the black plates. The food was really good and we'll definitely come back next time we're in town to try more of the dishes. The cashier lady was the sweetest.
Love Mr East Kitchen! They consistently serve delicious dishes; I love the menu and am now a regular customer

Interior alone made me fall in love with this place! Not many seats but it has a clean and spacious vibe to it. Surprisingly has a wide variety to choose from. We had a decent sized group so we ordered a variety of things. Everyone enjoyed their food and didn't really have any complaints. I particularly loved the omurice! Lots of great flavor and filling!
The fantastic Vietnamese x modern American fusion brunch that you never knew you needed. Fried rice omelette is the bomb
The food is great, the service is friendly, and the atmosphere is welcoming. This is not a fancy spot but provides value with a smile. I'll be back.

Love going to this place on my lunch breaks! Their Thai tea French toast is to die for as well as the tofu summer rolls. Always have the quickest service ever! Highly would recommend their Tom Yum noodle soup - that got me through the winter season in SF.
This place is great casual spot in SOMA! love their pad thai and thai iced tea. The staff is very nice and helpful.

I really like Mr. East Kitchen. The food is always fresh and tasty, with very large portions. The prices are not cheap, per se, but they are reasonable considering the location and the amount of food you receive.

The service is quick, with boba drinks served in under 2 minutes, and food coming out in under 15. The restaurant itself is clean, well-lit, and nicely decorated.

You order at the counter, but they bring the food to you. You bus the table yourself.

I very much like this place for weekend brunch.

I ate here for the first time on 8/22/18. The first time I stopped by was the day before but it was a bit after nine and they were closing so didn't want to be one of those people and demand to be served. It was a really nice young lady at the counter. Thus, I came back the next day. I like that it's somewhat like a chipotle in bowls with bases and then choose your protein/meat. I went with salad base (no longer offered) and lemongrass chicken. It was delicious and not that bad price was for San Francisco. This place is new and close to my place so it's very convenient and want to support local businesses in my hood. I recommend this place and hope it does well. I will be there on Friday with my partner hoping he enjoys it too. The people there are really friendly which is appreciated


I ate here on 10/21/18 and they no longer have the salad option. So I could still get the dish I liked but it's perhaps four dollars more. Not happy. Still good but...maybe 3 1/2 stars and there wings are not good. They should be marinated. They just throw on a honey sriracha sauce and no wet wipes. Perhaps trying too much. I hear the breakfast ain't that great.

I ate here for the first time on 8/22/18. The first time I stopped by was the day before but it was a bit after nine and they were closing so didn't want to be one of those people and demand to be served. It was a really nice young lady at the counter. Thus, I came back the next day. I like that it's somewhat like a chipotle in bowls with bases and then choose your protein/meat. I went with salad base (no longer offered) and lemongrass chicken. It was delicious and not that bad price was for San Francisco. This place is new and close to my place so it's very convenient and want to support local businesses in my hood. I recommend this place and hope it does well. I will be there on Friday with my partner hoping he enjoys it too. The people there are really friendly which is appreciated


I ate here on 10/21/18 and they no longer have the salad option. So I could still get the dish I liked but it's perhaps four dollars more. Not happy. Still good but...maybe 3 1/2 stars and there wings are not good.

I ate here for the first time on 8/22/18. The first time I stopped by was the day before, but it was a bit after nine and they were closing so didn't want to be one of those people and demand to be served. Also, there was a really nice young lady at the counter. Thus, I came back the next day. I like that it's somewhat like a chipotle in bowls with bases and then you choose your protein/meat. They also have pho and banh mi. Apparently they will soon be serving breakfast including Vietnamese crepes. For dinner, I went with salad base and lemongrass chicken. It was delicious and not that bad price wise being that it is San Francisco. This place is new and close to my place so it's very convenient and I want to support local businesses in my hood. I recommend this place and hope it does well. I will be there on Friday with my partner hoping he enjoys it too. The people there are really friendly which is appreciated.

Best food in the area!! The staff are all very nice and professional, especially Amy, who is an angel. They treat you well while providing you the best service. I've always enjoyed the food here, especially their brunch menu. I can come in and pick any option and know they'll always come out good. Could not recommend enough.

Incredible food, and super welcoming. I ordered the Florentine Benedict with a side of fruit. It came with hash browns and salad on the side. I finished the meal with the Vietnamese Dalgona Coffee. Would recommend the coffee as it has a rich texture that will get your day going! Will definitely come back.

It's their soft opening still but honestly I couldn't even tell! Their interior is really nice (lots of seating) and their food tastes great. Unfortunately, service could still use a bit of work (a little unfriendly and delivery of food was slow).

I thought the food here was fantastic considering it's a fast casual place! I ordered the rice bowl with chicken ($15) and the portion was big enough that I could share if I wanted to, or have leftovers for tomorrow's lunch (hehe). The great thing about the rice bowl is that you're not sacrificing veggies cause I was definitely eyeing the salad. There's a bed of kale and bok choy beneath the rice.

I also received a free jasmine milk tea boba because of checking in on yelp (a promotion they're running during their soft opening) and thought both the tea and pearls were bland. But the texture of the pearls was great!

Overall, I would come back again and recommend this food much more over other fast casual Asian places, like Freshroll.
Cute place, salmon Benedict was bomb and staff was super friendly. Had the milk tea w boba and that was also so good :)
So close to my apartment which is very convenient for quickly grab lunch or dinner, but wish they could provide more items and make the milk tea better.

Decided to eat there the day before and was not disappointed. We had reservations for Friday morning but didnt need them as it wasnt busy. Food came out fast and hot. Really enjoyed the sriracha bacon, thai tea french toast and omelette fried rice. Also the fruit is nice and fresh, even saw it be delivered while we waited for our order to be taken. 10/10 would recommend !

The food was great and the workers were super nice . I ordered the Thai tea French toast it came with fruits and sriracha bacon with two eggs. Whoever would know sriracha goes well with bacon . I was super full after . They were having a deal where it was 20 percent off. :) The food came out fast .

The best and sweetest humans work here. So welcoming and kind every single time. My bf and I order dinner at least once a week and our food is always fresh and so yummy and full of flavor. I recommend this place to anyone with tastebuds.

Coming from San Diego my girlfriend and I were visiting for the first time. I will say it's tough finding great spots in San Francisco due to places being closed or operating within certain time frames but THIS PLACE IS BOMB! The food is great and so is the aesthetic of the restaurant. We gave it 4 stars out of 5 only because there were some small things like the bacon being a little undercooked (in our opinion) and the eggs were a little bland. All else including coffee and Thai milk tea was really good and I would recommend this place to anyone

Great new addition to the area!

Had their Garlic Noodles and Bowls and enjoyed both of them very much. Loved how they had a bunch of asian vegetables (bok choy etc.) under the top layer which was a nice/refreshing surprise.

Overall it was tasty but not amazing. Service/staff extremely friendly! Would definitely recommend.

This could be our new local go-to spot. The food is good (4 stars) but what makes it outstanding is.... the value and the service! No joke.

This is probably the ONLY place in SF where I looked at my takeout and was like "woah, there is so much food here. I think I underpaid." Yeah, that much.

We ordered the banh mi - it was on a ciabatta roll (which is not exactly traditional) but it was 1) very large, 2) very generous with the protein (chicken) and 3) it came with a HUGE generous portion of deliciously seasoned fries. I think it was like $10 - I mean COME ON... that's ridiculous for SF. (I literally paid $15 the other day for a measly fried chicken sandwich).

The mango chicken salad was also VERY generous with both the mango and chicken.

Oh and the thai boba tea is delicious as is the Dalgona coffee (a MUST order)

And if you order over $40, they will throw in a fried banana (OMG, delicious) with ice cream. Seriously....

And to top it off, if you order directly through them (call them, don't go through those greedy online delivery services), they will give you an additional 20% off (tells you how much those "services" are charging these local restaurants).

And the staff are S-Tier.... perfect in every aspect (courteous, competent, efficient, speedy, etc..)



One suggestion to the owner: grill the chicken a little more to get some of that yummy Maillard browning.
I love this place and the food! Some of the best banh him I've ever had. Pineapple fried rice is well cooked (not sticky). Also love their coffee!

I fell upon this eatery while visiting the city. This is a very clean and quaint place. I had the garlic noodles with chicken. Absolutely delicious. I would recommend this place. It's a little pricey but what place in the city ism't.
If you want to have delicious food on a budget look no further! This was a great brunch spot
Went here for breakfast on a recent Sunday. Wow. What a great menu and wonderful food. Extremely friendly staff. Our newest fave for brunch in the City!

Large portions here! I was looking for a light brunch and ended up getting enough food for two meals. The food came out literally in 5 minutes, so it's great if you're in a rush or super hungry.

My friend and I enjoyed our garlic noodles. Pretty flavorful and not TOO oily. They also have loads of condiments so you can customize and season to your liking.

Definitely would come back, especially to the their non-noodle options.
This is my favorite brunch spot in SF so far. No waiting. Delicious food. Healthy options. They have oat milk! The Thai iced tea French toast is decent. The egg and avocado sandwich is delicious.

Small but very cute decoration.
Highly recommend their shaking beef for food, Viet dalgona coffee and super fruit tea (with more orange juice) for drink. Have been going there almost everyday for their drinks.

No other restaurant like it in the neighborhood! I love the Asian American fusion.

I had the Tom Yum Omelete and it was good had a strong Tom Yum flavor. The portion size is really good for SF and it came with a legit salad. Other places charge a lot but they skimp. They are doing business right to earn return customers.

Support them by calling in your order and get 20% off. Use your amex gold and earn $5 back as of 8/18/2020

Delivery orders tend to be inaccurate to the quality of the food; however, my experience with Mr East Kitchen was subpar. It might've been the delivery service, but my food arrived without a notification and had been sitting outside my door likely for an hour.
Nice ambience and timely service. Enjoyed the food and having bubble tea with brunch is a great combination!
Fabulous brunch restaurant. I love their pad Thai and Thai tea French toast (which is very creative!)

Highly recommend this place! Food was delicious and drinks were very well made. They were refreshing and included a lot of fresh fruit, didn't taste artificial. All the drinks were hits but the super fruit jasmine was delightful. The chicken sandwich was surprisingly light and and the flavors worked very well together. Service was quick and employees were very sweet.

Really good, 10/10 recommend. Would definitely come back again, the fruit was fresh, everything was warm and good. Very filling, the presentation was perfect, service was perfect, I got a table without any problem, was not a really busy afternoon.

I live about half a block away, tried this place a couple times over a year ago and every time thought the food was just OK. However during Covid, I decided to try it again and this place is just soooo good and good amount of food for the price. The best way to describe some of their food is American classics with an amazing thai/Vietnamese twist. I'm sadly moving away soon, but continue to go here nearly every chance I get. Also they have sweet little perks like get 20% off if you call in or order in person and if you spend more than $40 you get a free fried banana and ice cream.

What I do recommend is the Vietnamese Dalgona Coffee, any of the boba teas, Lava Beef, Thai Tea French Toast , shrimp Benedict, tom yum omelette.

This place is clean and modern. The menu has the
Basic popular Vietnamese dishes: bang mi, pho, rice bowl, spring roll at SF prices. But it was convenient so I wanted to try. I for the pork bowl: rice is cooked with stock so it's super flavorful. Pork was marinated well and was tender. I also ordered the boba which was cooked right (cooked but with a little snap once bitten into). Overall, pretty good for being open 2 days.
Service was very friendly and good. I had the pancakes and sriracha-bacon. The fruit garnish and presentation was wonderful. Pancakes should be bigger but they were fresh.

The food and to-go service is great! My food is always ready on time and the staff always triple check the order to ensure you have the correct items. The fruit and kale salad was very fresh. Each meal had a unique flavor which I really appreciate. Definitely check this place out, it's worth the money!
Great service and amazing food! I definitely recommend the thai tea french toast and the fried chicken with pandan waffles (:

I love this place.

It's my new theory that everything in my life should be served with heaping portions of bok choy, kale and jalapeños.

I have had:
Garlic noodles with grilled chicken
Pho bowl with grilled pork
Curry bowl with salmon
Garlic fries
And Fresh Rolls

Give it a few more weeks and I'll have probably tried everything on the menu.
I've never had a poorly cooked protein and only once was I missing the cilantro I love so dearly.
The portions are huge and everything is delicious!
It's true that sometimes there could be more initial seasoning. But, I kind of appreciate the "have it your way" aspect of adding seasoning yourself.

Omg this spot is in the downtown area and near westfield. Their food was good. I like the ambiance. Their portion of food is big which you can share with two people. Came here with friends and order pad Thai, mango sticky rice, chicken, and some omlette. First time trying authentic Thai food. Would recommend and come back.

This is such an underrated brunch spot in SF! People usually think of Kitchen Story/Surisan/Sweet Maple when thinking of asian fusion brunch spots in SF but this place is definitely more lowkey, with great food and amazing prices. This is located near the union square area and the moscone center area which means that it's centrally located and easy to get to. We got there around 9 on a Saturday morning and the place was pretty empty still. You order at the counter and then it's self-seating. When we went, there was a deal of buying 3 entrees, get 1 free which is an amazing deal considering every entree is about $15. Everything we ordered was delicious! The crispy chicken fried rice which is recommended as their top item was such a big portion with a generous amount of rice and chicken. The flavors were spot on. We also got the hangar steak which came with texas toast, 2 eggs, and a salad and this was such a good deal for $17. The steak was delicious and the dressing on the salad was super unique. As our sweet options, we got the thai tea french toast and pandan chicken and waffles. Both were really good and unique! I recommend getting a mix of the sweet and savory dishes, although their menu is extremely extensive and has options for everyone! Would definitely recommend this place to avoid the waits and the prices of other asian fusion brunch spots in SF.
We had Sunday brunch here. The food was excellent with several unique items. The service was great, friendly and prompt.

This restaurant deserved five stars from my overall experience. First is the ambiance. This restaurant is nice and clean with the high ceilings, some indoor plants, and cute decors, makes me feel like having lunch in the backyard. Second is the menu. They offered variety of food, from Asian to American and from mild to spicy. So this is a family friendly restaurant. Last but not least is the tasty food they serve. I ordered pandan waffle & chicken for my son. This dish is like East meets West. You get the taste of aromatic Vietnamese waffle combined with traditional fried chicken. It's a must try. I also ordered chicken pho for myself. Nothing to complain, the broth has flavor itself that I don't have to add anything into it.

What a great brunch spot! This location has such a vibe to it, although small, it has open windows for bright lit dining that brightens up the whole experience.

My bf and I decided to get the drunken noodles and salmon Benedict with a Tom yum soup as an appetizer. Every dish was seasoned so well and is authentic Thai which made it so much more delicious. They even have the Thai pink drink which has the hale blue boy pink syrup :) so delicious and milky!

10/10 recommend yall to come through!
Great place with amazing food. Had the steak Benedict and it was off-the-charts good. Large portions also.

I've been going to Mr. East for a few years now and they have never disappointed!! Both the quality of their food and service are wonderful (especially Amy and M!). Some of my favorite things to order are the garlic noodles, morning green salad, eggs benedict, passion fruit green tea and thai tea.
They recently added new items to their menu, so I decided to try out the fried chicken and pandan waffles ($10). It came with two sauces: one mustardy sauce and a garlic(?) maple syrup. The mustardy sauce helped cut the greasiness of the fried chicken, but I especially liked the syrup because it was sweet with a savory element to it. The chicken was perfectly juicy and coated in a thin batter that was super crispy with a satisfying crunch. It paired wonderfully with the vibrant green pandan waffles. The waffles were delicious, with a hint of pandan flavor and a mochi-like texture that I really enjoyed. I would definitely recommend ordering this dish!

Portions. XXL. So the cost kind of makes sense, aside from being in SF and all.

Interior is clean, slick. No complaints there. Service is quick (you order and sit, or order ahead for pickup).

The dishes are quite tasty. Really enjoyed the Garlic noodles with grilled pork. Though I tried reheating some leftovers and they didn't seem as good, so perhaps sharing and forego-ing bringing leftovers home may be a better path next time.

All in all, perfectly designed for a quick lunch bite if you're craving simple Vietnamese cuisine.

This place is a pleasant surprise. I ordered the Omurice. The fried rice was on point! It reminded me of the fried rice I ate in Taiwan. Flavorful with a kick from the spring onions. If there was anything to improve, I would like it slightly dryer, but this is more like a personal preference. The eggs on top were a bit overcooked, I would like it to be a bit runny. I enjoyed the bacon cooked with siracha. Overall a great experience!
Food was great! Try the veggie egg rolls and the Vietnamese dalonge coffee. I love the fusion brunch options like pandan chicken and waffles, they're so unique! Give them a try

Such a gem, service and food were amazing. We went on a Saturday evening and it wasn't super crowded. Our server was so sweet and the food came super fast.

We got the steak rice plate, the garlic noodles (best dish in order) and the passion fruit jasmine tea all of which were amazing. We also got the fried banana and ice cream for desert- which as a note is mashed up banana fried in a thick batter.

Definitely would eat here again, and recommend for a peaceful dinner in SF.

The food is amazing!
Price is cheap~
Service is great!
And the dine-in area is clean and safe for covid.

Had this Pandan Waffle with fried chicken.
Love it! Specially like the friendly staff here.
Come and support our local spot.

Brunch here is great and I appreciate the counter ordering (I prefer it to sit down ordering). It is fast and efficient. Food here is done very well. Only thing I would change is better explanation on the menu of what the items are. "Mr east" Benedict doesn't tell me what is in it (I think it was ham?). Seating is also not difficult around 12 on a Sunday which is another bonus.

This is a really great asian place - I love that they combine so many different asian cuisines together so you can get a bit of each culture in the same sitting. Their specialty is their thai tea french toast. The toast is eggy and the sauce is the perfect consistency of slightly thick. I would also recommend their superfruit tea: it was super refreshing and filled with fruit pieces!

I've been eating at Mr East for 2 years now and I go there not only out of convenience (close to work) but I really like the food! And recently the customer service has been especially top notch.
My go-to orders are the pork garlic noodle, banh mi + garlic fries, and milk tea! Plenty of garlic and pork gives the food amazing flavor, while the cool crunch of pickled veggies balances it out perfectly.
If it's your first time and you're not sure what to order I definitely recommend trying the garlic noodle!

These days I always order out (they're on a lot of delivery apps which is how I first found them) but pre-COVID the interior design is very modern and clean, and was nice to dine in.

Amy and M work really hard to learn the customers' names and usual orders, and they're so welcoming. And Mr. East has been coming up with new menu items! I've tried the taro milk tea, pandam chicken and waffles, and fried banana dessert. I love sweets so it's great that their menu has a solid selection of not only savory but sweet!

Fresh tofu roll. $5. I'm so dissatisfied and disappointed with what I got. The tofu is not crispy as it says on menu. It was uncooked. Plain tofu with no flavor sucks. Where is pineapple in my sauce?? It tasted like a Trader Joe's soy dipping sauce. At least could have filled it to the top. Oh yeah thanks for free 3 jalapeño slices! That was a nice touch. Meh
Delicious! Nothing fancy, but did the job. Food was freshly prepared, friendly service, incredible food. Well done!

We ordered around November 2020 & to say the food was delicious & fantastic is an understatement! It was incredible considering the takeout containers were cleaned/licked/emptied! We ordered the garlic noodle bowl and the shaking beef special plate. I wish I took pictures but I was very hungry. We are ordering again soon but the plates we chose are different this time around. Will update you once we get the food. Please try this restaurant out!

I visited Mr. East Kitchen for a weekday lunch and it was a great experience! The environment was super cute and the staff were all super nice and friendly.

My boyfriend ordered Banh Mi sandwich with pork and a cup of Thai lime tea. I ordered rice bowl with brown rice and steaks. For the drink, I got earl grey milk tea with soy milk and boba. I am so happy that they can make milk tea with non-dairy milk and can also make it non-sweet. I like the boba, super chewy :)

The pork in Banh Mi was flavorful and juicy. The side kale salad was fresh but the dressing was too sweet. Next time when I come back, I will definitely ask for no dressing for the salad. For my steak rice bowl, the steak is a bit plain without the complementary sauce but the overall texture of the steak was good -- tender, juicy and soft. There was decent amount of veggies in the rice bowl -- a blend of sautéed bok choy and kale.

Overall, it was a great experience. We will definitely revisit this place :D

Great food at affordable prices!! This restaurant has been a staple for me since I always need something quick to go and their Banh Mi is the best. Their Banh Mi is affordable and comes with garlic fries, whereas if you go anywhere else it's most likely $12-15 for just the sandwich. Highly recommend this place.
This is place is the bomb when it comes to breakfast. I would definitely recommend 10/10! I had the eggs Benedict' and it was delicious even as takeout.
Pho had no flavor so I added some sauce but I could only taste the sauce. The picture is the leftover I normally don't like to waste my food but I couldn't keep eating...

The food and service was terrific! We ordered the Shaken beef, garlic noodles with shrimp, pineapple fried rice with chicken, garlic French fries, and the Dragona coffee. Nothing was disappointing. The service was so accommodating, especially since we had our two young boys who are so hard to go out to eat with. Awesome!

Amazing food! I don't know what cuisine is this, but they do Thai, Vietnamese, and American food. Good portions and prices are very reasonable! Definitely a lesser-known gem that not many people know about.

They have oat milk tea!!!

I stopped by here on a weekday and had a good dinner with a friend here.

Simple, decently portioned, decently priced (for SF), what more can you ask for? Thanks for opening another option that's in a neighborhood that's normally not as popular!

Nicely decorated brunch spot, it has a modern look that is super instagram worthy! Menu was not too varied, serving American breakfast with an Asian twist. Before coming in, I would expect some wild interesting Asian-American fusion combos, but they just have 3 or 4 dishes that actually carried that idea. The rest of the menu was either traditional Asian style food or traditional American breakfasts. But anyway, the presentation was good, food was tasty, and the staff was friendly. Therefore, this could be a good spot for office lunches or dates :)
Exceptionally good food and customer service packed into such a small package. Easy parking around the corner.

I highly recommend this restaurant for breakfast. It is clean, bright and has outstanding service. And it is very reasonably priced for San Francisco. I ordered eggs Benedict. The eggs were poached to perfection. The excellent sauce had a hint of curry - I've been craving more of it ever since I was there. The plate came with a salad of crisp fresh greens dressed with a delicious smoked sesame dressing. The menu has lots of other tasty sounding dishes - I wish I lived closer so I could keep going back and trying them all.

Had the Pho with Steak here, quite disappointing.

The pho isn't the "normal" kind -- the noodles are flat and very soft. It comes with bak choy and not bean sprouts. And the meat is steak and not raw beef/tripe/beef balls/etc.

I wouldn't really mind any of those differences if it tasted good. But unfortunately the whole experience was underwhelming. I don't think the hard chewier texture of the steak goes well with the very soft noodles. The inclusion of bak choy was meh. The most disappointing of all was the broth-- it was pretty bland.

On the bright side, the staff was very friendly, and my friends who had the garlic noodles said it was pretty good, so perhaps I just got the wrong thing. But in any case I do not recommend the pho.

I love the bright, modern vibe here. I ordered pork garlic noodles, chicken banh mi, and Thai milk tea with boba. I was planning to have the noodles for dinner and save the banh mi for next day's breakfast, but when the noodles came out, the portion was big enough that I probably could've saved the leftovers for the next day instead lol. The food came out quickly and nicely plated, but the meat was a bit too chewy. Slightly on the expensive side, but for the portion and the service, I'd come here again for a quick office lunch or so.

Wait/Ambiance:
Really nice, modern SF tech startup ambiance with lots of succulents, neon lights, and grey muted colors. It really reminded me of a trendy start-up's office. This place is "fast casual" but actually kind of expensive for being fast casual (~$14).

Food:
I only tried the pork ginger rice bowl, which was a bit underwhelming. It was a bit tasteless overall, and so I tried pouring the fish sauce over everything, which helped a bit. I think it's supposed to be Vietnamese American fusion, which explains the kale in my bowl, but I'm not sure the flavors overall were complementing each other. I wish the fish sauce were a bit stronger, and the pork were a bit more garlicky/spice-ful.

Overall:
- I wouldn't make a special trip to come here again, but it's ok if you're in the area and are craving fast Asian food in a nice, modern environment. I haven't tried their milk teas, but other reviews say they're good -- I may be back for the milk tea, but I don't think I'll return for the entrees.

2.5, ok/decent with much room for improvement.

Pros: sparsely decorated but clean space, overall tasteful on a macro scale. Imperial rolls are a little salty but otherwise have good flavor. Shrimp Benedict comes with a red Thai curry based sauce (although unclear if there's actually egg yolk involved to make it an actual hollandaise) which is a refreshing take on a classic. Sriracha bacon isn't millionaire's bacon but still quite tasty. Berry salad is actually deliciously fresh. Portions are fairly generous.

Cons: they used artwork printed from a color printer taped inside empty picture frames (with bright green tape) for wall decor and sprigs of rosemary sitting inside plastic cups for table decor, talk about industrial cheap. Their garlic noodles are literally the blandest rendition I've ever tasted. One of the shrimp in our Benedict was still grey aka undercooked (they took it back and made a new one) and egg yolks were overcooked (not runny). Vietnamese pickle isn't nearly pickly enough.

Overall a lot of promise if they paid a bit more attention to details here and there.

I ended up in their neighborhood randomly and was a little hungry. So I thought I'd try them out. I was going to order chicken satay but the guy ringing me up said to order the spring rolls. He said they're really filling. They were! I'm glad I listened.

I got the shrimp spring rolls. They were fresh and really good tasting. And very healthy.

The decor of the restaurant is simple and clean. They take good care of their things and customers!
The best breakfast you'll get in San Fran hands down! There is something on the menu for everyone and it's made to perfection!
Yummy food. It's kinda hidden spot. I had the steak salad delicious my friend had basic breakfast. No complaints

Delicious Breakfast/Brunch place. My girlfriend and I shared the Classic Two Egg Breakfast with both Siracha Bacon and Chicken Apple Sausage. Entire dish was super tasty, especially the Siracha bacon and Thai tea French toast. Highly recommend.

The restaurant is very cute and clean, and the staff is very nice. We will definitely be coming again.

The sloooooooooooowest service imaginable. I waited for more than 30 minutes for an egg and cheese sandwich on my way to work.

Probably a dozen people came and ordered, then left with food while I waited. Eventually, someone came out and said there had been an issue with the sandwich? and that they were remaking it, but how long does it take to make an egg and cheese sandwich? Clearly not long, based on the number of people who ordered and left with one while I waited. Eventually I got my mediocre breakfast, with a bonus side of late-to-work.

This was easy walking distance from a friend's place. They were helpful in sharing dishes that are gluten and dairy free. I had the curry bowl with chicken. All very good and beautifully plated. My concern is that there was some sugar added to the curry. It would be tasteful enough without the sweetener. My friend ordered the pho--huge, flavorful, chicken seems fresh and good.
Everything on the menu is so good and the price is good as well! Service was awesome as well. Place is a bit small but the food is great! You try the pandan waffle and Thai tea french toast.

The portions are sooooooooooo huge! There were 6 of us and the one male finished his food.

Both the grilled chicken and pork were tasty. The decor and bathrooms were tidy and clean.

Improvements: Their garlic noodle was a little bit plain. It didn't leave my lips with that buttery sheen. But it tasted and felt healthier. Depends on what you're looking for I guess. :P
Really good service and food thank you Crispy Chicken Sandwich is really delicious . Employee is so kind.

a casual lunch spot. there is no outdoor seating but the indoor interior is adorable! we went around 1230pm on a sunday. ordered the food and it came out in less than 10 minutes! the food was good, not great. overall, decent place to try!

We stayed in a hotel nearby and saw this restaurant on the way back to hotel. Their brunch is DELICIOUS!!!!

We had salmon Benedict and also French toast with bacon and eggs. Strongly recommended !!

Very nice people and service as well
Will come back for sure

An asian fusion brunch spot?! Yes please! The service was great. The vibes inside were quiet and lovely. And the food/drinks were really really good.
- Thai iced tea latte: my favorite, very soothing combination of flavors, not too sweet but you can really taste the thai iced tea
- Rose milk tea: also really good, my husband liked this drink more
- Summer roll with tofu: I got this to be healthy and I had no expectations really, but it was so fresh and the tofu somehow actually tasted great! The combination of textures with the mint and vermicelli was perfect.
- The garlic noodles with chicken: Very tasty, big portions!
- Thai iced tea french toast: I didn't quite taste the thai tea flavor in this one but it was yummy nonetheless.

So good!! Will definitely be coming back.

I was first attracted to this place because it's an Asian fusion brunch spot. And I was not disappointed! Starting off with the interior, it has a lot of touches of light blue (lots of coolness), greenery, and is very modern! You order at the counter and find your seat, which I found a little untraditional for a brunch spot but actually really convenient! I ordered the garlic noodles with beef, the Thai tea French toast, and the eggs Benedict with kale salad + hash browns. It's safe to say I genuinely loved everything. I couldn't decide between the brunch items and the Vietnamese dish friends so I had to try both! And can I just say it's the perfect amount of "fusion". The Asian flavors meshed well with the brunch items like the Thai tea French toast and eggs Benedict which has siracha bacon. Overall, AWESOME SPOT! I'm already craving it again.

I don't know why I never actually tried Mr. East Kitchen before shelter in place given that I live so close! However, since March, I've ordered both lunch and dinner a few times and drinks several times for pick up. They're always very quick with preparing my order and I've never had any issues with anything that I've picked up from them. I definitely recommend trying their menu items

This place popped up and Yelp so I named it for our dinner meet-up. We found out once we were there that their grand opening was in the future on Oct 1, and currently it's their soft opening.

It's a small-ish space with a bright, modern vibe. Order at the counter and take the number to your table - grab utensils yourself at the counter. Yet, the plate - I order basil chicken - came out looking like that of a fancier restaurant.

The basil chicken was intensely flavored and surprisingly spicy considering the menu did not mention it was spicy. If you are hesitant about spicy food, try a different dish instead.

Overall, Mr. East Kitchen is a welcome new addition to SoMA and I expect them to be much more crowded after their grand opening.

I was pleasantly greeted when I came in. The servers and especially the owner was very nice to me. Food arrived so quick I barely had time to sit down and use the bathroom before. It was very clean inside not one spot was dirty. Food was so fresh tastes like it just came out of the farm.

I think I came on an off day. To be fair, a banh mi at 9:45am may not be their typical morning order. The pork was gristly, fatty, and old - seemed pretty clear it was reheated from the day before (I think there was randomly some steak in there?). Having ciabatta as your bread is unique, but the pickled veggies being cut into such large chunks meant they fell out of the sandwich with every bite so you had to constantly reassemble the sandwich. Not a lot of fillings either (maybe why I got steak too). The team behind the kitchen was wearing masks but the person working in the dining room wasn't, which made me a little uncomfortable. I took it to go, but the sandwich was so bad I tossed it.
It is a very good food to eat. Everything is Fresh and delicious. But! Going to the Asian restaurant they make me PAY first; which is not done with White customers.

I'm glad to see this place is still here! Their morning salad is so good. Yes, a breakfast salad (or lunchtime works too!) If that doesn't appeal, they have an extensive and interesting menu. But it is hard to resist that salad!

Edited to add: today I also tried their tofu bahn mi via MealPal and it was also very good - nice roll, flavorful fillings and lots of crispy French fries! I liked the dipping sauce too.
Delicious food, great service, and multiple food options. Definitely recommend for a casual brunch.

I came here for breakfast while I was visiting sf. You order at the front and they bring the food to where you are sitting. They brought me water without me asking and silverware to eat my food. I ordered eggs Benedict with shrimp. The eggs were cooked perfectly and it was just a really solid breakfast. It came with a side salad with a sweet soy dressing which was really good too. Service was great everyone working was really nice.

YESSSS YESSS, the service and food here is great ! I had ordered the garlic chicken noodles to go and they came out within a few minutes , and they tasted fantastic ! Will continue to come here, I also love the inside it feels very modern and clean .

10/10 nice small Viet fusion establishment. Owner is very sweet, hard working lady up front, the staff is friendly and you can see they try their best to get everything out in a timely manner. Visiting from out of state I recommend coming here for brunch.

I was completely blown away by this place. Service, food, everything. I had the steak and eggs, my husband had the shrimp Benedict. They were both fantastic and delicious. The sides of toast, hash browns, and fruit were welcome additions. Also the mimosas were not chincy at all, one was enough. Great place!

Ok the staff here was so kind. I got the garlic noodles with chicken and the chicken was a little bland for my taste. I would love to support this business more, but maybe next time I'll try out their Tom yum soup - my friends got that and it looked delicious good casual lunch spot with friendly vibes
Our favorite go to for their drunken noodle, Tom yum soup and most especially the mango sticky rice!

Flew into Oakland International Airport this morning from Palm Springs. Was looking on Yelp for a good breakfast place & found, Mr. East. Ordered the Shrimp Pad Thai only to have it come out with a huge, long hair in the dish. I lost my appetite & had them refund my order. Just shared Bun Mi with husband. It was just alright.

I live a few blocks from Mr East and just tried them for the first time today. The Steak Benedict was incredible and I wasn't sure what I would think of the curry hollandaise sauce but WOW!! I didn't think it was possible to make hollandaise sauce better but they found a way. I'll definitely order that again and now I'm curious to try out more of their menu as well. I had them add avocado to it since I put avocado on everything and they gave me a very generous portion. Big thumbs up, Mr East!

Amazing service and high quality food. I've had the banh mi sandwich for lunch a few days in a row, and the server/manager always remembers my name and order! Really nice staff, wonderful quality of food, and great variety. Perfect for lunch or brunch!

Had the tofu pho, the tofu is tasty and the soup is on the light side, which is good! It comes with good amount of vegetables.
I also had a coffee latte which is also very decent. A great place in Soma!

Ordered the Tom Yum noodle soup with shrimp and the tofu spring rolls. The rolls were yummy and fresh. The broth for the soup was also yummy although it lacked depth and spice. The bowl for the broth was basically just rice noodles with only half a bok choy and a few bites of greens and sprouts. The shrimp were delicious and there were plenty of them. However, who wants a huge bowl of mushy rice noodles? I would have preferred more variety of vegetables or just more vegetables. I wish I had not poured the broth in with the noodles since it was wasted since I didn't eat all the noodles and it was $15.00.

I've visited on a number of occasions, so this review will be an accumulation of everything I've tried here so far.

Visit 1 (Lunch): Garlic Noodles with Chicken - Not bad, but Chubby Noodle still wins in this category for me (was hoping for the Chicken to be less fatty and more grilled, as the pictures suggested).

I also took the opportunity to get an Earl Grey Milk Tea which I think may be one of the best Boba's I've ever had.

Visit 2 (Lunch): Salad with Tofu - Pretty good. Fresh ingredients and flavorful. I'm not usually huge on Tofu, but the grilled Tofu here was pretty good.

Visit 3 (Sunday Brunch): Got an Avocado Toast, which upon receiving, (presentation-wise) looked fairly basic, but it ended up tasting great - super fresh Avocado, perfectly poached egg, tasty Kale salad, etc.

Oh and the space is beautiful. There's that, too.

So overall - it's important to say this is a new and growing restaurant. Right off the bat, you can see it's modern, very nice inside, and a kind of cool vibe. The food is interesting - appears to be of good quality, and it seems they care about their food. This is a huge plus. The service as well was very good - this is a good thing.

As for what I ordered... it was OK. I think too many liberties were taken with the banh mi sandwich. However, plenty of protein (I chose grilled pork) but the sandwich was on a weird ciabatta roll - which I thought might be ok but I'd so much prefer a baguette. The traditional build of a banh mi was not there, but overall it had good texture and flavor. I'd rebrand this to be a "banh mi inspired" sandwich. It came with a kale salad which I didn't expect and didn't particularly love.

I also ordered boba tea - and one thing that is refreshing there is the menu is easy to understand. I've walked into bubble tea houses and been unable to order by the sheer fact there was 100's of combinations - they kept theirs simple and the quality was great.

Overall - I know they are still developing their menu - I'd suggest to the restaurant is keep the great attributes going - but maybe lean a little harder towards the "Vietnamese influence" of the menu.

Thanks for the meal - and those that read, this place is certainly worth a try.
Love it so much! Wooot ahhhhhh woot woot thjis is good and fast and eazzzzyyyyyyyyyyy

This place is cool and quite trendy, it looks cool clean and fresh. Nice vibe going on I had the five snapper which was ok the rice and sauce were excellent the fish itself was a little bland.

Service was great and after I'd ordered looks like the steak pho would have been a better choice. I will definitely be back to try that.

My vietnamese friend introduced me to this place and at first we were just buying the vietnamese dalgona coffee and it tasted so great and we became regulars and over time we tried the food as well and the hainan chicken was probably the best dish in SF and we ordered so many times when we go in they already know we were going for hainan chicken. Amy and Patrick was also probably the nicest staff and both the vietnamese coffee and hainan chicken tasted better when they're there but they were moved to a different location, would've been a 5 star if they were still there but i would still highly recommend this place!
Always amazing! I love all dishes there, especially garlic noodle with spiced chicken and salad
So friendly and great food. Super consistent and have a pretty big menu. One of my favorite restaurants in the area!
Superb. Awesome. Delicious and portion was full. I will be a regular here LOL egg noodle tastes like an pasta and grilled chicken was a little bit dry still good with sauce.
I ordered the deep fried banana, and there was no banana. Just a hole like it left in my heart.
We just moved to San Francisco and come here all the time for pick-up. It's great value. Delicious food and fantastic service. My boyfriend's fave is the shaken beef. Delish.
2 egg breakfast is delicious! Perfectly cooked eggs and seasoned to perfection. First time trying their sriracha bacon and I will be back for more.
Good food! The fried chicken & pandan waffle was excellent! Will definitely come back.

I picked up a garlic noodle bowl to go with tofu. The tofu was so good, no idea how they get it to taste like that. The noodles were super flavorful and the veg was well-cooked. My only qualm is that it was super expensive, but I guess that's just how it is. Will have to return to try breakfast.

We ordered garlic noodles with chicken, tom yum soup, spicy salmon and drunken noodle beef. The clear winner was drunken noodle beef. It is spicy version of pad thai. All dishes had sufficient amount of fresh vegetable. My 8yr daughter loved tomato flavor in tom yum soup.
I like this place so much! The decor is super cute and the food is also good. My garlic noodle bowl portion was generous. I'll definitely come back again when I'm in the area.

My friend and I are always looking for the best places for Vietnamese coffee, and we were MORE than happy with the Vietnamese Dalgona coffee with oat milk. Very friendly service and good prices. We will definitely come back!

I love this place. They have recently expanded their menu and everything is really good. You really can't go wrong. It's my go-to breakfast and lunch place with a ton of options. They are also doing 20% off all phone, in-person, or on their website. Finally a reasonably priced food place in SF.

Friendly service and tasty fusion dishes. When you walk by this establishment, you see some boarded up windows and one door is also boarded up but they are OPEN. They have a brunch menu in addition to lots of entrees to choose from, it was hard for us to decide. We had the fried chicken with pandan waffles and eggplant tofu. Wish we could have tried other dishes but we could only eat so much. The lychee jasmine iced tea was also very refreshing.
The food is very delicious! My favorite is either the chicken sandwich or the noodles. I come to eat here almost every day.

Wow what a nice find during these hard times for restaurants and their fans. Immaculately clean, friendly, welcoming, delicious. These folks have their priorities right. I did not feel at Covid-risk for indulging in a nice meal. Garlic noodles with chicken - yes! Super-fresh fresh rolls. Rich Vietnamese coffee. We'll be back.

MAJOR PSA;

You can order their pho on Caviar beginning at 9am if you purchase the basil chicken and leave in the comments section you'd like pho instead. I highly recommend this.

I can not say enough good things about their pho. Refreshing and consistent.

Keep it up Mr. East Kitchen! The best pho in SF.
I LOVE THIS PLACE!!! :) Everything on their menu is soon delicious and I am in love with their matcha boba oat milk tea. Absolutely satisfying. And they serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

5 stars for the food, 6 stars for the service. I have an unhealthy obsession with Mr. East. I go here on most Friday's and their eggplant tofu with earl grey milk tea or jasmine superfruit tea is on my must eat weekly rotation. The workers there are incredibly kind and helpful (I especially love Emmy who is one of the owners). She is the sweetest woman, remembers my name, and always makes sure I leave happy. The discounts are pretty steep so eating here almost feels like a crime. It's very clean inside the restaurant and service is fast, even during lunch rush hour.
Food was very delicious and staff is really friendly. Great place for breakfast or lunch.

Mr East Kitchen is a nice asian fusion spot in SoMa. They serve a pretty large selection of food, but majority of it is using the same ingredients. I do think the prices are reasonable and the portion sizes are generous. My only complaint is their hours are very weird. 9am-3pm. I usually don't consume heavy Asian dishes at such early times of the day but regardless i'm please with this establishment

We stumbled into this place in a whim and we are so glad we did! What a creative menu! The tum yum omelette was AMAZING! Just the right about of spice and tum yum flavor and the shrimp & eggs combo was great! It was our first dine-in experience since SiP and it could not have been better. Well distanced tables and protocols. Will definitely be back!

I once took my foodie teenage nephew out for Pho. He said "3 stars is trash." When we we're done and leaving he said: "3 stars, neither good nor bad."

SOMA Rice Plate:

Music: light jazz.
Clients: mostly white.
Staff: mostly viet.
Rice: oddly not starchy.
Bowl: Japanese-esque.
Shrimp: tepid, w/o tail $1 extra.
Beverage: self serve water.
Sauce: sugar spice - quantity: meh
Chopsticks: fancy disposable compostable.
Veggies: bok choy and kale - limp/steamed.
Service: counter.
Price: $16

Tenderloin Rice Plate:

Music: your iPhone.
Clients: mostly Asian.
Staff: all viet.
Rice: starchy.
Bowl: bowl? WTF. Commercial plate.
Shrimp: hot, with tail.
Beverage: hot tea.
Sauce: sugar spice - quantity: enough.
Chopsticks: plastic washable.
Veggies: bok choy hot wok fried.
Service: table.
Price: $12.

I'm glad the place was here and I'd rather eat with my peeps ...

Mr East Kitchen - a true gem in SoMa

I lived in SoMa for almost two years and once I eventually discovered this place, I didn't stop coming for the rest of my time there. I can't think of another spot I'd rather grab lunch at in the area than here.

Whereas most eating establishments fail in at least one category, Mr East Kitchen is stellar in taste, affordability, and healthiness. Could not recommend them highly enough, most especially their Basil Chicken

This is a great addition to the neighborhood. I've tried their rice bowls with chicken and pork and they are both good. The best thing about their rice bowls is the nice portion of dark green vegetables. In fact, I wish they would give you even more vegetables! I often feel gross after eating meat-heavy takeouts but I don't at this place. Also, their seasoning is not excessive so I'm able to eat here more frequently. I've already eaten here a dozen times since they opened!

I have tried their breakfast as well but unfortunately it's not as good as their lunch/dinner. The hash browns were very greasy and the sriracha bacon was overly fatty, almost inedible.

One last thing is sometimes I do get a bit thirsty after eating their bowls and I wonder which seasoning causes that. It's not the best feeling but I hope it's just the fish sauce which I could eliminate next time. I feel pretty satisfied with their bowls otherwise, and look forward to trying their other options.

We had the following on two visits:

Curry shrimp egg Benedict - 4.5/5,
Thai tea French toast - 4/5,
Egg, Avocado and Chicken sandwich - 3.5/5 ( nothing special),
Caramel iced coffee - 1/5 ( couldn't drink as it was so bland, was just milk and minimal coffee/caramel),
Cappuccino - 4/5.

Seating is good. Place is neat and clean. The knives and forks were little dirty and I told them about it. They took care of it. A 20% off coupon if you check in via Yelp is nice.

Nice modern vibe and I like that the menu called out Gluten Free, Soy Free, Vegetarian, etc. I got the campfire dish since it said that it was gluten free. I was excited because it was a noodle dish and being GF, you don't always get those! I have a gluten allergy though and I'm thinking the garlic noodles in my dish may not have been gluten free :( I asked a server if she knew what kind of noodles they were and she said they were garlic noodles like the menu said. I asked if she knew if they were gluten free and she looked at the menu and said yes. (Seemed silly, since I chose from the menu!)

Flavors were good but my stomach seems to be disagreeing with those noodles. I did see that there is a garlic noodle bowl that was not specified as gluten free so I assumed my noodles would be different since GF was specified for the Campfire dish. Maybe somebody can clear that up for me? I asked again when we left what brand the noodles were and I was told that they make them in house.

Hidden gem. Off the beaten path location. We walked there from the Metreon about three blocks. Food was delicious, and service was great. We had the crispy chicken fried rice, chicken was flavorful with the right amount of crisp. Also had the Drunken Noodle Beef which was killer, our favorite dish, tons of flavor and a little spice. My daughter had the waffles which were very flavorful and just a little different. Service was fantastic. We'd definitely come back when in the area.

Today I was in the neighborhood on 5th street and found this restaurant open. Went in, very clean, friendly staff and I have to say that the food is very fresh and tasty, just delicious. Check them out.

Ordered delivery to our hotel one morning so my disclaimer is that this food might not necessarily travel well and is likely much better eaten in the restaurant. I tried their green tea French toast with eggs and chicken sausage. It was good, the French toast definitely hit the mark. The syrup is where the green tea is and it was a delightfully novel taste for me. We also ordered the breakfast sandwich with sausage and the cheese was a little craft cheesy for me. It was sticky instead of creamy, but it might've been the temperature. I also tried the passion fruit green tea with boba and it was exactly as described. I liked it. Hopefully, I'll get the chance to drop in one day and try it in house so I can get the full effect but I overall it was a nice twist on some classics.

We came here on a Sunday breakfast right after they opened. We got the Vanilla Latte and the Americano, but they forgot to bring out the Americano. We had to flag down our server, but it was all good in the end. The latte actually had tasted like there was coffee in it, so it was a really nice mix of sweetness and coffee. For our brunch, we got the Thai Tea French Toast, the Chicken Pho, and the Garlic Fries. The Chicken Pho was not that good, and I would not recommend the dish to anyone. The broth was really weak, and it tasted watery. The chicken was rather tender, and my friend only liked it once she added in the Hoisin and Sriracha. Meanwhile, the Garlic Fries were absolutely amazing. They were very crispy and the Sriracha Mayonnaise paired so well with them. I really enjoyed the French Toast, but the only thing I didn't like was that the thai tea sauce wasn't very strong. It didn't really taste like thai tea, and it was only sweet overall. It was still a pretty good experience with very attentive staff, so I'll definitely come back soon.

I rarely write yelp reviews but I had to because I highly recommend people to check out Mr East Kitchen! Amy and M are super sweet and make the best drinks and food! So far I've had the Dalgona Matcha, Jasmine Milk Tea, and garlic fries, and they all tasted amazing! I also think the prices are pretty cheap, and the food is very high quality. Best of all, the food looks aesthetic for the gram! Come support this local SF business
Garlic noodles dish has lots of veggie and goes well with any protein. Drinks are refreshing. Restaurant is clean. Great find!
Great food and immaculately clean restaurant. Hash browns and bacon were delish! Very attentive staff.

We went for brunch on a Sunday morning and it was such a great experience! We called ahead to ask if there was seating and they reserved us a table for four. The staff was very friendly and parking on a Sunday at 11am was not difficult. Sadly we didn't get any pictures of the food-- but the seating area was right outside the shop and very comfortable. I ordered the vegan sandwich and even though I don't like kale, the kale salad it came with was pretty tasty. The actual sandwich was steamed spinach and tofu between two hash browns, but really the salad was the best part! Would recommend for people on a budget but wanting to go out for brunch.

This place doesn't seem authentic and first and it kinda isn't but it is really good. All food portions are huge. The meat in the pho is really high quality. I got the beef pho and the steak is actually cooked, was disappointed at first it wasn't rare but it was a lot more flavorful than typical pho beef

Chic looking interior that helps to clean up the otherwise poop-smeared and needle-laiden streets. Good food, but way not worth the price, especially for a place that doesn't offer sit-down service. I paid almost $20 for a takeout lunch order of garlic noodles with some meat on top.

IMO, Tin down the street is a much better deal and actually slightly better.

I want to update my review. After my last review, the owner immediately updated the hours and invited me back. I finally got around visiting the restaurant for dinner. Everything was delicious! We had fried spring rolls, garlic fries, tom yum noodle soup, and banh mi sandwich. Nice flavors and good portion size. Will come back for their brunch menu!
Came here on Sunday at 6:50pm and it's closed. On the website and in Yelp it's supposed to be open. Very disappointed. Update your hours on Yelp please.
The hai nan chicken is amazing and the service is incredible. 10/10 would recommend. Poggers
Quick and easy ordering on a Friday night! Called in and they helped me within 20 minutes!
Here in Soma, where there aren't as many houses or apartments, it's hard to find a good brunch spot. This one is good.

This was our first breakfast while visiting San Fran. We where the first customers of the day. The food was just average and the price was very high. Not a bad option if you are in the immediate area, but would recommend elsewhere.

Ordered: garlic noodles, curry plate, chicken satay

Garlic Noodles: chicken cooked perfectly and well seasoned. Noodles firm and parmesan cheese worked well. Thought could have a little more garlic flavor and maybe some extra seasonings. Dish served with a vinegar sauce but I felt the dish could use a sauce.

Curry Plate: flavorful broth, kale and bok choy need to be cooked with some other ingredients to bring out flavor (felt more steammed), chicken cooked perfectly.

Chicken Satay: Only two pieces which for $6 is a little expensive. Could use more peanut sauce as it was used sparingly.

Overall: I would definitely come to this place again. Good variety in dishes and overall was worth the purchase. Some changes could be made but as its only been open for a few days, what they have going on here is worth checking out (I orderd through Grub Hub)

One of the best Vietnamese places I've ever been to. Mr East Kitchen is more of an untraditional American-Vietnamese restaurant. Only two long tables inside and a couple of two seaters outside. Perfect aesthetic place for the foodies that love taking pictures and the decorations are really cute. The amazing food and environment make me feel right at home. Ordered the garlic noodles with chicken. Usually, when I order garlic noodles with chicken at Vietnamese places, the meat is super dry and hard to chew. But the meat was juicy and lean. Also the flavor of the noodles didn't overpower the meat and veggies. Very well balanced bowl made with fresh ingredients. Great service and food comes out fast. Prices are pretty average for the noodles ($13-$14). Hope to come back soon!

Dropped in for lunch. Got the "banh mi" with pork. Not bad but definitely not traditional here- hipsterized version of Viet food. Pork was flavorful, good mayo sauce, bread was soft- ciabatta- not baguette. I tried some of the steak pho which again was not the traditional style here. (Kale in the pho...) Broth was flavorful, but a bit salty. Steak was good. Price was ok for SF. Overall- decent, would try it again.

Super cute spot with fresh decor, a unique menu (love things like the Thai tea French toast) and better price compared to nearby locations (their coffee is better and half the price of nearby Contraband).

I think you guys could do a lot to increase traction and make this a hot spot in the neighborhood for the complexes right next door full of young people:

The best cafes are spots that people want to come spend a few hrs hanging out with friends, or do some work while grabbing a drink and a light meal. Add more outlets around the space so people can charge laptops/phones while at your place, and add Wi-Fi for customers. This is an expectation young people have for cafes in 2018.

Also, add more comfortable seating- put some more lounge-like chairs around and put cushions on the long bench you have on one of the walls- you guys have the space for it and will make the spot more attractive as a place to meet friends

Overall excited about the spot and looking forward to seeing how you grow.

This has become one of my favorite places to order from! Think I've already ordered this like 3 days I a row... The tom yum soup is amazing. The banh mi is pretty filling and the chicken was so tasty! All the fruit teas just hit the spot!! How haven't I tried this place before?!
I only went once but will be back! I had the Drunken Beef and it was fire. Great flavor, plenty of great juice! Can't wait to try again.
Super close to work and super convenient. I've gotten to go a number of times, highly recommend.

It was a good experience having brunch here on the weekend before going to SFMoMA. They have very good selection on their brunch menu. The Thai iced tea was great. Thai Tea French Toast was a perfect match. I enjoy the decor in the restaurant as long as the service. The server was very friendly and attentive. Overall experience here was great. I would come back to try their lunch menu.
The best spicy salmon dish here at Mr. East Kitchen is so good and fresh with a great service make the best coffee with great design. For sure we'll be back

I just got the Pad See Ew on the free voucher program. The meal was delicious. I'd never eaten wok nookles, but they are great. The broccoli could have been cooked a little longer, because they were a little hard to chew with a limited amount of teeth. The counter clerk/server was very polite. He even engaged me in conversation about my cycling. He made me feel welcome. One day when I have more funds, I'll eat there as a paying customer. I'll also recommend Mr. East Kitchen to friends.

I first ate there on a voucher program. Their food is delicious, especially the shrimp fried rice. The problem I have is the fact that when I asked if I could get my order for dine in, I was told that vouchers are for take out only. I felt as though I wasn't good enough to sit inside and eat my meal. It is true, I am on disability and reside in supportive housing, but I should not be treated this way, just due to the fact that I'm using a voucher. Otherwise, they would have been given 5 stars.

It was pretty good. Bacon was delicious. the Thai pancake was awesome too. Self serving is fine if it was obvious where everything was...I also really dislike hard chairs...the place is a bit cold....and fast food like...for the price, and for the food, which deserve a lazy brunchy sunday kinda enjoyment, really calls for more comfy, warmer furniture...just my two cents...

Had garlic noodles with lemon grass chicken. The garlic noodles were great! Liked the bits of crispy garlic. The chicken was on the dry side, could've used more flavor. Definitely have had better lemongrass chicken. Also had Thai tea with boba--good standard stuff, not wow.

I recently tried them again and I'm happy to report that the morning green salad, despite the $3 price increase, is great again. The veggies are fresh, the portion is pretty good, and I'm getting toast instead of croutons.

They took away the protein options as well and I think that's fine. I'm happy to pay for the quality. I hope they can maintain it this time.

This is (was) my go to spot for their morning green salad but in the last few weeks it has been getting very noticeably worse. The avocado served recently have black marks all over and today I got croutons instead of the regular french toast. Not getting food from them anymore since I don't know what I will get.
Great place to get some breakfast and brunch! I really enjoyed the outside seating because the weather was great and they decorate very well.
This place is amazing, super friendly staff and very clean establishment. Definitely recommend to anyone in the area, you won't be disappointed. Amazing presentation as well! 10/10 recommend

Overall our experience was amazing, both the food and the service was great the food was very fresh and tasteful the foods appearance on the plate was practically making us drool we couldn't wait to indulge in to it all after taking pictures of it! However, only one thing we were disappointed about. We activated our Restaurant.com Certificate at Mr. East Kitchen as it is one of the available certificates on its website. But after we placed our order and redeemed the certificate, the cashier needed to get the manager/owner and they were saying we were unable to use it here. Of course we were a bit flustered considering we were starving, made a commute from our hotel specifically to this place to redeem this certificate, and then once we already redeemed it we were told we were unable to use it. Fortunately, after briefly staring at the manager with faces of confusion and frustration as he basically tried to deny current partnership with Restaurant.com and then have us pay full price, he took care of the coupon for us which we appreciated. I mainly wanted to type this review so that you are aware that Mr. East Kitchen does NOT want to be associated with restaurant.com. I was thinking the owner mainly did it for marketing and publicity purposes but that's just a bit shady and inconsiderate, to me personally. I even asked him if he informed the company about this and he kinda said yes but it didn't look sincere to me, and I'm sure restaurant.com would had taken Mr. East Kitchen off of the website if that was true. I wanted to make sure a similar situation does not happen again to future customers. It's just a bit inconsiderate of them considering most customers are most likely not from the area, and we specifically used our time and money to drive to this location to use this certificate. But like I said, overall the food and the service was great after the initial encounter with the cashier and manager/owner. Well thank you for your time and I hope you take my advice and experience into consideration. :) I do recommend this place!

The food is good not spectacular but good. I ordered the Garlic Noodle Bowl with grilled shrimp and Thai Tea to go. The portions were great and I feel they are reasonably priced accordingly. The one thing that really turned me off about this place was the girl at the counter. She made the experience extremely awkward and uncomfortable. She was not eager to answer any questions nor did she crack a smile or have a friendly inviting demeanor during the entire encounter. When I asked if I could have some more unsweetened tea for my Thai tea that was too sweet and 1/3 foam she scolded me and said next time tell me how sweet you want it before I make it. I also was not provided with any "to go" items just simply handed a box of food. Unfortunately her Energy over shadowed everything else which probably shouldn't be the lasting impression a new business leaves on its customers.

Decided to stop here while getting my car fix and glad I did! Not too busy at brunch and we were able to get seated right away. Husband and I had the steak, banana toast, and the side of two eggs with the chicken sausage. Everything was absolutely perfect! From the presentation, service, and down to the last bite! I would definitely recommend this place!
Good place to go I actually Their really nice and helpful stuff and also their food is really good my fav plate is Fried Rice with beef,shrimp broccoli and carrots

I bookmarked this once I saw it pop up on yelp. I was in the area and decide to pop over. Menu is pretty decent for a quick bites place. Its super clean and sunny so def nice lunch break place. I ordered a jasmine milk tea, bahn mi, and the wings. The tea was good that I've been back once more. The bahn mi was a little disappointing. The bread just wans't the usual bread and a bit too bready. The salad was good though. WIngs were small but still tasty.
My favorite here is the beef pad Thai, it's really good and the portions are large! I also really like the fruit teas here, I definitely will come again!
The brunch is quite good (We got the French toast and an egg dish) and best of all no crazy line!

Great food and friendly staff. Very clean. Garlic noodles are great. Lookout for the homeless that come in and just grab a drink from the cooler and leave. It's just in kind of a rough area. Sad they can't really do anything about it (to be honest is it worth it for them to do something and cause a scene to make customer feel uncomfortable). Perhaps putting the drinks behind the counter might help.
Tast brunch with a dash of southeast Asian flavor. Tom yum omelette and shrimp Benedict with curry hollandaise. Yum

10% off when ordering by phone or in person! I've been frequenting Mr. East Kitchen for over a year and haven't grown tired of their extensive menu at all. Definitely try the sriracha wings + garlic fries ($9) and the pineapple fried rice!
Beautiful restaurant with great service! Highly recommend the Tom yum omelette and the Thai Tea french toast! :)
I order from here almost 2-3x a week. I love their food. So we'll presented and delicious!!! Wish they were open in the evenings!

Came across this place on Instagram while looking for something to eat for lunch and so glad that I did. I ended up ordering the banh mi to go with chicken. It comes with a kale salad too so that was nice. Chicken was tender and flavorful, and they use a ciabatta bread which is different but I like it. They have boba too with Straus milk. A bit sweet but it's my fault since I get 100%. I'll be back soon.

The food here was decent, but the French toast with Thai iced tea type sauce on it was NOT TASTY. The service was kind, but the location was not good for parking and the interior was rather industrial. I had some eggs and hash browns that were delicious and good sriracha bacon, but their most famous dish was just weird and they didn't have maple syrup at all.

Pretty decent bahn mi sandwiches. I ordered their lemongrass grill chicken shoulder bahn mi sandwiches which was absolutely delicious!! My friend ordered their pork, and their broth was pretty tasty. She said that it was decent for the price...

Friendly staff. Excellent food. During COVID, pre vaccination. They gave 15% discount to help. I appreciated that. Food tasting great is first and it did. Their price very very good. Garlic noodle with grill pork comes with kale salad. If memory serve me right. Below $15. I a,ways finish filling full
the food was incredible and the staff was very friendly. The atmosphere was very nice and cute and I definitely will come back when I come to the city again.

Curry is very good. But the new hours make no sense unless you are a local business. Not open after 3 or on Sundays. Use to be a favorite of mine but their hours make it clear that they no longer want business from local residents.
This has become one of our favorite hidden gems. Everything we ever ordered was delicious and we left in a food coma. Staff is friendly. Food is FRESH!

I was looking for a place to eat brunch on Saturday before visiting the American Bookbinders Museum. Feared this would place would be busy -- it wasn't. Ordered the Tom Yum omelette and the Pancake special -- loved the sticky rice that came as a valentine's day treat. Menu has some interesting selections for all meals. Highly recommended.
The food here is delicious, and the drinks are as well. The Thai Lime ice tea is unique and definitely should be tried!!

Five stars for the food and service :) Ordered their pad see ew and it came with a generous amount of noodles and chicken. The dish was nicely flavored, not oily at all, and came out fresh and hot. Their garlic fries were perfectly seasoned, not over-garlicky at all, and it paired really nicely with the sauce served on the side. I also ordered their Jasmine Milk Tea with boba and it tasted freshly made. I appreciate how they allow you to customize the drink to your likings: type of milk, sweetness, ice level). The lady/cashier who took our order was super nice, and so was the guy who made our drink and served us. The restaurant itself was super clean and nicely decorated. Overall, great experience dining in at this restaurant.

Amazing service and amazing food!!! Definitely worth checking out! The options are all too good to choose from but I can confidently say I was impressed with the garlic noodles and tofu! My new favorite place
Great service and food, we stopped by for breakfast and were pleasantly surprised. Large portion and super tasty!

This is my new favorite brunch place! There's a wide variety of food and everything we've tried so far has been excellent. I'm looking forward to trying some of the lunch-ier menu items at some point. Lastly a tip for folks who prefer drinks that aren't sickeningly sweet: try the Thai Lime fruit tea! It's what all Thai tea should taste like.

New lunch spot! Came here so a friend could have the pork noodles. I got the tofu salad and man, the tofu was super tasty! Wide range of options, big fan of what they are doing. Quick service. Clean inside. I wish them well.
