We got the mascarpone pancakes, k bomb chicken benny (benedict), butterfly lychee drink, and the strawberry matcha latte. Everything was delicious and our server was amazing!
food and service are amazing - went with a friend and we were sat in under 10 minutes and food came out quick. Kind staff

Delicious! Butterfly Lychee and Leafy Green Benedict
Wait time was around 45 minutes on a Sunday.

I came here with a large party and made a reservation online. When we arrived, the table was all ready for us and they even added more seats when we requested it at the last minute. But in terms of service, that was where it ended....

The food was admittedly very good and looked even better in photos. We ordered a whole bunch of plates and shared with each other so that we could try a bit of everything. My favorites were the okonomiyaki fries, anything with the house potatoes, the pancakes, and the smoked salmon Benedict. Everyone dining with me raved about the potatoes/fries too. The drinks, on the other hand, looked great but tasted subpar.

The service could have been better though. We knew going in to it that there was mandatory gratuity of 20%, which is higher than the norm. That was fine since it was a special occasion, but we knew it could go one of two ways: they're guaranteed a high tip so the wait staff can be complacent and unattentive, or the service will be exceptional. We felt like it was more of the former. After we made our order and told them we were going to share everything, we still had to keep flagging the waiters to ask for extra plates, utensils, condiments, napkins, etc.

The mandatory tip equaled to almost $50 for us, which is almost the cost of two items from the menu. That is a bit exorbitant imo.

Other than that, I also thought there were some cleanliness issues. As I sat down, I immediately noticed how all the fabric seats were stained with oil and who knows what else. We sat next to the white wall, and I noticed the paint was peeling off. The utensils are served in these cute gingham lined baskets, but is the lining washed after group after group has touched them? Finally, the floor was littered with scraps of food.

Besides the issues, the food was good but I do wish there was more variety to the menu. Right now, it's very brunch (carb heavy) focused. So lots of potatoes, bread, waffles, pancakes. Hopefully more meats are added in the future. I know they used to have dinner service but not anymore, so I would love to go and try their dinner menu if they bring it back. Other than that, I won't be dining here regularly. The prices are fine for this type of fusion brunch, but the mandatory tip is a bit extra and makes me not want to go and support that kind of policy.

Such a good place. I've been back so many times. Always super busy and often a wait but they do their best to be accommodating. Staff is so sweet. The volcano coffee is one of my go tos. Definitely crowded but still a nice place.

I knew this place was SUPER popular and also saw other reviewers that recommended to go early. I was gonna reserve a place, but they actually don't do reservations especially on a weekend, so it's first come first serve.

Since it was better to go early, I woke up at 10am to head down to SF with a friend of mine for brunch. We didn't get there until 11ish, and once we got there, the place was PACKED omg. Thankfully, we didn't have to wait that long for a table, and got in fairly quickly.

I ordered a K-bomb chicken benny and it seems to be a popular dish as there was one on every table. It had a lot of variety to it like a mini salad, poached eggs, Korean fried chicken, and potatoes. Everything was really good, and I get why a lot of people get it.

My friend got the Mascarpone Pancake, which looked really good as well. She said the crème tasted like a mix of whipped cream/cheesecake? which she got sick of it halfway through. There was too much of it, so we had to scrapped half of it off. Pancakes itself were nice and fluffy.

My friend got the pina colada, which she said it had a mixture of tart & sweetness. I got the butterfly lychee which was so refreshing. All the food and drinks were so aesthetically pleasing.

Service and the wait time was pretty good. Servers were going in & out quickly, and they were top notch. The store itself is modern & fancy. Friend said the place could fit well for a very small wedding venue.

This place is always packed around brunch time on the weekend so make sure you get here earlier in the morning! Was my second time here, and this time I got the k bomb chicken benny which was delicious. The plate also came with a good amount of salad and potatoes that I couldn't finish, so had my friend eat them. The service is also great and super kind.

During this time of year, they had lots of Christmas decorations up, like garlands, lights and a tree! Super festive!

One of the best breakfast places in SF, hands down! Make sure to make a reservation if you are able to. This place is busy non stop from opening to closing time.

We ordered the butterfly lychee, strawberry lemonade, chipotle Benedict (the best Benedict's I've had) chicken and waffles and kids pancakes with bacon. The food was EXCELLENT and by far the best food we had during our SF trip. Service was also great.

You can only find street Parking which makes it challenging.

Oh gosh! My large family and I were in town. After reading some reviews we thought this was a great fit. Not going to lie I didn't look at the menu just skimmed over pictures. When we arrived I was a little afraid that my traditional Hispanic in-laws were not going to like their food as they wanted something more traditional! But wow I watched everyone nod their heads in satisfaction as they took their first bite!
We waited a little to get seated and our services took a little longer but I'm assuming due to our larger party. The service was amazing!
Will definitely be back!

Incredibly delicious!
I came yesterday with my girl around 11:45AM. As we arrived we noticed there was a lot of people waiting along with all tables inside occupied. We both knew if this place has a wait with walk tables occupied it is a must go to spot for brunch. We waited for a good 30 minutes until we got a text our table was ready.
As we got seated we were immediately treated by our server. They have QR codes for their menu. My girl got a matcha and I got a cranberry mimosa. Their cranberry mimosa was incredibly delicious! I ordered their chipotle Benedict and my girl got Korean chicken Benedict. Our food came out in a great time and both of our foods tasted incredible! Usually with Korean chicken it is usually a hit or miss, but the way they cooked it and crisped it was perfection!
The establishment in the inside was very cute and not too small. They have a good layout of the restaurant and they have a bar where you can peek at, I do not think you are able to eat at the bar.

Overall I would come back here again when both my girl and I are visiting SF

Busy on a Wednesday morning, but seated immediately. Their QR menu is easy to read and access. Possibly the best Chicken & Waffle I've ever had! Chicken is absolutely delicious and meaty, not oily nor soggy. Nice texture and individual flavor to each dish is great. We were not a fan of the crust on French toast, but still a good sweet treat to share. You do have to wave down service if they are busy, but shout out to 2 foh staff who held the whole space down! (I know it's not easy) Yummy Matcha is a must!

There was about. 30 minute wait for us to be seated and they are adamant about not seating you without your full party. However, we were greeted quickly and sat when our table was ready. I ordered the mango matcha latte with oat milk. They were pretty busy after we were seated but we finally received our drinks after about 15 minutes after ordered. It was pretty good.

Food wise, I ordered the K-Bomb Benny (Korean fried chicken benedict) it was sooo good. I asked for my eggs to be poached medium and they were absolutely perfect. It was a pretty large serving and I finished most of it. Great combo of flavors!

There was nothing memorable about the decor or ambiance besides how busy it was, which is great for the restaurant. We had a flight to catch so we were in and out within an hour or so. Good food but I don't know that I'll be back here.

Love this place! Friendly service, food is always good and can never make a wrong choice. Ambiance is nice as well and they definitely have instagram worthy drinks. I drank mine and didn't get a pic their mocha lava is delicious! Get here early as it does get crowded!
Service is really good!!! But last time I went I ordered chicken and waffles and honestly speaking the chicken was too crunchy (burnt) for my liking

Ooooh! It was pure deliciousness

With my family being spread across the states, it was time to double as tourists in the City. No turkey. No dressing. No sweet potatoes. But YES TO CHICKEN & WAFFLES, SALMON BENEDICT, and GRILLED CHICKEN SANDWICH! Mimosas, Iced Coffees and Boba!! Yummy

Not crowded, food great, perfect for "Native Tourists"! And we will be back!!!

This place is always so good, the staff are friendly and the service is timely. Usually the restaurant is packed during brunch but today I was lucky to get there with no wait times. The food is consistently good, anything you get is honestly yummy. I typically get the chicken and waffles or the pancakes but today I got the eggs Benedict with salmon. It was amazing, packed with unique flavors and the portion was quite large.

Tasty food. We had some drinks to go along with it and we were happy. The restaurant was nice; I liked the cute atmosphere (cozy vibes) service was also good. It was affordable for our budget so we were satisfied in the end

I only have one thing to say here -- the mascarpone pancakes are EXQUISITE (which I regrettably did not get a picture of). I don't think I'd ever be able to finish it myself but it is just so rich and creamy and I will definitely come back just for that. Chef's kiss. Definitely gets a tad bit overwhelming if you eat more than a few bites though but it is so good. I'd recommend sharing with at least another person.

The location is nice, and the ambiance is pretty standard in terms of brunch places -- minimalistic and clean.

The brunch plates were overall not bad, and I liked how balanced everything was. I did notice that they do not allow substitutions in order to manage time, which I do wish they would allow (especially for dietary restrictions), but I do appreciate the available options. The scramble was surprisingly not super "eggy" and the mango and strawberry matcha lattes were pretty solid as well. But the star of the show is definitely the pancakes!!

Overall, great experience for me! My boyfriend and I went on a brunch date here, and truly had a great time. I had the K-Bomb Benny and the Whipped Mocha Coffee.... FIRE! The pancake was a little dry and could've been more buttery, but it wasn't terrible imo. As much as I love a good physical menu, their online menu stood out to me because the graphic design and images were just so fun. Overall, the ease of service, interior design, flavors, and ambience were a breath of fresh air.

Four Chairs is giving brunch goals -- from the vibes to the plates, everything hits.

The cranberry mimosas are off the hook -- tart, bubbly, and way too easy to sip. The interior is beautiful, with a modern, cozy feel that makes you want to stay awhile.

The chicken and waffles were perfectly crispy and flavorful, and the K-Bomb Chicken Benedict? I ate and left no crumbs. Flavorful, bold, and totally worth the hype.

Great food, great drinks, and a space that feels like a whole experience. Definitely coming back!

Food: Great! The traditional eggs benedict was delicious. Lemon hollandaise sauce was amazing, everything is cooked perfectly. The volcano coffee is on the bland side and is akin to a very milky latte when fully mixed. It lacks sweetness and coffee flavor.

Service: No complaints. Not long of a wait for Saturday afternoon.

Ambiance: Spacious interior and clean.
Parking is hard to find, waitlist is expected to be long but about 20-30mins for us. We loved it so much we had to return again

Hubby suggested this place after seeing it on Tiktok and we made our way there. Only street parking is available and was full when we got there. We split into two (there are four of us), two to look for parking, and two to get on the wait list. There was a short wait of 35 minutes before we were seated. It's a medium sized restaurant and it was packed. Minimal space between the tables. There were beautiful light fixtures and all kinds of decorative items on the walls and shelves. It was clean, average on the noise level, and comfy. The waiter was friendly and came to take our orders.

K-Bomb benny (my order)- Mmm that Korean chicken, beautiful burst of red, and nicely seasoned, tender, it was NOM. The rest of the meal complimented it well.

Creme brulee french toast- We all got a taste of this and it did not disappoint! Creme brulee lover here, it was not too sweet, and so so so good! I'm not a french toast person, but I would love to eat this again.

K-Bomb chicken sandwich- My son ordered this and said it was the best chicken sandwich he has eaten, and asked how he can eat this on a regular lol guess I got learn how to make this at home haha

Chicken and waffle- Hubby ordered this and LOVED it!

We'll have to come back to try the mascarpone pancakes.

Didn't have a reservation but they moved through the waitlist pretty quickly. Our food came out fast too. Didn't feel rushed while eating but it was pretty warm and loud in there because there was a lot of people.

Came on a Saturday around 9:30am. The restaurant was completely full, but we were seated pretty quickly.

K-Bomb Chicken Benny:
The side salad was surprisingly good, the potatoes were crispy, and the chicken itself tasted great--though the breading started falling off after the first bite. The eggs Benedict, however, was rough. The sauce was very citrus-forward, almost like mayo mixed with lemon, and it dripped all over the plate. The whole dish felt awkward, like the flavors weren't meant to go together.

Crème Brûlée French Toast:
Not my favorite--it tasted like condensed milk over scrambled eggs. My partner loved it, though, so it might be worth trying depending on your taste.

Chipotle Benny:
Came with the same questionable sauce, and the bread underneath was so burnt we couldn't cut through it, even after asking for a sharper knife. The dish was about 70% bread. We ended up having to send it back because it was that bad.

Strawberry Matcha & Mocha Latte:
Both were delicious!

The staff was very friendly overall. However, midway through our meal, we were approached and asked to move across the restaurant to help accommodate more people. It was extremely awkward and left a bad taste in my mouth. I felt like if they were going to inconvenience us like that, they could've at least comped something--but nothing was offered.

Overall, not the best experience for me personally, but I'd consider giving it another try since my partner really enjoyed the French toast.

Food was delicious. The waffle WAS PERFECT SO GOOD my bf and I loved it. Service was great and super kind always checking up on us. The drinks were amazing and beautiful, I recommend this restaurant and will be coming back for sure with friends! :)
Good place for brunch. A lot of sweet and savory options. Plenty of drink choices too. There can be a little wait depending on the time you come. Spacious and just great for dining in.

Take my review with a grain of salt because it appears to be short staffed. Only two workers running around the whole restaurant, but only one for the first half I was here.

The restaurant is cute, as is the food. However probably due to the lack of staff, we didn't get to order for a while, long enough to lose my appetite a bit. We also weren't sat right away despite having a reservation. Not super long though and probably due to the short staff again. I do recommend making a reservation though because it was packed at 10:30AM on a Thursday. The staff was super sweet though and took off my egged Benedict when they noticed I didn't like it.

For the food, I fear this place is gimmicky. The photos are great, however I would prefer if the taste lived up to it. The pancakes were not fluffy, a bit chewy actually. I also got the k chicken Benedict, which the chicken I can applaud for being tender. It wasn't bad, but not memorable. The eggs Benedict themselves, was not a fan of the flavor profile. I couldn't eat it. Might also be due to having to wait so long to order them the time for them to cook, I wasn't really hungry anymore.
They are nice and friendly here. The food didn't take long to arrive after ordering. The drinks were good along with the meal. I like that the food wasn't greasy. It was good.
Love it here the wait time sometimes is long however food is great will come back however definitely arrive early or make a reservation. Drinks 10/10 food 8/10 Space 8/10

Food - 7/10 - looks better than it tastes, but still enjoyable and always a good time with friends and family!

We went on a Wednesday morning at 11am for brunch, I wanted the truffle omelette but was told that they were out of it. I saw that the chicken and waffles were one of the "recommended" items so I ordered it. The chicken ended up to be mid. The texture of the batter were too grainy for my taste and a bit dry...the flavor was there tho

my mom ordered the Kbomb Benedict and the dish was presented really well. Again the fried chicken in the kbomb Benedict was subpar. Her Benedict plate came with potatoes and a side of salad with carrots (which we forgot to tell our server beforehand regarding her carrots allergies) so she had to individually pick them out to enjoy her food.

The okonomyaki fries were one of the best tasting item that we got today. The bonito flakes definitely add to the flavor profile of the fries, very interesting!

Service - 7/10
The servers were very attentive. There were only 2 servers on the floor with 15-20 tables so it took a while for us to get serve. Not sure if they have communication or assigned sections between servers but I find it abit awkward when one server took our order, 2 minutes later, the other server came to our table ask to take our order. Seems disorganized but really appreciate their efforts as they seemed short staffed.

We'll be back! Waited about an hour on a Saturday around noon. All of our party wasn't there yet but the host held our spot in line till they were there. Had chicken and waffles, creme brulee French toast, and a couple different Benedict's. All of it came out fast and was amazing!! No left overs for us.

I came here for brunch with a friend. They have a wide variety of food options, as well as "instagramable" items. We opted for the k-bomb chicken Benny, chicken and waffle, and mascarpone pancake. Food was delicious. They provided different types of syrups, so the food wasn't overly sweet. One was a classic sweet syrup, and the other one was spicy syrup. I ordered a side of coffee and it wasn't the best. It was way too dark and I don't think it was meant to be brewed that way.

Overall, we enjoyed our food. I strongly advise you to come early because it fills up fast! By 9:30 there was a line out the door and service was slow. There was one person taking orders for the entire restaurant.

This place is a benchmark in great brunch. The savory food was rich, delicious, full of fresh vegetables and - critically - with great sourdough toast. And the waffle was sweet and tasty with that great Belgian crispy coating, without feeling *too* rich after that great meal.

I had to try the chocolate milk and I'm glad I did...it was so good it was ridiculous. I will come back craving that specifically.

We definitely want to come back and try some cocktails but this was an awesome recovery meal after a night out dancing. Love that this place is so close to us in Bernal because it's among the best brunches in sf. And, it's got that cozy vibe we love Bernal for, with friendly and fast staff.

And whew, those potatoes are so good! Needless to say, we both cleaned our plates.
Food is always yummy here and came out quickly.. Staff was friendly. Must have chicken & waffles.
I enjoyed my time. Everything was amazing.! I definitely recommend everyone go here. Take the time enjoy the ambience and eat good food.

My boyfriend and I visited this spot when we landed in San Francisco last month. What really drew our attention was the creative dishes.
The food was spectacular but my absolute favorite was the Matcha Latte with Strawberry purée.

Calm and spacious little restaurant, I definitely recommend for any one who likes a creative meal.

Would definitely come back here! We walked in just after they opened at 9am on a Saturday and we were already like the seventh party there. The others literally must have been waiting in line when the door opened. We were seated quick and served quick! The staff clearly takes great pride in plating the food perfectly. Everything was served beautifully.

Volcano coffee - we ordered it with almond milk. Once mixed up, it tastes like a jamocha or coffee flavored shake. Very good! However, there's much too much ice in the glass. It turns out to be a pretty small serving due to the amount of ice.

Chicken and waffles - the chicken wasn't what we expected. It wasn't seasoned as well as desired and looked/tasted like it was coated in cornflakes. Hubby says he could taste the flour in the crusting and it wasn't fried hard enough. It came with a sweet and sour type sauce that was pretty tasty on its own but he never tried it on his chicken. The waffle was perfection! Hubby says it's probably the best Belgian waffle he's ever had!

Crème brûlée French toast - OH.Em.GEEEEEE!!! I LOVE crème brûlée sooooo this was EVERYTHING! Like good to the last drop!! I'd come eat this again and again!

Home fries - yes please!! These were perfection! Get them. Every time.

Egg whites - such a huge serving. They were fine.

The food here was so fire, I forgot to take a picture. We ordered the mascarpone pancakes and k-bomb chicken benny. Both were amazing. Everyone who sat near us at the next table ordered a similar combination and we all looked over, smiled and agreed that it was delicious. Quick and easy service. Very polite servers and clean tables. I highly recommend this place for brunch. The waitlist was only 15 mins for us for Sunday brunch.

From the moment we walked in, the cozy aesthetic and welcoming vibe set the tone for an unforgettable brunch. The presentation of the food is top-tier--Instagram-worthy but more importantly, absolutely delicious.

We had the shrimp eggs Benedict, and wow--perfectly poached eggs, juicy shrimp, and the most flavorful hollandaise sauce I've ever had. The roasted potatoes were crispy on the outside and soft inside--seasoned just right. My friend ordered the Korean fried chicken plate and couldn't stop raving about the sauce and crunch. Both dishes came with fresh, vibrant greens that balanced the richness beautifully.

And the drink... chef's kiss. The strawberry matcha with mint was as refreshing as it was stunning--a perfect balance of creamy, earthy, and sweet. The layers looked like art in a glass.

Service was friendly, attentive, and genuine. You can tell they put a lot of love into every detail here.

Whether you're a local or just visiting SF, Four Chairs is a must. Already planning my next visit!

Not worth the price or the wait. It was good however, definitely not worth the hype. So disappointed.
The kbomb benny was sad.. relying heavily on the chicken for flavor so the benny was bland. The creme brulee French toast was only really good on the top toast in the middle... everywhere else was just like bread with the custard on top rather than a French toast. The chicken sandwich and the mushroom burger were good but did not justify the price, nothing special.
The service was incredibly friendly and fast.
This is just kinda one of those trendy brunch places that's just for looks more than anything else. Not bad, but would not return.

My friend randomly picked this place and I must tell you, THIS IS THEEEE SPOT TO BE for breakfast and brunch.

We were a bit shocked about the line on a Sunday noon but a quick glance inside explained everything.

Luckily the wait was only 15-20min. This place is packed like crazy. The food is super good. Didn't get to try any (alcoholic) drinks but I'm sure those are fabulous as well.

Staff is friendly and quick to serve you.
They cook some great tasting fresh food serbices are great atmospheres great staffs friendly very helpful their great for a community

A birthday brunch success! They don't take reservations on weekends, but a friend showed up early and joined the waitlist. There is a solid amount of seating inside (although a little cramped), but the decoration is very cozy with a lot of wooden furniture & warm lights.

When I'm eating out I want a combination of taste, portion, and presentation. This place hit all 3 which made the higher price worthwhile. I ordered the K-bomb chicken Benny and although I'm not a huge fan of eggs benedicts, this place changed my mind.

Every was well seasoned, presented nicely, and left us feeling full. The drinks also complemented the meal well and were pretty to look at. Their menu has a solid amount of options ranging from light and sweet to heavy & savory. The mascarpone pancakes were a perfect dessert to end the meal on (though they might be too light for a meal itself).
Food is outstanding, Service was amazing and place overall is really welcoming. Definitely coming back soon.

Great spot for brunch in the city! Prices aren't outrageous and the service is quick. Our party of five came around 2pm on a Saturday and was able to get seated within 10 minutes which was great.

We got seated at the large community table with another party and started perusing the menu which is on a QR code. I decided to split one sweet and one savory dish with a friend opting for the K-bomb Chicken Benny and mascarpone pancakes. The chicken was batter and dipped into a sweet and spicy sauce more mild than spicy and served a too fluffy toast. The eggs were runny and came with a side salad. I would say the portions are quite large and filling for brunch.

We were expecting the mascarpone to be inside the pancakes but it was sandwiched in between the layers of pancake. However the pancakes with fluffy and flavorful so no complaints here. Served with fruit it helps break up the sweetness and density of a carby meal.

Excited to come back and try some of the drink menu and other items :)

just trifling. the chicken was dry as hell and we had to wait a whole hour out in the cold just for them to tell us that we had to sign in ourselves on their ipad system. the drinks were really good but if your blackj or have experience eating good chicken DON'T come here.
thai tea was excellent though.
Fried chicken does not travel well, so i would like to try again by dining in. Thought it was a bit overpriced for the quality.

Food
Service ( why 4 stars? When we left, a waiter said bye but a waitress standing next to us , no smile and no bye)
Ambiance

Overall kids love it

Be prepared to wait on the weekends. I went on a Sunday around noon and was like 1h wait.
The place is bigger than I thought. There are some comunal tables for bigger parties.
You have to scan the QR code for the menu.

I had the K-bomb Chicken Sandwich and Butterfly Lychee to drink and shared the mascarpone pancakes.

The drink was a just a little too bit sweet for me but didn't mind. Half of the glass had ice, I wish it had less to be honest. Not enough to drink.

The Chicken sandwich was good. Not too spicy. Just a little messy to eat and you'll need a wet towel or more napkins.

Pancakes. Yeah.. no. I don't understand why would you put mascarpone cream between the pancakes. Doesn't add any flavor, just fat. Maybe if they had it for a Tiramisù pancake would make sense.

Service good and fast. You can split the check only in 2 cards.

Overall it was good, nothing stands out but for me brunch is all the same. Everything is well presented and the drinks are very cute. I wouldn't wait 1h again to go here. Arrive early.

Couldn't make a reservation (at least not for Sunday brunch), and they won't seat you until your whole group has arrived. Fortunately, there was no wait at 10 am, but we seemed to have timed it just right because a bunch of people showed up and had to wait as we were seated. When full, the restaurant is quite noisy.

Food was pretty good. Mascarpone pancakes were sweet enough (perhaps a bit too sweet) without the syrup. K-bomb chicken benny comes with ciabatta, but I prefer English muffin. Not sure if they would allow substitution for English muffin.

You can adjust the sweetness for the matcha drinks, but the drink is half ice. The matcha strawberry was ok; I'll try the matcha mango next time (assuming they can accommodate a "no ice" request).

The ambience and service was great, but the food wasn't very good :/

K-bomb Chicken Benny was super salty. The chicken marinade and the potatoes were saved with the side salad. I did scrape the skin off the chicken to make it manageable to finish. Also, the bread wasn't toasted and the egg was essentially a runny soft boiled egg. About 1/3 of the potatoes were actually good and seasoned right, but there were chunks of salt visible... so they were tasty when done right.

My friends both had the Citrus French Toast and they weren't impressed by it either. It didn't taste like French toast to them and was slightly eggy. Also, the side of bacon was $7, for only 2 pieces! Super pricey.

Overall great experience. Make a reservation, this spot gets really full and tends to have a wait. Parking is tough, street parking. All food was delicious, the pancakes, the French toast and the k-bomb was so good. Drinks are also a must try, tried the mango lemonade, and the volcano coffee. Overall great service, and delicious food!

The matcha strawberry was really good. The chicken and waffles were okay, they weren't anything special and it was a small serving for the price. The wait was really long but it was a busy Saturday morning. Very busy inside and crowded
The ambiance is great and the presentation of all the dishes is definitely instagrammable but the food is only okay.

I would give it 3.5 stars if I could. The K-Bomb chicken Benny was very cute but not very yummy. The same was true for the French toast and Chipotle benedict. Four Chairs knocks the presentation out of the park so it's perfect if you're looking for an instagrammable brunch location with a lively, casual atmosphere.

This spot is a must if you're into top-tier pancakes and French toast. The pancakes are fluffy, buttery, and very sweet (which I love). The French toast - Thick-cut, golden, and custardy with a perfect crisp edge. Both are beautifully plated and full of flavor.

Great portions, fair pricing, and a cozy vibe make this place an easy 5/5. Come hungry -- you won't leave disappointed.

Food delicious! Everything we got was so delicious and shareable. Good portion sizes.
Drinks I got the dalgona coffee. Perfect level of sweetness.
Seating, plenty of seating inside. Can be loud if it's a full restaurant. Good service, staff were friendly. Would definitely come back and try other items on the menu.

Came to celebrate my sisters birthday, we were a group of 5 adults and 1 child. We were quoted 30-45 minutes after adding ourselves on to the Yelp waitlist. Around 35 minutes we were notified that our table was ready, upon checking in with the hostess they said another 15 minutes. We were okay with that, but we ended up waiting a little over an hour and this is the part that makes me upset because if you know you can't accommodate us I would much rather the staff be honest with us from the beginning instead of guessing.

Once we were finally seated, our food came fairly quick but it was really cold, portions were reasonable and drinks were good. Our sever checked up on us often and of course gratuity was already added to our bill. This place definitely lacked organization and could've been better.

Wow! This was my first time coming here and they were very impressive. Everything from the staff, atmosphere to the food was all great. We came before closing and were able to get a spot on the waiting list, and we only waited for about 15 minutes for a party of 6. Every dish was a nice twist on brunch. The Korean chicken Benedict was tasty but a bit too saucy in my opinion. The crème brûlée French toast had the flavor mix but was a little bit soggy in the middle. The pancakes were on point! No complaints there. The butterfly lychee drink was colorful and delicious. I added soju to it but the strong lychee flavor masked all the alcohol taste.

3.5/5 Cute Asian American brunch spot in Bernal Heights! They're relatively new to the area and have become a well known spot in the neighborhood; opened in 2022! They are ONLY open for brunch though and allow for Yelp reservations and waitlist. They have a pretty large space and try to make the most of it by putting tables close together. Service was fast and nice!

I've tried the:

K-Bomb Benny (3.5/5) - New item for them but not sure if it should've been a benny since the Korean Fried Chicken was super crispy and flavorful but didn't seem to go with the egg/bread part. For this specific benedict, they didn't do the traditional English muffin and substituted it with ONE slice of ciabatta which, I didn't like.

Mascarpone Pancake (3/5) - They did 3 pancakes with each layer separated by whipped mascarpone which was so delicious but the main minus for me was the pancakes itself :(. The pancakes were kind of dense and just the mascarpone and syrup saved the entire dish for me.

Chicken and Waffle (4/5) - They fr know how to fry things here. It was crispy and juicy inside! The waffle was ok but overall, definitely my favorite item at this restaurant!

Strawberry Matcha Latte (1/5) - The matcha was so watered down and barely had any taste. The strawberry part was just the artificial paste. For $7, it was mid.

Thai Tea (3/5) - Ok.

Truffle Omelet (3/5) - Also ok. Just a normal omelet.

I had found this place on yelp and seen all the great reviews so that really captured my attention. Me and my family went on a Saturday morning a couple of hours after they opened and surprisingly the wait time wasn't bad. We walked in and signed in for the waitlist and no more than 30 minutes later we were seated. Location is a little small, they seem to be really busy so more space would be nice. Food was AMAZING!! I would definitely recommend and come back.

Very unique place in the area sorta near Bernal Heights. They had great business..packed with people. Typical American food but seemingly run by Asians :)

None the less the breakfast food was really good. I felt very southern today so I had fried chicken and waffles haha. The waffle was not soggy; crunchy (?!) for a change... I don't think i've had waffles like this before.

My GF ordered, pancakes mascarpone cheese which was very rich and tasty. Her daughter ordered the eggs benedict which also looked quite tasty compared to others i've seen.

The other thing they are known for is their drinks. The volcano coffee was quite good; this thick cream of a coffee of sorts but blended well with the drink and NOT overly sweet.

Ambiance wise, it is very rustic feeling, benches which is great. I'm not going to fault anyone on this point, but when we went this past weekend; it was one of the hottest days in SF?!! (over 90F! if anyone knows SF, thats like a total outlier! ...hence in the restaurant ...it was like a cooking oven.. I think many establishments in SF probably doesn't have AC the other 364 days of the year ; its like tundra...haha, at least to me. SF is always cold.

Cool place, definitely a return. Prices I won't comment; everything is expensiv in Bay Area. (i'm personally sick of that; won't dwell on that point.)

A great spacious restaurant. The food was fairly quick and was definitely delicious! Pictures below. The staff were friendly and the menus were straight forward. I will definitely go back to grab food again!
Food is really good! Mouth watering. And the drinks!!! Yes! Love it! Service is amazing!

Mega delicious brunch with great service and casual ambiance. I would highly recommend if you're looking for an Instagram worthy plate of brunch fare.

There's an iPad at the front for joining the waitlist. The restaurant was packed when we arrived but we only waited a few minutes.

Back at Four Chairs!!! This time I brought my parent and grandparents. It was a Thursday late afternoon and there was zero wait but that didn't mean there were zero customers. For a Thursday afternoon at a brunch place, it was peaceful.

Strawberry milk: it was delicious! I am always skeptical about strawberry milks from restaurants or cafes since they tend to taste a little funky compared to what I could make at home BUT this was tasted very good (I got it with oak milk which was an extra $1)

K bomb Benny: I ordered this last time too and it HITS every time. It's so good. The fried chicken is made to perfect and the chicken is perfectly made between spicy and sweet. It's moist, it's crispy, it's perfect. The eggs Benedict was also amazing. Poached to perfection, I could eat this every single day.

Chicken and waffle: waffles CRISPY, chicken EVEN CRISPIER

Marscapone pancakes: fluffy pancakes, they have a light flavor and are bouncy. 10/10 if you like pancakes.

My mom and grandparents REALLY enjoyed this place, it's a multigenerational restaurant! (as in anyone can enjoy this place). My mom is even planning on bringing her friends here. I also really love this place, I'm going to be bringing more of my friends here!
Had a superb mid-week brunch here. The ingredients were fresh and the mimosas on point. The service was just as good.
5/5. Everything was perfect, food, service and ambience. Well definitely come back and try other menu.

This is a brunch place that serves you photo-worthy dishes that taste pretty decent. Here's a breakdown of all the dishes I ordered:

Volcano Coffee - your typical dalgona coffee
Butterfly Lychee - a very pretty looking lychee calpico
Nova Benny - LOVED the potatoes on the side and the salmon, but something's off with the sauce
Grilled Chicken Avocado Salad - chicken tastes freshly grilled and the sauce matches well with the rest of the plate

A must-try would be their potatoes...
Service was quick on a weekday even though they had a full house. I would say it is moderately loud.

2/18/23

I came here for saturday morning brunch with one of my friends. I had been wanting to come check out this place, but I usually work weekends, so it was hard to find time to come. My friend and I got here about five minutes before they open so we could beat the crowd. That early in the morning, I parked about a block away from the restaurant. We were the first people to arrive and were promptly seated. You can scan the QR code for their online menu.

Here's what we got for brunch:

- 2 volcano coffees
- Side order of buttermilk pancakes (to share)
- 4 chairs omelet (hers)
- 4 chairs benny (mine)


Our waitress was super friendly and checked on us regularly throughout our meal. The volcano coffees were delicious; definitely an item worth trying out.
Their buttermilk pancakes are very fluffy and won't make you feel heavy like generic pancakes. I really enjoyed the vibrant colors and the freshness of all the ingredients in the food. The potatoes were soft with a little crunch on the outside. The eggs benedict were cooked perfectly. Even the salad was nice, bitter contrast to the rich savory tastes to the eggs and potatoes. I highly recommend this place, but do come early! Would love to return again for another delicious breakfast/brunch.

In a sea of Asian fusion brunch spots, Four Chairs is a solid choice! There are definitely areas of improvement, but overall my party and I had a good brunch.

In terms of food, our favorites were the Bloody Mary, fries (that's paired with sandwiches), Nova Benedict, and mascarpone pancakes. All dishes were very aesthetic and high quality, but those were the specific standouts. The Bloody Marys were a good mix of soju and tomato. The fries were SO crispy and warm. The Benedict had a unique, citrus sauce that paired well with the poached eggs. And the pancakes were soft, bouncey and not too sweet.

In terms of service and ambiance, it was solid as well. Servers were very friendly but a little hard to flag down (since they were so busy). The check-in process was a little confusing since the iPad initially was not working and all the workers were too busy to help troubleshoot. Additionally, we waited around 50 minutes for a party of four on a Sunday afternoon. The biggest flaw for us was that the restaurant was so stuffy and warm. I don't think they have air conditioning built into the building, so we ended up a bit uncomfortable during our meal since the ventilation was lacking. All in all, not deal breakers but just areas the restaurant can fix to get that five star rating!

It's a modern Korean brunch place with fusion items. Food is delicious and photo-worthy decorated. But still don't get the hype!
Service is good and quick when you sit.
You can check in via Yelp app to plan for your trip otherwise expect a looong wait!
Atmosphere is fine though very loud and people sit so close to one another and shouting. Despite nice brunch place with fancy looking dishes, IMHO, not kid (younger than 6yo) friendly, not good for group, not good for quality time seating. Good for couples only.
Good for once experience.
Flavorful food with good presentation. Ambiance was nice and modern, and the service was quick. Good first experience!

Visited on a Saturday morning around 10:30am with two other friends. The restaurant was pretty busy, but luckily as soon as we walked in they were able to seat us. They do have an iPad with a yelp wait-list, that you can add your name to if no seats are available. The restaurant remained pretty busy throughout the morning so be prepared to wait a bit.

Drinks: Volcano coffee - friends order but I had a sip, essentially a dalgona coffee, super strong whipped coffee topping that you mix with milk

Food: Loco Plato - scrambled eggs with shrimp, served with a side of roasted potatoes and toast, shrimp were large and plump cooked perfectly, eggs were well scrambled, wish there was a bit more seasoning ate a little bland

K-Bomb Chicken Benedict - delicious, the fried chicken was crispy, coated in a sweet and spicy gochujang sauce, eggs were nice and runny, creamy spicy hollandaise sauce added even more richness, highly recommend giving this a try

Pancake - texture was nice light and fluffy, beautiful presentation, served with some fruit and maple syrup

Okonomiyaki fries - good crispy shoestring fries topped with Kewpie mayo, okonomiyaki sauce and bonito flakes, a nice option for sharing and a huge portion

Service was fine, staff grabbed our order in a timely manner and food came out relatively quick. Since it was so busy they didn't really check in on us other than to see if we finished and ready for the check.

Overall a solid brunch option with a few unique twists on the classics. Worth a try, the k-bomb benedict was definitely the highlight!

My best friend and I visited Four Chairs for brunch. We arrived around 2:15, hoping they weren't too busy and that it wasn't too late to get a table since the restaurant only accepts walk-ins on the weekend. We put our name down on the Yelp waitlist but were seated right away, when we made eye contact with the server. I love how the cleanliness and coziness of this restaurant align with the eagerness of the servers.

My best friend ordered the Chicken & Waffles while I ordered the Mascarpone Pancake. I was expecting the Mascarpone to be sweet, but not as sweet as I thought- the Mascarpone was overwhelmingly sweet to the point I had to remove most of it off my plate. I also tried some of my friend's Chicken & Waffles which is what you could expect out of it, a juicy chicken and a warm waffle.

Decent brunch place but I don't get all the hype. We came for brunch on a Saturday at 1pm and it was very busy. I wish we would have put ourselves on the Yelp waitlist before we arrived because it was a 60-70min wait when we got there and I'm not sure if it was worth it.

I got the kpop chicken sandwich which I enjoyed. The fried chicken was very flavorful. But my friends both got different breakfast scrambles and they were really bland and mediocre.

From the photos on here and IG I really wanted to love this place. This place is a hop and a skip off of 280/San Jose Ave, on Mission. My son found them on IG and forwarded me the post. So we decided since we had Juneteenth off we would take a trip to the City. I looked up the Yelp page and noticed they had the option to make reservations or get on the wait list. So I had my son put out name in just in case. I am glad we did as when we got there (1:00PM) there was a group of people outside. Parking is a nightmare since it is street metered parking. So allow for like 30 minutes before your reservation time. I dropped my son off so we could at the very least let them know we had arrived while I looked for parking. As he did the host advised him it would be a few minutes as they overlooked we needed a highchair. The entrance is a bit tight and people still decided to park it there to wait for their table.

This place is intimate. By intimate I mean you are almost elbow to elbow with the table next to you. So if you're claustrophobic this may not be the place for you to dine in. Even with the height of the ceilings you still were very aware the room was packed. We were seated and luckily knew what we wanted beforehand.

Our order:
1. Butterfly Lychee and chicken and waffles: drink is listed under "Instagrammable Drinks" and it definitely was. It was actually refreshing and was not overly sweet. Lychee flavor came through nicely. I had high hopes for my chicken and waffles. Presentation was a 10/10 but flavor was lacking and gave it a 4/10. You get one huge waffle with a scoop of butter garnished with a sprig of rosemary, topped with 2 bone-in chicken pieces and a side of sweet and sour for the chicken and syrup for the waffle. The waffle was crispy. Like crispy all the way through and don't know if that was intended. The chicken was breaded in a really thick unseasoned coating. The chicken was also unseasoned but at least was cooked all the way through. Anyone that knows about frying chicken knows you season the chicken AND the coating/batter.

2. My son ordered the strawberry matcha with oatmilk. Another "instagrammable drink" but my son enjoyed it. He opted for the Kinder Garden omelette, with county potatoes and ciabatta bread. The omelette was a veggie omellete and veggies were vibrant in color. Potatoes were fried and unseasoned. Instead of the ciabatta he ordered he was served sourdough. He gave his meal a 3.5/5.

The service was pleasant, attentive and punctual. Bathrooms were actually clean and well stocked for being as busy as they were. Don't think we will be back. It seemed as if they're marscapone pancakes and creme brulee french toast were popular orders as I saw servers coming from the kitchen with trays full. Luckily the table next to us ordered the creme brulee and since we were sitting so close heard them say it was really "egg-y". Presentation for all their items drinks and food are photo op worthy but for the taste, hassle in parking and all the other places in SF that are palate pleasing, I don't know that we'll be back.
Amazing & delicious food. We had the chicken & waffles and Korean chicken, matcha drink & strawberry lemonade. Would definitely come back.

Came here for Brunch with family "party of 7" & i had big expectations about this place since it always seemed busy,
food to me didn't taste fresh and had nothing special if you see the picture of my salad was kinda soggy like it had been sitting with the dressing for a minute!
Service really not organized, too many people working and not knowing what to do.
we had to ask for napkins and more coffee after finishing our meals because nobody was checking on our table.
Sadly Our sever disappeared after taking our order,came back only to drop the check...
worst of all TIP was already included.
After all it was a really bad experience.

Made the trek out here after hearing the good reviews on a Saturday around 11:15am and waited about an hour to get seated! 3.5 stars.

I got the shrimp salad with ciabatta ($18) and my boyfriend got eggs, beef bacon, and sourdough ($17). The sourdough and ciabatta bread looked and tasted nearly the same. The shrimp was nicely cooked and appreciated the fresh fruit in the salad, but it was waaaay over dressed- should have gotten the dressing on the side. The eggs and bacon were also fine, but the star really was the potatoes. Probably my favorite of the meal- perfectly crispy and flavorful. We also got 1 side of pancakes ($8) sweet bite. I appreciated they included all the fruit with the side pancake. I would say the pancake itself was just ok, a little dry for me.

Service was pretty fast once we got there and food was nicely presented and fair prices. Not sure that it was personally worth the 1 out wait for me, but glad we tried it!

Came here on a Sunday around 1 pm and it was absolutely packed which is to be expected. We had no problem waiting and it took us about 30 minutes to get seated.
When I got the notification that our table is ready, I hurried in and got in line to speak to the host. When it was my turn, the host apologized to me and said he gave away my table..... and that we would be next. This has never happened to me before. Then when the next table opened, he apologized again and said he would seat another party before us. What is the purpose of notifying us our table is ready if it is clearly not?
Once we got seated, our server took our orders. The food was absolutely delicious, so flavorful, and large portions. We ordered pancakes and egg Benedict so we can try something sweet and something savory. Both did not disappoint and we left feeling very very full.
The service was pretty disappointing, we barely interacted with the server and we couldn't flag them down. We pretty much got no service until the bill came where we had to ASK the person taking our bill to also take our empty plates. Our plates took up the entire table and we waited for 10 minutes to track down someone to take them. A pretty horrendous service experience.
When we paid in cash, we did NOT say to keep the change yet the server never gave us our change back or our final receipt. Throughout our time there, the only time we interacted with the waitstaff was to take our orders, deliver food, and take our bill where we were finally able to ask for some things. We waited to see if we would get our change back and we didn't, so we just left. The lack of service didn't really warrant a tip so it was an incredibly ironic that they kept our money without asking.

Easily a top fave brunch spot in SF. Everything was beyond amazing! Presentation of food, great cocktails/mocktails, and wonderful staff. Price point was reasonable for the amount of food that you get!

I like how it's an Asian fusion brunch spot. Honestly everything on the menu sounded so good! My friends and I came at 9am so we can be one of the firsts to eat!

We ordered:
k bomb chicken benny -- sweet and a little spicy. Nice and saucy and crispy exterior. It came with eggs benny on a toast and side of potatoes and salad.

okonomiyaki fries -- so much bonito flakes and lightly drizzle mayo sauce. Fries were thin cut and crispy.

strawberry lemonade -- super refreshing. Great combo.

butterfly lychee -- such a beautiful drink!

chicken & waffles -- my friend said it was good but she said she would have liked 2 drum sticks than 1 breast and 1 drumstick. Overall good portions.

mascarpone pancakes -- my friend devoured it! She said it was amazing! Lovely presentation.

mango tango -- pretty good

I would recommend! Staff were so attentive and welcoming. I would come back!

The texture of the food are too rich for us. Maybe we are in rush. W placed the order right after we were seated.after 20 mins , I wanted to ask about that drinks. I waved my hand and called for the waitress. I haven't got a chance to say anything.she shows a little bit impatience" we are waiting for the food" I wanted to ask if the drink is not ready yet I would like to cancel it. It has been 20 mins. " here you go, it's ready.

We ere not greeted during the time of having it he mealMaybe it's Sunday。 and they are too busy. 22% suggested tip came out first, and 18 % is the least , we don't even get the service for 15% tips。hope they can do it better next time

Fast and friendly service

Your sons and garden and sweet maple brunch feel located in the mission-bernal area

Drinks were too sweet for me

Fruits were old and not fresh.

Everything from the french toast to the Korean benny was average, but wouldn't order again.

I thoroughly enjoyed my scramble.

Overall: pretty looking food, but meh and average quality. Thanks :)

I met up with two friends for brunch at Four Chairs and it was GREAT! It was close to 3pm closing and still the servers were attentive and the food and drinks was delicious! I got the crème brûlée French toast and it wasn't too sweet and so yummy. My friends ordered the By the Bay, and the Pacific Sunrise. The Volcano coffee was extra yummy! We all left happy!

I went here for brunch on a Saturday and it looked like it would be busy but we waited around 15-20 mins.

The place itself is very clean and nice. It seemed to have a good amount of seating inside and service was quick!

What we got:
Kbomb chicken Benny- this dish was really good and flavorful. I love how it is a fusion of Korean food with brunch! They gave us a good amount of chicken and I loved the hollandaise sauce on the Benedict's. Over all this dish was pretty good! 8/10

Mascarpone pancake- I really enjoyed this dish! I loved how it had the perfect amount of sweetness. It was so good to the point where I was trying to scrape up all of the mascarpone off the plate! This dish is a must try! 10/10

Strawberry lemonade- This was just your average strawberry lemonade. It was pretty good and well sweetened 8/10

Over this place is a good place to stop by for brunch. The wait isn't that bad either so I think this is a great place to go!

Came here in a Thursday brunch for my friend's bday. We took waymo so i dont know how parking situation is. We had a reservation but there was no wait when we got there. Ambiance was great. Servers was fast but i think theres was only 2 so after we got our food they never came back. We have to call them couple of times.
That place is so good I recommend it to everyone come visit and enjoyed it. Services are great and food flavors is great

Wow. I always make good choices when it comes to brunch. I can say,I read,check in and rave about it after.

We were there as soon as it opened. The service was perfect for travelers like us. We tried 3 items and 3 drinks. We need a bit of everything from coffee to adult beverages.

Mascarpone pancake. I can have this everyday.

Chicken and waffles. Bruh,it was juicy!

Lively omelette. Delicious.

Volcano coffee. It's very similar to a Vietnamese coffee so I had it 'to go' and added ice.

Maybe parking can be a potential problem. Be careful and do not leave any visible valuable. Lol.

Popular brunch spot in the Mission District.
Friday morning reservation made on Yelp. It's a large restaurant with two servers on the floor.
K-Bomb CK Sandwich was very sweet and messy. Ordered the fried chicken sandwich. The chicken taste like Tyson's.
Mascarpone Pancakes too sweet couldn't finish. Ordered the Southwest scramble. It was good.

I was very impressed with the food here. Twelve of us same for brunch on a Saturday at 11am. The staff was very professional and accommodating. I had the k bomb Benedict and my husband had the chicken and waffles.

We don't go out to eat a lot but the food was delicious. I ordered a matcha mango with almond milk for $7 and it was yummy.

The oven baked potatoes in My k bomb beny was nice and crispy. The eggs were cooked perfectly. The Korean chicken was nice and crispy with Korean flavors.

My hubby's chicken with waffles
Was huge and coated perfectly. The drumstick was so
But it didn't fit in the small take out box. It was a large order for $17. He could only eat half.

All the entrees could be shared.

Four Chairs is one of my go-to brunch spots in San Francisco. The food always comes out beautifully plated, and their drinks are just as pretty as they are tasty. It's a cute, cozy spot!

What We Ordered:

K-Bomb Chicken Benny - Korean fried chicken on ciabatta with chipotle hollandaise. Crispy, flavorful, and a fun twist on a classic benny.

Mascarpone Pancakes - Soft, fluffy, and topped with whipped mascarpone and berries. Sweet, buttery, and very satisfying.

Crème Brûlée French Toast - Thick, golden toast with a crackly sugar top and a custardy center--sweet and rich, but not too heavy.

Chicken & Waffles - A comfort classic. Crunchy chicken, fluffy waffle, and a perfect balance of sweet and savory.

Smoked Salmon Eggs Benedict - Fresh, light, and balanced with a creamy hollandaise and soft poached eggs.

Strawberry Matcha Latte - Refreshing with a nice balance of earthy matcha and fruity sweetness--plus it's super photogenic.

Volcano Coffee Creamy - whipped coffee that's smooth and mellow--fun to drink and not overly sweet.

Butterfly Lychee - Light, floral, and refreshing with a pretty gradient--one of those drinks that's made for Instagram.

I've been to four chairs a couple of times and they never disappoint. Located in the mission, usually parking isn't too crazy if you get there early enough. We've gone around 10am and there's never been too much of a wait. They use the Yelp waitlist so you can check in online or when you get there. Last time we waited literally 1 min lol. It was packed but they have plenty of tables and staff who move quickly once someone leaves.

We ordered the volcano coffee, chicken and waffles, veggie omelette and crispy chicken burger and everything was quite flavorful and tasty. I'm a big fan of the volcano coffee because it's thick, creamy and still has a strong coffee flavor which I love. Their fries taste like double fried and I love that crispy texture. Everyone always appears to be in a good mood while at four chairs which I love and staff are super friendly. They also move quickly and get orders out fast.

I saw this place on tiktok, looked intriguing enough to try. This place service, food & drinks are 10/10. BEST coffee I've had in a long time! Chipotle Benedict was very tasteful and layered with flavor. I went right after opening, quite busy already. Get in, eat & get out, you can tell this place has a line

This spot is a cute brunch place. They had lovely Christmas decor for the holiday season. We put ourselves on the yelp waitlist for a party of 4 and it took about 15-20 minutes to get seated.

I ordered the chicken & waffles dish and it was so good! The waffles were light and crispy. It came with a chicken drumstick and a big chicken thigh. The chicken was moist and the skin was crispy. It was a big portion for me since I took the chicken thigh piece to-go. I also got their strawberry matcha latte and I loved it! It had the perfect amount of sweetness and matcha flavor.
Great brunch place a must go and will again soon. Quality food quick service excellent experience. Rustic country style look inside homestyle food inside can't go wrong.

I visited Four Chairs for New Years brunch and loved the food but the service was extremely slow.

Firstly, there is a decent amount of street parking available on the weekends which is nice and makes it more convenient since the wait can be quite long. We were a party of 6 and took about 30 mins to get seated.

I tried the chicken and waffles which was well balanced, had great texture and was a sizeable portion. Having said that, I do prefer the Lapisara and Cracked & Battered one more. I also tried the pancake which was ok - my one was a little dry and not as soft and fluffy as I was expecting. Lastly, I got their volcano coffee which I really enjoyed! Across the table, there were orders of the Benedict and Korean fried chicken which were also good.

The con was how slow the service was. Our food took 30 mins to arrive and we had to flag down waiters for the bill.

Overall, I recommend Four Chairs for a fun, tasty brunch in the area, but go with time in hand!

Service was super fast our food was out in no time. They have great choices in the menu and everything is tastyyy! Loveeee the crem brûlée French toast OMG! Ambiance was nice and modern. Music not too loud. I will say tho, the place is not that spacious and some tables are really close to each other which some people might find uncomfortable. Other than that, great place! Definitely going back

This is probably more of a 3.5 star review, 4 stars if the line wasn't so bad. This place is the brunch equivalent of karma farming. Seriously, if you're one of those people that likes to wait a long time for a meal, you're in luck. Best bet is to join the waitlist from Yelp BEFORE you head out the door on the weekend.

Regardless, the food is good, but nothing worth waiting for. I will say they have a 5-star presentation game, which you can tell from the crowd is the primary reason many people come here. When the menu says their drinks are "Instagrammable" ... just ewwww.

In the plus category, the pancakes were pretty damn good. Their eggs benedict were also cooked to perfection. The service is also excellent. The chipotle sauce needed more heat and substance to it. It just seemed a bit thin to me. The Korean fried chicken was good, but again, not worth a huge wait. If you can swing it, make a reservation for during the week and come on your own time.

Get the chicken and waffles here - they were amazing!! Came here and waited about 30 minutes for a table. I would definitely try the chicken and waffles again, the waffles were nice and crispy and the chicken was super crispy and the batter was perfect.

The Volcano coffee was a super fun drink. The ambience is fun, a great place for brunch but be prepared to wait.

I cannot praise this place enough!!
Hands-down one of the best brunch spots in the city.
It's not in the best area but it's worth making the trek.
The service is always prompt and polite, and the food comes out quickly.
We sampled a few different dishes, and each one was better than the last!
I love a good eggs benny, and Four Chairs has several to choose from. We tried the Nova Benny and the Chipotle Benny, and both were good but the Chipotle Benny was definitely my favourite! Perfectly poached eggs, great flavour, I could eat it every day. We also loved the Mascarpone Pancakes. A must have. Amazing.
We will be back again and again!

Came back on a Sunday morning and got seated right away. Keep in mind that this was on Christmas eve.

Food came out pretty quickly but thought the flavors didn't hit as good as they did the first time. Bumped that it's inconsistent.

Went on a rainy Saturday and had to wait for about an hour to get seated. Thought they could add a few more tables with the space they have. Aside from that, food was actually pretty good. Would come back to try more things from the menu!

Alright so plan ahead because there is a wait to get in. The online Yelp reservation system didn't work for us. We had to sign in on their tablet when we got there. We waited about 30ish mins or so before being seated. The interior is really cool-- modern with low lightning. It felt relaxed, yet somehow chaotic (due to how busy the restaurant is). It is slightly packed, but didn't feel uncomfortable. The wait staff were all nice and attentive.

Ok so the food is good! We got the KFC Benedict, lox omelette, and the pancakes to share. Everything was really good. The pancakes were sweet but not too sweet. They were super soft and fluffy. The KFC was really good. Lots of flavor and the crunch was outstanding. The lox omelette was good too. You can't go wrong with salmon. Oh and their fried potatoes were super crispy and well seasoned. We left pretty full. You definitely get a good amount of food.

Overall, I'd come back and try some of their other stuff. We had a great time here.

I reserved our seat through yelp
waitlist which was very convienent. Right when our group arrived our table was ready.

One thing for me was the tables were small for our party of 3 and we felt cramped with our meals on the table.
The butterfly lychee drink was very tasty and I wish it was refillable lol
I ordered the k chicken sandwich and man, I LOVED IT!!! It was so scrumptious with the right kind of kick of spicy. The Pancake wasn't my type of pancake I'll eat again. Tasted odd to my taste buds, that was my only leftover.
The ambience is nice and loved the space. Waitress and bus boy was kind and courteous.

This spot was worth the try. Service was nice and quick. I had the K-bomb Eggs Benedict and it was an 8/10. The chicken was super tender and flavorful. The eggs in my benny were cooked to perfection. The only thing I wasn't a huge fan of was the bread the eggs come on top of. The portions are generous as it comes with home fries and a side salad. The drinks were good! I had the Butterfly Lychee with soju and it was a nice touch to our lunch. It is a bit on the pricier side, but the experience was good overall.

Visited during lunch time on a Wednesday, so there wasn't much wait. We were seated immediately and our server was friendly. We ordered the volcano coffee and chocolate milk (specifically for Halloween) and it was good. Chocolate milk was right amount of sweetness and volcano coffee was spilling out like a volcano, good sweet treat. The Mascarpone pancake was fluffy and soft. The Southwest Scramble was flavorful and the potatoes were crispy. Definitely had better brunches but wouldn't mind coming back.

Finally came around to trying out this brunch spot in SF! We waited around 30- 40 minutes for a table of 7 which isn't terrible for our group size as walk-ins on a Saturday morning. Just a FYI, they don't take reservations on the weekends!

I ordered the Leafy Green Benedict & a strawberry lemonade. The potatoes were crispy and perfect. The Benedict was decent, just need a tad bit of salt. The lemonade was pretty tame in flavor but still refreshing. I would come back, maybe on a weekday, to try some of their other menu items as the menu was so vast and the other drinks looked so cute!

I enjoyed my time here at four chairs! Brunch is always a meal that I am interested to see how the establishment changes things up, since there's similar meals- omelette, Benedict's, pancakes, etc. but four chairs did a great job at adding their own flare. The k bomb Benny was so good. Flavor was on point and the chicken piece was large. I loved the egg for the Benedict. Can we also give a shoutout for the potato's?! Yum!

The lato plato was a lovely spin on an egg scramble but it had shrimp in it! You don't often see that around. The mascarpone pancake was light and fluffy. I didn't feel that heavy feeling after a plate of pancakes, which was perfect.

Lychee butterfly drink was apparently too sweet for my friends' tastes.

I would recommend a try at four chairs. It's located in the thick of mission district. Come a little before 11am on a Sunday and join the waitlist. Once it turned 11am the wait time tripled.

The food is amazing. Unfortunately, the wait was very long on a Friday morning. About an hour. The service once inside was not good, but there were only a few waitresses for the busy restaurant. The K-bomb Chicken Benny was my favorite thing. The Creme Brûlée French Toast was delicious. The Volcano Coffee was an amazing. The food was worth the wait, but the service could be better. I still recommend Four Chairs, but be ready to wait!

This place has some of the best food i've ever tried! The pancakes are perfect and the matcha is pretty good too. I booked a reservation here a few days before and had to wait 10 minutes to get sat. It gets pretty busy though.

solid brunch spot in the city! parking wasn't too hard to find, found some street parking in the neighborhood on a hill that was a ~5 minute walk to the restaurant. arrived around 11 am on a sunday and there was a ~45 minute wait. i had tried to get on the yelp waitlist in advance but it said the waitlist wasn't available. we waited outside and they conveniently had a menu (with photos!) taped to the window, so we were able to think about what we wanted to order.

we sat at a long table shared with other groups, but that didn't detract from the ambiance/overall experience too much. the drinks were really pretty and good - i got the strawberry lemonade. for food, i got the pacific sunrise which is a salmon benedict. it came with potatoes and a salad, and everything about it was solid. everyone in my group seemed to like their food as well. the sweet items looked really good but i don't have the biggest sweet tooth for brunch unfortunately.

would definitely come back if i was in the area!

Wonderful food. Service is quick but not rude at all, they just got famous and have a lot of people to get through. The atmosphere is so calming and very aesthetic. I would recommend going when they are about to open as I didn't know what time they opened so I got there early and still caught a line of people waiting for the restaurant to open.

Came here early Saturday morning via BART. We got sat right away and it already semi busy.

Since we don't often traverse the Mission District, we decided to try the creme brulee French toast, the K-Bomb benny and the mascarpone pancakes. For drinks I got the mango tango and the bf got house coffee. The mango tango is off their Instagramable drinks menu. So yes very Instagramable if you're trendy like that, but it was nothing to call home about. It's just how it's described a nice picture and some basic juice. I started with the benny and the chicken itself was amazing and the eggs was runny as they should be. The salad on the side was really just a negative space filler. I personally just picked at it. I would say the bread for the benny was a poor choice, too dense. The mascarpone pancakes were pretty good too. I really liked the mascarpones filling(?) /layer(?). It kept the pancakes moist and gave more flavor to pancakes. Nothing too special about the pancakes themselves. The creme brulee french toast can definitely be skipped. It was just a thick piece of under soaked bread with burnt/caramelized sugar on the top. Doesn't really break like a creme brulee.

Overall I enjoyed most of the food. The interior is very modern with a clean bathroom. Staff is friendly. It's SF priced food you could probably make just as good at home. It's a good one time try if in the area. Definitely wouldn't recommend if you don't live near the area or don't' like taking BART then walking several blocks through the Mission to get there. Street parking at your own risk. Definitely plan to get there early. We left about 10:30ish and the line was forming down the block.

Waited around 20 minutes on a Saturday, the waitlist moves pretty fast. Parking can be difficult but there's plenty of street parking. The food was really good, the Korean fried chicken had a tangy taste and the breading was tasty. Everyone around the table enjoyed their food and no one had complaints. The drinks were also good, and was very impressed by their mango matcha. The country fried potato's were also really good - not too salty and good amount of crunch! Would recommend.

K Bomb chicken Benedict 4/5 flavors were solid and size was good the potatoes or home fries were really really good but the Benedict was ok not very special
Crème brûlée French toast 4/5 good flavor needs more fruit or something else to balance
Volcano coffee 5/5 really strong solid coffee

Service and ambiance were good

The mascarpone pancakes were not good it was also a little small for the price. They tasted like pancakes that you made at home and the mascarpone tasted a little weird. The fruit was good!

The By The Bay was okay but probably wouldn't order it again. The Okonomiyaki fries were great 10/10 would order again.

I would say this place is over hyped and should really be 3.5 to 4 stars at most. Don't think I would eat here again.

Me, my friends, and cousin really loved this place and we honestly ate all of our food. Me and my cousin had the chicken apple plate with scramble eggs and it was really good. I enjoyed my drink also which was the Piña Coco drink which I enjoyed because it wasn't too sweet. My friends really liked their food and had a good time. The service was nice we waited about 30 mins for five of us on a Saturday afternoon which wasn't bad to be honest. The atmosphere was good and people were nice. It was all of our first time here at Four Tables and we would come back again

Grabbed some brunch on a Sunday morning, it was busy as it should be and was surprised that we were seated almost immediately for 3. There were lots of seating area and mingling people. The waitresses were very nice and tentative. Gave us a good amount of time to decide on what we wanted to order before checking in with us.

Online menu was legible and there were pictures to easily choose from. The food was good, my mom said she loved her Chipotle Benedict, my bf said his scramble was good as well. My chicken was good, a little on the saltier side alone but good balance with the sweet waffle. It was a bit battery than I liked but it was still good. The volcano coffee was perfect, took me back to lockdown when Dalgona Coffee was trending.

Busy on the weekends! Waited for about 45 minutes on a Saturday. Tables are very cramped and close together. Ordered the k bomb Benny and the creme brûlée French toast. The chicken was delicious - very flavorful and crispy. I loved the home fries - they were super crispy. I also really like the vinaigrette for the salad. Overall a really solid brunch spot.
great spot was super packed though and we had to decide to stay because it was busy and we had a jam packed day
Food was hot and delicious!! Drinks came out fast. Made a reservation and was seated right away! Busy brunch vibes!

We made resy for thurs brunch. Plenty of meter parkings. Volcano coffee was yummy. Sweet and strong. Mascarpone pancake was so small.
It was tasty and not too sweet.
K Bomb Benny ~ Korean fried chicken with cabbage on ciabatta bun. Delicious
Chicken sandwich was crispy, tender and juicy.
Service was great and attentive.
Spacious dining area.

Really good. Every dish was thoughtfully made. Drinks were ALL SO GOOD! Get the berries harvest salad, it has shrimp and berries, it was really good and portions were generous. Will keep coming back again and again
Delicious food! Service was quick and efficient. Definitely going back! My friends and I loved it here. The raspberry mimosa was delicious!

Food:
We got the matcha strawberry latte, thai iced tea, k-bomb benny and macapone pancake.
Matcha strawberry latte - nothing to really write home about, the strawberry flavor was a little too strong and matcha was pretty weak
Thai iced tea - Pretty good, a lot of condensed milk but too much ice
K-bomb benny - The benedict sauce on the eggs didnt really have a lot of flavor and the fried chicken was good but not really anything special. Potatos were nice and crispy but overall pretty mid.
Macapone pancakes - The pancakes were really good which is why I put a 4 star review. The cream wasnt too sweet and had a nice buttery taste that paired amazing with the pancakes, and the fresh fruit gave it a nice flavor kick.

Service and ambiance were pretty good, and the price is not too bad. Would come back for the pancakes.

We were walking around the area and this place caught our attention so we stopped by for food. The interior was very beautiful. We ordered quickly but our food did take a while to come out. They were busy and we were a large group so it's understandable. I ordered the French Toast. It had so much fresh fruit on top with a sprig of rosemary, which amped the flavor up. Not only was the meal delicious, but it looked so beautiful, like an art piece. Such a cute place!

There's a lot of brunch options in SF but this place consistently pops up when I was doing my research.

Place was busy on a Sunday. Long wait time but it was worth it. The place is small and a little cramped but staff were very efficient and organized. Our orders took a longer time to arrive so maybe consider that if you're in a rush

All our orders are tasty. The Southwest scramble is so so, nothing special. K bomb benny is unique, I didn't expect that korean chicken will pair well with eggs benedict. Also tried the volcano coffee, it's the usual Dalgona coffee, nothing special. But the star for me was the mascarpone pancake. The batter is soft and fluffy and the mascarpone topping is the perfect compliment! Definitely a must!

Food is really good, you can't go wrong or be disappointed with what ever you choose. Service is good, the servers are doing their best to accommodate everyone in this really busy place. Ambiance is nice and inviting, but did not really pay attention much cause I was busy eating my food and looking at other peoples order.

Went with a friend on Sunday for Brunch as we had been hearing about this place for a while. Parking around is difficult so wouldn't recommend driving. Got there around 11:45 and put my name on the waitlist and waited for around 45 minutes before we were seated. The tables are pretty crammed together inside.

As for the food, I ordered the fried chicken with waffles. The chicken was really moist and tender with the skin really crunchy. The sauce paired with the chicken was the star of this dish. However the waffle was really soggy and wasn't the best. My friend tested the mmm k-bomb benny. The fried chicken was really tasty and moist however she said the flavors were a bit strong. We also ordered the crème brûlée French toast which was tasty but nothing really special. The drinks were pretty tasty as we ordered the mango tango and butterfly lychee.

Overall enjoyed our food but didn't really wow us.

AMAZING FOOD, one of my favorite brunch places to go.
The waiting is kinda long but worth it.
Service and ambiance great
Highly recommend the chicken!
Great French toast and pancakes
Love this place

This is one of the best if not the best brunch spot in the Bay Area! Their food is so flavorful and just delicious!! The chicken and waffles are the best hands down. The mix of flavors on them is a perfect harmony of sweet, spicy and savory. I tried their seasonal Pina coco drink and it did not disappoint. It was refreshing and light. The macapone pancakes are such a treat! I think one of the best things I've ever had. We went around 2pm so service was so fast and efficient. I love this place and can go on and on about it but just do yourself a favor and go and enjoy! I promise you won't regret it.
