The ambiance was really nice inside and the service was really quick and friendly. I'm definitely interested in coming back and trying their dinner options!
Food was good and the ambiance is nice. Food has a little twist between American and Asian. Portions are small. The place itself is clean. Parking can be difficult, but you will find one eventually.

4.5 stars rounded up.

If the steady stream of customers coming in during our Thursday morning meal is any indication of the weekend crowd, best to visit on a weekday if you have the luxury; Four Chairs serves brunch (with a Korean flair) everyday (except Tuesdays when they're closed.)

We ordered:
-- volcano coffee ($7 + $1 up-charge for almond milk): much like the strong & sweet viral Dalgona coffee everyone was making during the pandemic.
-- k-bomb chicken benny ($20): didn't try but wish I had. My friend said the chicken was perfectly spicy.
-- chicken & waffles ($17): i ordered chicken breast instead of dark meat & a large, moist piece was coated in a crunchy, well-seasoned batter. Went so well with the spicy honey sauce. Fluffy, delicious waffle.

Bittersweet that I enjoyed my order so much because I'll be hesitant to try anything else next time I eat here! Looking forward to trying the Four Chairs Bacon that was unavailable when we came.

Friendly soft-spoken waiter.

Brunch Time ain't just for the weekends anymore, People.

Yes please! We were getting famished after doing some sight seeing in San Fran and I found Four Chairs on yelp.

This a very cute and quaint little restaurant tucked in between a few other shops and eateries! The waitresses aren't very conversational but not did we need them to be

We ordered the chicken and waffles with the southwest scramble. To drink we had the strawberry lemonade with added soju and the volcano coffee

Everything and I do mean everything was delicious! The fried chicken was cooked and seasoned to perfect and OMG the scramble was so refreshing and delicious. The portion sizes are very good too! The true star was the volcano coffee! It's a must try!

The staff can take a while to come around. So, if you see them wave them down. Otherwise it's a very good spot for breakfast or brunch!

Totally worth the wait--waitlist actually moved much faster than expected. Staff and ambience were lovely. Brunch was incredible...loved my Kinder Garden scramble, normally a meat-lover, I didn't miss having any since the mushrooms provided a robust flavor. The scramble was cooked perfectly, substituted toast with the freshest fruit bowl. Volcano coffee with oat milk was our waiter's suggestion....did not disappoint. It's a must-try. Although busy, we never felt hurried...truly great service and people!

Went with a friend on a rainy Saturday at around 11am and waited for about an hour! The service was great and attentive even with so many people.

-kbomb benny: 7.5/10 the chicken was sweet and savory and worked well with the eggs benedict. The chicken was crispy and tender, and it was on the saucier side but I didn't mind it.
-okonomiyaki fries: 8/10 the fries were crispy and the flavor was good! It the first dish to come out from our order and I think because my friend and I were starving, we devoured it.
-strawberry matcha latte: 7/10 the drink was so pretty!! I think it looks better than it tasted and I've had better matcha, especially in SF, but it was still nice and not too sweet.

This place was a nice spot to have brunch with a friend:) It was loud but we could still hear each other and make conversation.

It would be easier to come with a smaller party to avoid the long wait. The food is fun, especially for pictures.

The drinks are sweet but delicious. The plain coffee is just ok.

I like the salad the best. The burger has too much sauce. Everything else is good.

Big portions, perfect to mix and match to share as a group. The dining room has a nice decor and space out away from tables to tables.

It is a fun place to come for a relaxed weekend brunch.
Order away! You can't go wrong with anything on the menu. Four Chairs is not shy about its bacon. Most of the dishes come with thick-cut sweet flavored bacon.

overall experience : would definitely come again! amazing service and great ambiance. food was delicious as well as the drinks. came for lunch on a monday and no wait at all!

food :
- chicken and waffles 9/10 : waffles were perfectly airy. combination of the salted butter and syrup was amazing as a person who prefers savory dishes it was not too sweet. the chicken was really crunchy but batter was a little too thick for my liking. overall it was lightly salted and paired with a spicy garlic flavored sauce that made for a great option.

- okonomiyaki fries 10/10 : fries were perfectly crispy with a generous amount of flakes on top. the salty flavor of the flakes and the creamy mayo added great flavor to the fries.

- k bomb chicken benny 9/10 : chicken was perfectly cooked. super crispy with a savory spicy sauce. the eggs benedict had a perfectly soft boiled egg with a citrusy sauce on ciabatta.

drinks :
- matcha latte 7/10 : not the best matcha latte but had great matcha flavor and lightly sweetened

- volcano coffee 9/10 : tasted really good and creamy but it was initially hard to mix in with the cup that they used. flavor was on point.

Eh personally felt the place we really gimmicky and not worth the line for mediocre food. First, we came on a Saturday lunch time and waited for about 30 minutes. You get 90 minutes in the restaurant and they're really strict (the table beside us got essentially kicked out after they paid because people were waiting and they were just sitting there chatting). The service is slow but that's because the dining room is packed up the brim with as many tables as they can reasonably fit. I had the French toast, which was ok. The husband had the Korean fried chicken Benedict, which was also ok. I dunno, I guess the food is aesthetically pleasing if not particularly outstanding?

Great place to grab some brunch and catch up with friends! I came here on a Saturday at around 10am, and there wasn't too much of a wait. I had a party of 6, and because we couldn't get seated until the whole party arrived, we put our name down on the Yelp waitlist. Once my whole party arrived, we were seated immediately! I got the By the Bay Benedict, and it was super delicious. It had the right amount of mushrooms and shrimp on the toast, and the potatoes and salad were great as well. The service was friendly, quick, and efficient! By the time we finished up, there was a longer wait, so definitely come by early if you want to avoid the crowds! Overall, great place in the outer Mission to grab some brunch!

Came here on the weekend for brunch and the wait wasn't too bad. The wait was 30 mins which was really good for brunch on the weekend. It was pretty easy finding parking as well.

One main thing to call out was that this place does not have AC and it was super hot inside the restaurant which made a not so good experience. The food looked really nice and picture worthy but I wouldn't say it was the best. Out of all the dishes I would say the fries were the best. All around it was a okay experience and definitely a very aesthetic spot for brunch :)
Delicious bites and cozy vibes at Four Chairs! The perfect spot for comfort food with a twist.
The hype delivered. Excellent friendly service, beautiful food, delicious drinks and clean ambiance and atmosphere

What a lovely brunch spot! I don't usually venture out to this area for brunch, and I was given a wonderful surprise with this meal! I came with 2 girlfriends and we ordered a Benedict, scramble, omelette, French toast, and waffle. The star of the brunch was definitely the waffle, it was lightly crispy and so soft on the inside! We almost ordered another round, but decided to restrain ourselves. I would recommend getting on the yelp waitlist before showing up, they are quite busy for being tucked away in southern part of Mission. All in all, a great brunch spot with all the staples and worthy of a visit!

I went to Four Chairs with some friends for brunch on a weekday, and the place was packed. We tried making a reservation over the phone, but they said they only take walk-ins.
The restaurant is surprisingly quite bigger than we expected. The atmosphere was very lively. The big lights hanging from the ceiling illuminated the entire restaurant. The modern decor went really well with their innovative American breakfast and brunch menu. Most of the dishes that we ordered were very vibrant and colorful. In fact, they have an Instagram worthy drinks section on their menu.
Our table ordered :
1. Butterfly lychee
2. Mango Tango
3. Citrus French toast
4. Nova Benny
5. Kinder garden
6. Side of turkey and 2 eggs

Both the drinks (butterfly lychee and mango tango) had the right flavors, but they were super sweet. They almost tasted like a syrup water. I will probably try a different drink next time. While we were seated, we saw a lot of folks order volcano coffee, so maybe I'll get that next time. Nova Benny was phenomenal. The capers added the right saltiness. Hollandaise sauce was smooth and creamy. The only small complaint I have is that the bread was not as good. It was very hard to cut through. Potatoes were cooked well. My friend said that the kinder garden was lacking in flavors. Citrus French toast was really good. It's a filling dish in and itself. It comes with a lot of varieties of fruits, which was a nice little touch.
Each table has a 90-minute dining window, as mentioned on their menu. Though I'm not sure if they enforce it. Our servers were very attentive. Overall, it was a good dining experience.

A solid brunch spot!! Ambiance is great it's seems to get really busy. Def come early, we came in on Friday morning around 11 and got seated right away!
Ordered the southwest scramble which was super flavorful and the mascarpone pancakes was delectable!
I also really enjoyed the strawberry matcha lattes!
Presentation was truly on point
Glad I got to check this place out!

The food and drinks were so so so good! Very brunch-y place. The mascarpone pancakes were fluffy and the mascarpone was very rich. I also got a volcano coffee, and the texture and flavor was amazing. Got there at 11:30 on Sunday for a party of 5 and put our name on the waitlist, we didn't wait for long, but we directly basically asked to leave after less than an hour since the line was so long.

Came here with friends on a Saturday around 11:30am and it was around a 30 min wait. The interior looked very nice inside, however, they do not have AC, so it can get a bit warm in there in a hot day.

The server was very friendly. We ordered our drinks first, my friends ordered strawberry lemonade and orange juice and I ordered the butterfly lychee. My friends and I thought the drinks were aesthetically pleasing and tasty.

As for food, we ordered scrambled eggs, eggs Benedict, fries and an omelette. I was pretty disappointed with my scrambled eggs, they came out a bit watery... not sure if it's supposed to be like that but it wasn't that good. I've definitely had better scrambled eggs elsewhere. I asked my friends about their opinion on the food and they agreed the food was just alright. But the drinks and fries were delicious!
super busy, but the yelp waitlist was winnable. service was solid but the food was nothing too spectacular...overall a rlly pretty brunch, nice visuals but low on yumminess and affordability
We had a great brunch at Four Chairs - well worth the wait. From the drinks to the food to the service, we couldn't have been happier.

We went right at opening hours on a Sunday with four adults and a toddler and they were so incredibly thoughtful with meeting the toddlers needs with a highchair, cup and plate. As a mom, this is work 5+ stars. All the food items were so yummy and well thought out and just like the photos on their digital menu. 10/10 experience.

We Liked the waffles. potatoes are very good.

Restroom facility needs improvement. Needs to be made cleaner. Has a strong urine smell in the men's bathroom.

I've been meaning to try this place since they've opened.
Avoided the crowd and got there 30 minutes after opening. When my food came out, there was a line to be seated.
There are only 2 servers and a busses so water, straw, food, and drinks you get the point to a little longer than expected.
Food is really good and fresh fruits and coffee they even have crushed ice.
I'll come back just not starving. If I'm not mistaken, they don't serve pork major plus.

I waited an hour and a half and I'd do it again but hope I don't have to (reservation me please). Great food, good service, my only complaint is it's a little cramped but that's SF push as many seats and tables in as you can
I ordered the BLTA with salad and they added the salad dressing inside the box which made the bread extremely soggy. When you order to go you separate that. Fuckin idiots.
Great food in a nonsense setting with fast and polite service for a fair price at Four Chairs has drawn me back several times since discovered It.

Cozy environment! Great service! The food was amazing and just right! Highly recommended for brunch just be aware of busier times. Try to reserve during the week days or get early on weekends. We got there 10:30am, and waited for 5 minutes. 20 minutes later, it was crazy.

The food here was pretty but pricy. We had chicken and waffles noodles. And the french toast. All tasted good. Nice place ton treat yourself to a brunch. Good party environment but hard to hear if the place gets too crowded. The service is ok but not super fast so you can relax and enjoy your meal. There was a bit of a wait on the weekend so plan on waiting during the weekends for brunch. .

Once I was seated the service was quick by the waitresses to take our drinks and food orders. The food was great! They had different options. We tried the mango tango and cranberry cocktail which were good. The mango tango was a tad sweet wit. The mango syrup but would definitely order it again. We ordered the K bowl chicken which was flavorful. It had a little kick with the siracha mayo that I loved. We also tried the chicken sandwich, the chorizo egg Benedicts, and crème brûlée French toast. No complaints there. I would definitely come back when I'm in the area again. The location was a little tough for parking but the place itself was cozy and small inside.

From the moment you step inside, you're greeted by warm, attentive service and a genuine neighborhood vibe that only enhances the meal. The staff is friendly, fast, and welcoming--even when the place is buzzing, the warmth shines through
The restaurant itself is not too fancy, but the food is awesome! It was quick and easy to order. Our food came out right away and it was all yummy.

Simply fascinating! I'm one of those who practices "intermittent fasting" and skips breakfast, and of course, brunch too. So, I need a good excuse to have breakfast or brunch. My best friend invited me to this restaurant, and everything is truly delicious! The service is fantastic; the team works hard and is very friendly.

I loved the drinks because they are super colorful and delicious.

I'll be back with a couple more friends! Thanks a lot.

Pull up a CHAIR and take a seat with me at Four Chairs , one of the most underrated hidden gems for brunch in San Francisco!

Brunch is definitely my favorite meal of the day, and I was so stoked to finally check out Four Chairs , which is located in the Mission District of San Francisco. They specialize in Thai-inspired brunch, curating beautifully prepared brunch and dinner dishes that emphasize the fusion of elements of both Thai and American cuisine. Here's what I tried:

Nova Benny: a perfectly poached egg, fresh smoked salmon, cream cheese, red onion, capers, and Meyer lemon hollandaise on an English muffin, served with potatoes and baby arugula salad.

chicken and waffle: two pieces of perfectly fried chicken (I mean look at that thick crust and juicy tender white meat inside) served with waffles, maple syrup, and this yummy Thai dipping sauce!

French toast: perfectly flaky and tender French toast, served with citrus, fresh berries, whipped butter, and maple syrup.

I was honestly SO blown away with the beautiful presentation and unique flavors of each dish, and I love how everything on their menu is so affordable and reasonably priced, especially for San Francisco. I also heard that they have an incredible dinner menu, and I definitely can't wait to be back to feast again. Definitely make sure to check them out if you're in the area, and support a small, local, and Asian-owned business!
Excellent food, service, and atmosphere. Had the K Bomb Benny and Volcano coffee based off reviews and they didn't disappoint!
The food here is so good and so is their thai tea. My personal favorite is the creme brulee french toast. There can be a bit of a wait though, and the spacing inside could have been done better.

Celebrated my cousins birthday here on an early Saturday morning. The inside was nice.
Everything I ordered was tasty I'd say. I would definitely come back to try other things on the menu. The French toast was really yummy! Everything was plated nicely and appealing. Cons is the time limit. The servers really rushed us. We were a party of 8. Understandable because it gets busy and the place is a little small.

I went here for brunch with a friend the other day. There was a long wait, but that's relatively normal for a popular brunch spot on a Saturday afternoon. The service was good. The food was average. We got the k bomb Benedict and the chicken + waffles as well as a strawberry matcha latte and a volcano coffee. Everything came out quickly! Food tasted fine, but nothing was that memorable.

Stumbled upon this place by accident while running errands in the area and it was a pretty nice find!

It's a trendy looking brunch place, but without the over-hyped long waits (at least for now!) They actually have a nice looking dinner menu as well which I might have to try next time.

We split the chicken and waffles, the four chairs benny, and a side of french toast (I couldn't help myself after seeing some pictures and just wanted to try it)

I liked how crunchy the fried chicken was, and although it could've been a little juicier, I think the satisfying crunch of the batter made up for it. The waffle was pretty crispy too! It came with both syrup and this sweet and spicy sauce, but I mostly just used the syrup.

The four chairs benny was like a normal benedict, but instead of canadian bacon it's served with their four chairs bacon, which is this extremely thick cut candied bacon. It was very tasty but kind of hard to cut through and chew because of how thick and fatty it was. It was a hefty price mark up for the bacon too so I'm not sure I would get it next time, although I'm glad I tried it. I will say I really enjoyed the meyer lemon in the hollandaise, it added a nice zest to the creamy decadent sauce. The potatoes were nice and crisp and very solid brunch potatoes.

I do think the side of french toast was probably the most disappointing. I couldn't help myself after seeing some pictures and ordered it in a moment of weakness, but it definitely looked better in pictures than it actually tasted. There was a nice orange flavor to it, but I think the bread was a little stale. I know stale bread is generally what you want to use for french toast, but I think it probably did not soak enough custard before being cooked, so the end french toast wasn't super fluffy but instead a little dense and chewy, almost dry.

Overall, it's a pretty cute place that I would definitely recommend checking out if you're on the hunt for a new brunch spot to try.

Four chairs is such a cute place to take your mom dad ir family here or just a cute date with your partner or friends I love the mimosas and the strawberry lemonade it was so good the waffles was really good but the chicken I didn't like the skin the meat was juicy I would definitely come back I just wouldn't get chicken but I really enjoyed everything else !

Service was great and wait time wasn't too bad considering we rolled in on a Saturday early afternoon. Food was honestly just okay; the brûlée French toast was really dry and upon cutting into it, you can tell it wasn't soaked in the egg/cream mixture. Kid's pancake was dry but the grilled cheese sandwich was good according to my older one. Husband had the fried chicken sandwich and it was decent but nothing to rave about. Pricing was not outrageous considering we're in the city. Definitely more of an Instagram-esque establishment.

I got the k chicken Benny and the chicken was delicious! the eggs Benedict on the other hand was very lemony which I didn't expect. I didn't like how the lemon overpowered the meal, but at least the chicken and salad were yummy.

My friends and I came on a Monday for brunch with a reservation, super excited to try the food at four chairs! We took a while to get seated and despite mentioning the reservation the server spoke over us when I told her my name and party size and just sat us. No problem-- but the reservation was kind of pointless and if there was a wait, we would not have gotten seated before the other walk in parties. It was very slow to get our order taken, drinks out, bill charged etc, but food was out fairly quickly.

The food was ok. We shared a mascarpone pancake for the table, got a couple of Benedict's and a scramble and while it was all fairly good it wasn't spectacular. My chipotle Benedict and whatever meat is on there was SO cold. Potatoes were good.

Overall, the food is cute and dining room is large, but taste and service have a lot of room for improvement. If youre looking for an instagram-y spot this is your place! But the dining experience was less than desirable and I would not come back. Our brunch took 3 hours to get through and we had to flag down a server for every request. A little grace-- there were only 2-3 servers for the entire dining room, so they were busy, but seeing tables seated after us get their drinks and food out before we ordered anything was not great.

Yeah so this meal BUSSED!!!!! If you can't already tell by the pictures this meal os gorgeous and delicious girlllll. The meat was so flavorful and paired with the eggs and patatos it was soooooo good. The coffee was also really good, my friend had the taller glass and it was really strong for me, I had the matcha mango and the mango chunk puree was so yummy! The restaurant itself is cute too!

My favorite was the French toast! The presentation was extremely nice and the cream and honey added the perfect sweetness to the toast! The egg benedict also tasted great and they gave a large piece of bacon that didn't have too much fat! The truffle omelet tasted like any other omelet but I wish it had more of a truffle taste. Overall, I highly recommend this cute little brunch place! DEFINITELY try their lychee drink!

For more food recs, check out my ig: @deez_noms

This place must still be a little lowkey on everyone's radar because I could not believe that we didn't have to wait for a table on a weekend morning! New spot with nice dining area that almost looks like it's suited to host intimate dinners. Food here was overall delicious with good value for brunch!

Truffle Omelet: 3/5 and one star off because I feel like the truffle taste could've been more present, it kind of just felt like a normal egg omelette. That said, texture and accompanying sides were on point.

Mascarpone Pancake: the real star of the show - delicious. So delicious. Sweet, fluffy, and how you'd hope everyone pancake to taste in your life.

Okonomiyaki Fries: simple but tasty. Slightly overpriced ($10) but gets a pass because I haven't seen anyone do this for brunch yet. And for what it's worth it was pretty tasty and I appreciate the uniqueness.

My family and I enjoyed their brunch.

We had chicken and waffles, Chipotle benedict, and Nova Omelet.

All were great, but I enjoyed the chicken and waffles the most.

They have a Yelp waitlist and will only seat you when everyone is here.

This place is great brunch spot. My girl and I stopped by for a quick bite. There was a bit of a wait after we had put ourselves down on the waitlist. We waited around 10-15 minutes. The place was packed in a good way with a very active and fun vibe. We ordered the chicken and waffles as well as the homie home fries. The chicken and waffles hit the spot and totally satisfied my craving. It also came with this side sauce that was pretty delicious. The only thing I wasn't the biggest fan of was that there was a lot of breading on the chicken but at least it was all crispy. The homie home fries were nice and crispy. All they needed was a bit of salt but other than that my girl and I really enjoyed them. Overall this a great spot to grab lunch/brunch for a reasonable price. Will definitely be back.

Overall Score: 8.4/10
The service was incredibly quick and efficient while the food was so yummy. The matcha has a bit too much strawberry puree for me but still very good.

I came to Four Chairs for brunch with a couple of girl friends. We arrived at 10:30 and were seated immediately. There seems to be a bit of a wait if you arrive after 11am, so plan ahead.

The food was delicious! My friends ordered an eggs Benedict with chorizo and an apple sausage scramble. I ordered a Kinder Garden scramble and absolutely loved it! The eggs were perfectly soft and the potatoes were crispy and firm. The food wasn't greasy, which was a huge plus. My friend also commented on how perfect the hollandaise was on her eggs Benedict, as it was not too heavy.

We topped off our meal with the mascarpone pancakes! The aesthetic made your eyes drool and mouth water. To top it off, they also tasted splendid! The mascarpone filling was not overly sweet allowing you to blend in your pieces of fruit and savor those along with the rest of the pancake.

5/1/22 Sunday

Friendly staff. I arrived here at 11:15 am, but once 12:30 hit, it was packed. I like they have one eight-person table and a few six people tables--a fun, classy environment for group breakfast.

Love the plating. I recommend the volcano coffee, it's a cold blended coffee drink with a lot of milk.

Order quickly when it gets packed or you won't get it in, timely.

Great vibes and great brunch!

I've been wanting to go here for awhile as it's been on my brunch list for SF. The servers were super friendly and efficient and here's everything we ordered:

Volcano coffee: 8/10, delicious, it was very reminiscent of the dalgona whipped coffee trend back during covid days of 2020. The drink itself wasn't super strong and had a light and creamy taste to it.

Butterfly lychee drink: 9/10 delicious!! So refreshing and tasted like a lychee calpico with an added oomph. We really enjoyed this and it was very refreshing.

Mascarpone souffle pancake: 10/10, AMAZING. I would come back solely for these pancakes. The creamy mascarpone is sandwiched in between each layer of the fluffy pancakes and each bite was so fluffy and delectable. It also was fairly light for a pancake and I didn't feel groggy or heavy after this at all.

Chipotle benedict: 7/10, The home fries it came with were crispy and fresh, and the benedict had the perfect runny yolk. I do wish it came with a different meat though since the chorizo didn't stay on the benedict that well and it would have a more satisfying bite with a full piece of meat.

Chicken apple sausage scramble: 7.5/10, solid scramble, sausage was juicy and had a nice bite.

Overall solid brunch place and great vibes.

Eggs Benedict: we ordered the leafy Benedict and the salmon egg Benedict 'nova benny'. It was plated beautifully. The eggs were runny, the hollandaise sauce was great, but its color was just a little pale. Good quality salmon. The dressing on the side salad was super delicious whoever made this bravo the potatoes were flavorful too but a bit oily for my taste.

From the kids menu, I ordered the turkey ham and grilled cheese sandwich and my daughter loved it.

Mango tango drink and french orange juice were good!

The service:
Was great! They even brought plate and a cup for my kid right away that made her so happy.

Ambiance
Was nice and even though it was crowded it wasn't noisy.

Also the kitchen looked sooooo clean and organized.

Tasty, Large Portions, Great Service. 4.5/5

We decided to get brunch here at 1pm on a Saturday. Highly recommend joining the waitlist as this place can get packed. For reference, we reserved a table for 2 ~20 mins prior to arrival and were seated promptly.

FOOD
- Chicken and Waffle: 10/10
The chicken was juicy and crispy & the waffle had crunchy bits which added a nice texture. The dish came with a side of syrup and sweet chili sauce which tied everything together.

- Kbomb Benny: 9.5/10
This dish looks spicy, however, it was not that spicy at all(I don't have a great spice tolerance)! It was more sweet than spicy. The chicken was sooo flavorful and the salad added a nice refreshing touch. My only critique is that the potatoes were quite lackluster and dry.

- Butterfly Lychee: 6/10
The drink was aesthetic and definitely tasted like lychee but it was just too sweet. I think the drink would be great with less sugar and more lychee bits to bring out the natural sweetness.


SERVICE
- Despite being busy, the waiters were attentive and checked in on us. Quick and great service!


PARKING
- Might be difficult to find free parking but there were plenty of metered parking spots ($1/hour) in the area.

This place is smaller than I expected, but the service was great and fast! We only waited about 20 minutes on a Saturday afternoon. It was so cute inside and felt like a little cafe.

The food came out pretty fast and we got the Chipotle Benedict, Okonomiyaki Fries and Butterfly Lychee. The bacon was so amazing! The fries were pretty standard and simple, kind of overpriced. The chipotle Benedict looked so good and tasted good as well. The real winner for me were bacon and butterfly lychee drink. It tasted just as good as it looked!

The food was great and the service was nice.

The Ambiance was okay but noisy.

Nice brunch spot.


The wait line is always long.

We came around 2pm for brunch.
It wasn't busy at all.
Service was friendly.
The food was ok. I got an omelette of some kind.
It seemed like something I would make.
I'm not sure if I would come back.
The neighborhood has difficult parking.

Nothing I love more than Asian food than brunch and this place is the perfect crossover episode. I love an eggs benny (my go to) but the chipotle took a bit away from the hollandaise for me here. Mascarpone pancakes were not only aesthetically pleasing but fluffy and delicious for all you sweet lovers. While the drinks looked so instagrammable they were quite average but nice to sip on, nonetheless. Food takes a bit of time to come out so I'd look out for that if you're ravenous and you come here on a weekend (maybe bring a deck of cards) Otherwise, super cute spot!

I really wanted to like this place more because the pictures look so yummy. Brunch is one of my favorite thing so I was dissatisfied. I went on a Thursday and the service was good. They were quick to sit us and get our order.

Okonomiyaki fries 4/5, I'm a big fan of okonomiyaki sauce and it paired well with the fries. I wish there was more sauce and less Bonita flakes. Definitely good to try once. FYI, best to get this with a big group of people like 4 or more. They give a generous amount.

Mascarpone pancake 3/5, I have to say these were very dry. I struggled to cut the pancake with my knife and as I was cutting it the top and middle pancake were slipping and falling apart. I have tried many mascarpone pancakes and these were not it. It's just regular dry pancakes with mascarpone cream. It felt more like a dorayaki.

K-bomb chicken sandwich 3/5, I really wanted to like this but the Korean fried chicken lacked flavor and it was dry. It was missing a little kick that you normally get from other Korean friend chicken spots. The cole slaw that comes with the sandwich needed more seasoning.

My overall impression for the place is the food is missing flavor.

Chicken ratio to the rest of the things was a little off. The pancakes were beautiful! Just wish they tasted a little bit more like pancakes. Crème brûlée smelled and tasted amazing! Definitely overhyped but the presentation of everything was great

Brunch review. I walked from 24th street Bart. They turned off Yelp waitlist. You check in on the kiosk when your arrive with your party. My party of 4. Service was fast, food is good for Instagram as for taste ..its mid. Not bad. Will I come back, no.

This place was on my to-try list and it satisfied my brunch cravings!

PROS:
Very fast and attentive service!
Basic Brunch Spot

CONS:
Can get very loud
Everything was a lot sweeter than expected.

I loved the ambiance and how tables were set up. We ordered a mimosa, the citrus french toast, and the K-bomb benny. The k-bomb was not my favorite and somehow VERY sweet, sweeter than the syrup on the french toast. The Benny was half over-cooked and the pairings for this dish did not mesh well together. The french toast was perfectly cooked and I enjoyed the ample amount of fruit.

One of the best brunches I've had in a while.

The food has an Asian influence, and we all loved it. It wasn't overdone, or a miss, and all the food hit just right. Next time, I'd love to try the drinks!

The atmosphere inside is cute and trendy! And the service was good but sometimes you have to wave them down. The food came at a pretty good pace!

Our favorites were the Korean fried chicken eggs Benedict!

We lucked out. I made reservations for Friday at 10:20 a.m. the day before. We were greeted by a friendly smile and was seated at a table that had a reservation sign on it. Wow! I noticed the restaurant was packed as the noise level was of happy patrons. The hospitality and service - WARM and CHARMING. Great! The menu selection - SUPER! We sat next to a couple that ate here before. "You gotta try the lychee drink. It's delicious." Not only was it delicious, it was an absolutely beautiful PURPLE drink! My BF ordered the creme brûlée French toast and I had the fried chicken and waffle. We definitely will be back as we were very satisfied with what we had for brunch. We felt the prices were very reasonable for what you got. No price gouging here. It's worth every penny. We'll need TWO CHAIRS for our return!

We had a 30ish minute wait when we arrived. It gets pretty busy during brunch time, so arrive early! Once inside, the vibe was great and enjoyable. We scanned the QR code for the menu (although I'm kinda old fashioned & prefer a physical menu). The waiter was nice and friendly :)

One dish you definitely have to try is the K-Bomb Chicken Benny. The chicken has a nice crunch, texture, and flavor, giving a unique touch to it. Another great dish is the Mascarpone Pancake. These pancakes are light and fluffy, and they're not too sweet, which I enjoyed.

Overall, Four Chairs is a fantastic place for brunch. With delicious dishes like the K-Bomb Chicken Benny and Mascarpone Pancakes, it's definitely worth a visit. I'll be coming back for sure!

What an awesome lil gem of a brunch spot!

Apparently they were having a soft opening. They have a pretty cool wood-forward aesthetic. Minimal, but clean. One large dining table really caught my eye with the decorative flowers as a center piece. Their light fixtures are super sick too.

Onto the drinks, beer is beer (that's right, I said it! Lol) but the volcano coffee is pretty good. Heavy and rich, but tasty. Not lactose intolerant friendly tho! Reminds me of what pandemic coffee drink Dalgona coffee.

Onto the food, FOUR CHAIRS BENNY! WOW! Thick cut bacon and the Meyer lemons Hollandaise sauce are the mvp's of the dish. Oh and the cherry tomatoes get an honorable mention too. The salad and potatoes are fine, but oof. As a self proclaimed Benny aficionado, this one was delicious.

Totally totally totally look forward to coming back here. Thanks for the great experience!

Large portion, quick service, and liked the idea of fusion brunch style. Got the Korean chicken but it was a bit too saucy and heavy for my taste for brunch. Glad I tried it, but might opt for a different option next time.

when I saw this place, I was like I have to go there. We did have to wait like 30 minutes, but that's because the place was crowded. The staff were really nice. The food looks like how it does in the pictures and it taste amazing next time I go I think I'm gonna get the pancakes. The place is like really beautiful on the inside. It's a great to take pictures and the food is so pretty looking that it's perfect to take your pictures for your Instagram or whatever.

I hate to give this tip away because places like this will be even more crowded, but one way to know a place is good is if it averages 4.5 stars on Yelp. A 4-star average can be hit-or-miss but 4.5 is practically guaranteed to be great. That being the case, I expected this place would be great based on the average rating alone, and I was not disappointed. It was an absolutely excellent meal. Everything was just about perfect. Portions were very generous too. 2 entrees and one side could comfortably feed 3 people. If I have only one complaint it's that I think things should be served on separate plates (I don't mind different food touching, but the plate was so packed that a few things inevitably fell off the plate) and the tables for 2 should be a little bigger. Negligible complaints considering how great the food is.

I went with a friend this time but as someone who likes to dine solo often, I wish they had half-portions so I could sample everything pictured again. It was a very well-balanced meal split between two people, but if I'd come back solo I'd definitely be overwhelmed and not get to try as much as I did this time. RESTAURANT OWNER, IF YOU SEE THIS, PLEASE ADD AN OPTION FOR HALF-PORTIONS.

The food was good but I knocked down 1 star because it was too loud and I felt like there weren't many beverage options that stand out.

Overall the service was fast and it was a great brunch experience. We were able to get seated right away without a reservation (which they do not do on weekends).

Stopped by Four Chairs for brunch upon a recommendation from Tiktok that featured their k-bomb chicken sandwich and mascarpone pancakes that looked so delicious.
I was thankful I came on a weekday during the hours people are at work. I would assume this place may be packed usually. I placed a reservation and end up missing it but my group of 3 (including myself) were able to be seated without a long wait.
Even though the waitress had on her mask I could tell she was all smiles and cheerful.
My group and I were drooling over the menu. It was so hard to choose what to eat. And we really liked that the menu was kosher friendly! My aunt said it's a kosher eater's dream! We ordered the citrus French toast with a side of chicken sausage, chicken and waffles, and the k-bomb chicken sandwich. My mom loved the sweet and sour sauce that came with the chicken and waffles meal. My aunt said the k-bomb chicken sandwich was garlicky (which she liked), spicy, and tender. It reminded her of a Nashville spicy chicken sandwich but not as spicy. My mom and her both agreed that the pickles were a great touch to the sandwich. As for me, the citrus French toast was so satisfying. It had a light strip and fresh fruits . For drinks we ordered the butterfly lychee and the volcano coffee. All good! I really loved my eating experience at Four Chairs. Thank you.

I've been on a streak of okay / mildly disappointing visits to hyped restaurants (4.5+ rating) in SF that have turned up to be...just okay. And unfortunately, Four Chairs was another one of these. Perhaps we got the wrong items?

Came here after a morning in Glen Canyon Park and was surprised at how packed it was at 11.30am. Thankfully the Yelp Waitlist made it easy for us to join. The entrees here are a really good size, and also pretty good value compared to other places in the city, so they've got that going for it!

We got the Korean Fried Chicken Sandwich and Nova Benedict to share.

FYI, the sandwich is MASSIVE. Definitely plenty even as a shareable entree. Unfortunately the spicy / sweet sauce was just ok, the juicy chicken thigh patty made up for it but the gochujang flavor (guessing that's what they were going for) didn't quite come through. Would get again, just don't think of it as a Korean sandwich!

Nova Benny was pretty standard, we did like the light and tangy hollandaise, and the side salad was a nice and much needed balance to the sandwich (which we mistakenly got a side of fries with).

Overall, I'd come back if I happened to be in the neighborhood. But I don't live too close...so probably wouldn't make a special trip!

Brunch: I waited over 25 mins for my food to arrive. Other tables that sat and ordered after us got their food before us. Our food was not hot.

I was celebrating my girlfriend's birthday and was not pleased with my experience.

The food was good but my order was lukewarm.

For the gram, not your gut. Everything looked pretty, and the drinks were good, but the food tasted incredibly mid, and we would have been better off going to a local diner. Service was also mid, except for the amazing man who was busing the tables--he was such a joy! It hurts to write this review because we love to support local businesses, but it's definitely giving that they either struggled to maintain quality as they scaled or the menu has always looked better than it tasted.

Food was absolutely delicious, beautifully plated, with large portions. Tasteful, clean interior.

Full house at 12-1pm- recommend going either early or later in service hours. The wait isn't too long at ~30m and the waitstaff/kitchen are on top of their game but with the close seating, the atmosphere will be a lot less hectic

I went earlier this year and this is probably the best breakfast place I've ever been to! The food was amazing, and the price might seem high but for the amount that you get is worth it. I had the pancakes which were so delicious, they are like nothing I've had before. My boyfriend and sister had the chicken and waffles. The waffles were huge and the chicken was like Gordan Ramsey Popeyes! The volcano coffee was great! We had to take some to go afterwards. The service was top tier, always checking up on you. It does take some time for the food to be served but it always super busy due to how good this place is so I don't mind. The place itself is dark but cozy and simple, personally I love the decor. I can go on about this place for a while. Overall, this place is amazing. 100/10!!

Waited over 40 mins to get our food. It was a 3 day weekend but I honestly don't think it's worth the wait. It's all for Instagram. Waiting for the table and food took almost 1 hour. The presentation of the food and drinks are amazing the food is as well. I love what I order but for the price and time wasted I probably would've went somewhere else. It's definitely good to try it out if it's your first time avoid weekend. The restaurant is spacious but the tables are extremely close together which I personally think they should just make it a bit wider. The table next to us was just too close by.

Wow! YOU NEED to come here. I'm in the area for my birthday celebration week & came across this spot on Tik tok. I love hanging out in the mission district so this was a perfect fit for my plans. Also the HOME FRIES ARE AMAZING. The prices are also reasonable especially for the quality! We were seated right away and had a great experience. Its busy so lots of movement in here + guests come in casual clothing so if that's your vibe then this is the place!!

Gave 4 stars because the pancakes weren't as warm as I wanted them to be, but other than that it was great

After looking up good breakfast places we decided to give this place a shot. Food was great. The pancakes were delicious just needed to be more warm. The chorizo eggs Benedict were super good and the house potatoes were .
Check this place out.
The drinks taste good and look so pretty. The food was good. They seem to be always busy. The staff worked hard to clean the tables and have people seated as soon as possible.

snag a reservation or come early, if you can! we arrived ~12pm on a sunday and it was about a 45 minute wait for a party of three. by the time we were seated, the wait time grew to an hour (at the very least).

it is pretty cramped in there - tables are small yet very close together, so you can practically hear the other party's conversations. menu is available via QR code & they provide complimentary water! after ordering, it took ~10 mins for drinks and food to arrive.

to drink, i had the mango tango - it was nice, not too sweet. it seems like a big portion but the glass is full of mostly ice. i also had ordered the nova benedict - i may have had too high of hopes for this, but i don't think it was anything special. but pleasing to the eye? yes!

both of my friends loved their drinks and plates, however! the mimosa was stronger than your average. i'm sure i'll be back, and will definitely try something else on the menu. though the food is good, i'm not sure if it's worth that long of a wait.

I've been to Four Chairs twice now for breakfast, and both times were absolutely lovely! It's a small, cozy spot with a warm and welcoming atmosphere -- perfect for starting the day on a peaceful note.

Looking for a new breakfast spot. Yelp had this in the top 5. As soon as I arrived, I thought wait time was going to be really long but only waited for 10 min. Mind you we got there at 10am. Service was fast. Drinks were delicious. I got a Delgado, and my husband got a strawberry lemonade. We both ordered the chicken and waffle. It was delicious. My only complaint was my chicken was a bit salty, to me. Husband didn't say anything about his.

I came here on a Friday morning with some friends. We made a reservation but surprisingly it wasn't too busy. The mascarpone pancakes were really impressive. I thought they would be too sweet and rich, but the mascarpone was light and the fresh fruit really balanced everything out. The kbomb benny was also pretty good. I found the okonomiyaki fries to be decent but would only get it with a larger party since it was a pretty decent serving even to share. Overall, I really liked the ambience and would recommend this brunch spot.

Such a yummy brunch spot! My friends and I were craving breakfast foods and decided to try this place we had in our bookmarks. We went on a Friday morning and it wasn't too busy. There were two servers fot the entire restaurant. The dining area is very cute and well lit. The food was amazing. The waffles were so flaky and fluffy, they almost tasted fried. 10/10 would come back to try the truffle omelette and lychee drink!

Came on a monday morning and we were seated right away. The benedicts i ordered were out of this world. Very instagram worthy drinks too lol i didnt try them but they looked cool.
I stuck to the mimosas and those were pretty great

Came here twice back to back weekends because it was THAT GOOD!!

The first time we ordered a carafe of mimosas which came with the OJ on the side which I LOVED since I only like a tiny drop of Oj in mine.

We ordered the Chipotle Benedict and Loco Plate, both were 10/10.

The second time we ordered the chipotle Benedict again (yes, it was just as good as the first time) and the K-bomb Benedict which is hands down my FAVORITE now! The chicken was alittle spicy and so juicy! It is a must have here! I can only imagine how delicious the K-bomb sandwich is.

Service was quick, we got on the waiting list through Yelp and got seated pretty quickly.

The space is also very simple but clean, it gave farmhouse vibes.

Can't wait to go back!!

Loved this place. We took the drive up to SF from San Jose for a birthday breakfast. My son found it on Tik Tok and we were all pleasantly surprised.
The wait was 5minutes before we were seated. The vibe of the place was cool, the service and food was really good! We loved the drinks presentation (Instagramable ). We had a varied selection from the menu, the Volcano coffee was really good, the Butterfly Lychee drink was so pretty.

The food presentation was great, the taste was also really good. I loved the fact that they had Beef Bacon on the menu as well (not common). I definitely recommend this place if you're in the area or even want to take the drive up to SF. Definitely worth it for breakfast or brunch.

Beautiful and tasty food. We arrived right at opening on a week day and were in and out in an hour. They had fancy drinks but we only had the food. K bomb Benedict and a scramble. The portions are perfect.
Cute spot and food was pretty good, but I didn't really like the bread for the chicken Benedict.

Food was so good! I love the fusion of Korean and American brunch. And everything is very instagrammable for you foodies out there.

Super clean and modern interior. Great for brunch with friends or a date

Went for brunch today, we were seated pretty promptly but it did take a lot longer for someone to come by & take our order. I feel the tables are way too close together, as we could clearly hear the couple next to us making negative comments about us ordering a pitcher of mimosas...apparently we were the only ones in the restaurant drinking something other than coffee. We ordered the chicken & waffles which was umm ok at best. Unfortunately, I don't believe we'd return considering the ambiance & food was just so-so.

I was excited to try this place but fell short of standards despite the pretty food. Upon walking in there was no vax check. And weren't checked for the people after us or before us as we'd asked the tables around us who were pretty much done eating if vax cards were checked ever. The waitress stated they were checked tho and then asked to see ours. We then moved to a table away from the all the others seated as there was ample seating available.

We ordered the French toast, scramble, and benny. Coffee was terrible. Asked for French toast with regular bacon and their four chairs bacon was brought out. The benny was good but no broccolini on the plate at all. The scramble was good but food all came out separately and wasn't the hottest. All good was beautifully presented and tasted pretty good. I know it's a soft opening so I hope some stuff can be improved upon. Overall it didn't make me want to come back but it's a cute place. Service was friendly but slow bc of short staffing.

First of all I want to say it's really nice to be back here again.. Four Chairs has always been consistent with their service and Food, I'm glad that the Business is actually picking up since then.. I'm sad though coz they don't open at Dinner anymore, even the menu is less choices than before but the drinks are still the same.. I do love the cream Brulee French Toast!!! Definitely will be back
The Food was Great and the service was Execelent..definitely will be back here! I want to check their Dinner next time

So I came here a while back for Chicken and waffles. I haven't been back since now I know why. Typical SF problem form over function. The crust of the French Toast was a rock and the pastrami.... I mean beef bacon was ok. Service was passable not stellar. It is kind of loud which I could let pass if the food was good. Not worth the wait or the price

Came here for brunch on Sunday. There is street parking available and it was easy to find a spot. There was a line when we arrived so we joined the waitlist and it took about 25 minutes to seat our party of 5. The place is nice and looked newly remodeled, however, when we sat in the back table there was a leak from the ceiling. We only felt the drops at the end of our meal. Not a huge deal, but we did alert the staff in case it got worse. The staff was appreciative and very friendly.
We all ordered different items. I ordered the truffle omelet and volcano coffee. Unfortunately, I did not taste even a hint of truffle, so not sure why it's called that. I definitely felt duped. It was good, but I could make the same meal at home so would probably not come back for that. I had a bite of the four chairs benedict and that was tasty and the burger looked great as well. I would return for a different breakfast item or would try the omelet again if there were actually truffles in it.
Definitely a must go when visiting or even living in San Francisco!!!! The food is so delicious and the drinks are super

Feels like a new brunch place on Mission! I'm not sure how long the restaurant has been around, but it has a clean, new feel.

I loved the Volcano Coffee - it was light and fluffy, not too much caffeine, which I appreciated. I also had the Loco Plate, which was a really satisfying and tasty scramble. The garlic shrimp were full and plump and not too garlicky. My friend was able to sub her home fries with fruit and it was a colorful and refreshing alternative. I love that the toast was not typical slices of wheat bread.

The waitstaff were great - attentive and checked in on us after we got our food. We went on a weekday, so it wasn't too crowded. We sat and talked for a couple of hours and didn't feel rushed.

Soft Opening!

Formerly RakiRaki Ramen, Four Chairs is a new restaurant in Bernal serving American brunch staples by day and an ambitious global, Asian fusion-y menu by night.

They're open for indoor dining and takeout only. No outdoor seating and I don't see them on any delivery platforms yet.

I'm usually not a breakfast/brunch person but I'm always down for some chicken & waffles.

I called for takeout and was quoted 20 minutes (it took about 40 minutes).

Staff wore masks properly.

F O O D
* Chicken & Waffle w/ maple syrup ($15)
***Add Four Chairs Bacon (+$10)

The waffle was crispy and dense on the outside, and soft on the inside (like a liege waffle without the pearl sugar). The bone-in fried chicken thigh was crispy and moist but very unseasoned. The drizzle of syrup provided that savory sweet combo that I crave.

I added the Four Chairs Bacon out of curiosity, thinking it's their take on the infamous millionaire's bacon (candied bacon). And, it is...salty, sweet, and smoky with a tinge of heat.

S E R V I C E
Friendly and warm.

My order took longer than expected. Staff was apologetic and they kindly offered water while I waited.

I ended up waiting outside and they brought out a Dalgona Coffee (whipped coffee drink) on the house. Very kind and unexpected.

A M B I A N C E
Contemporary and casual with warm woods and hanging edison light bulbs.

P A R K I N G
Challenging street parking but doable during the day. You can try parking at the BofA lot on Sundays.

It takes a lot of balls for a small business to open a new restaurant in SF of all places, and in a pandemic no less so wishing Four Chairs the best of luck in Bernal!
The food was amazing, it also came out pretty fast despite rush hour. The matcha drinks were also really good I highly recommend!

Four Chairs is less than a fifteen minute walk from the 24th St BART Station. I'm always here for a restaurant within walking distance from convenient public transportation.

I would recommend coming before 10:30am on the weekend if you want to increase your chances of getting a table. You can also call ahead to make a reservation (try not to be late!). The inside is spacious and fits more tables than I expected when I looked at the restaurant from the outside. Service was friendly and attentive, even when the place got busier.

I ordered the buttermilk pancake, which came with a stack of three pancakes topped with fresh fruit. The pancakes arrived warm, allowing for the butter to melt in. I do wish that I could choose whether I wanted two or three pancakes because three was too much for me.

Although, maybe I have myself to blame for being full because I also ordered a side of homie home fries. I have no regrets about the potatoes. I was hesitant to order a side in addition to my main dish because the prices add up, but I'm so glad I ended up ordering them! They were super crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. I've never had home fries with texture this good. They definitely made this spot stand out compared to other brunch places.

For drinks, my table of six shared a mimosa pitcher. The portion size wasn't very large per person. The champagne and orange come separately, so you can choose how much of each to pour. I saw sangria and some fun non-alcoholic drinks on the menu. I would be interested in trying those if I came back.

Overall, cute brunch spot with not only the classics, but also some unique offerings!

This tiny restaurant in the upper Mission is a real SF gem! Their breakfast/brunch menu is amazing! And the service is phenomenal. Unless you don't mind waiting, be sure to make a reservation. We came all the way from Vallejo to eat here because we heard it was a "good eats" place. We were not disappointed! And you won't be either! Oh and the speciality drinks are out of this world! We are already planning our next visit.

The atmosphere was lovely and everything we ate was DELICIOUS!

Service was efficient and friendly!

Not super quiet so if you're looking for quiet don't go but that's literally the only reason. We LOVED it!

Best fried chicken ever!

Great brunch food, chic ambience, good service but could be faster!

This super hip restaurant is perfect for a weekend brunch with a big menu that caters to most dietary preferences. Lines are long though, so plan for a 15-20 minute

I got the garlic shrimp + veggies egg scramble (called Loco Plato) which came with house style potatoes and a slice of fresh whole wheat bread. The shrimp was tender and the garlic flavor did not overpower the dish. I had requested the eggs to be well done, and the chefs DELIVERED! The eggs were not runny at all, without being burnt or dry. Perfectly done

My partner got the K-Bomb benedict - he loved the flavor on the chicken breast. The benedict was flavorful and served over ciabatta bread. The combination of Korean spiced chicken and eggs benedict worked out!

The french toast had a lovely hint orange zest, but the toasts were a bit dry. Could have been better.

The star item at this brunch though was the Butterfly lychee drink which we got with soju. Super refreshing and sweet.

Highly recommend going here for brunch!

I came in hoping Four Chairs would be good but I feel like its one of those hip restaurants that look better than it tastes.

The Original Egg Benedict - The hollandaise had a very citrusy flavor that threw us off. We didn't expect it and didn't care for it. The potatoes that came w it were crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. I loved the texture of the potatoes but felt that it lacked seasoning. I don't think it had any seasoning at all? It tasted just like a potato. It needed the help of ketchup.

Citrus French Toast - It was so beautiful but it didn't taste like anything. lol. We didn't finish it, we only ate the fruits.

Drink - We ordered the Volcano Coffee and it was very sweet.

In terms of service, our server was very nice and friendly. What I didn't like was that we got there maybe 5 minutes before 5 other parties got there and our order was taken last.

Love the place. It's been a while since I've been impressed by a brunch place. There was a bit of a wait on a weekend even though we went close to the afternoon but the line moved pretty quickly. We got the k bomb chicken benedict and strawberry Macha, both of which were incredible. Place has a nice chill vibe as well. We would definitely go back again.

Delicious k bomb benny I dream of coming back. Staff is nice too :-)
Thanks thanks thanks

The Hawaiian omelette was very nice.
The wait time (40 minutes), rushed and borderline rude staff took my order, delivered my food and ignored me. I had to chase down the guy to pay my bill. They seem most focused on turning tables vs service.
The room, and it is one big room, is Loud, loud, loud. You almost have to use hand signals to communicate.
Trendy, I'm sure. I won't go back. Many, many other places serve better food in a nicer atmosphere.
Just an update warning -- no espresso drinks here. You can get coffee "drinks" that are beautiful and tasty but no lattes. The drip coffee is very good though.

There are plenty of pictures of the incredibly Instagram worthy delectations available here.

The more salient fact is that it is always extremely popular. I arrived 10 minutes after opening in a Saturday and it was mostly full EXCEPT for two person tables. Large groups be warned.

So I was seated lickety split and immediately transfixed by the drinks delivered to my next table. All thoughts of a plain coffee vanished -- and I rarely go for elaborate drinks. The coffee volcano looked too fun(and there was a purple extravaganza worth chiming another time) And said volcano coffee was all thought it would be -- but it was stickier than I expected. Do try it.

They also had the fries and I personally found the aroma of the bonito flakes unappealing but they polished them off.

I really wanted to try a scramble -- and will another time -- but it seemed "important" to try either the creme brûlée French toast or mascarpone pancakes since I'd heard so much about them.

The pancakes look like something from a food magazine AND they tasted great too. Not too terribly sweet either. I had a am chicken sausage ich it to cut the sweetness as well.

It wasn't a cheap brunch, but it was delicious AND I didn't feel miserably full.

Three cheers for the Four Chairs!

Came here on a Sunday for brunch around 1pm and there was no wait! We got the French toast and chipotle benedict to eat & a butterfly lychee to drink. Everything was so tasty and colorful! The place was also very cute & the service was great.

Everything was phenomenal! Great service, they were very attentive of coffee and water refills. The food was excellent. My boyfriend and I got the by the sea Benedict, the shrimp benidict, pancakes and the creme brûlée french toast. It was all amazing 10/10 for sure. I would definitely recommend this spot and we will definitely be coming back again!

This was recommended to me by a friend. Came on a Saturday morning and was seated immediately. The restaurant was spacious with a clean interior. We ordered thai iced tea, mango tango, chicken and waffles and crispy chicken burger.
Thai iced tea: really good! great drink size
Mango Tango: this is club soda with mango syrup. super refreshing and sweet
Chicken and waffle: was excited for this but slightly let down. Good portion size. The chicken had good breading but just needed more seasoning. The chicken also came with a delicious sweet chili sauce. The waffles were nice and crispy and came with syrup and butter. The butter and syrup wasn't warm however so it was very difficult to melt and spread the butter on a lukewarm waffle. Also, just own preference, but messy to eat since chicken came on the bone so difficult to get a good bite of both chicken and waffle.
Crispy chicken burger: super crispy chicken on a soft brioche bun. Super flavorful with the aioli. Came with a good serving of fries that were well seasoned.
Overall, a good recommendation with lots of drink options. Good service!

This was my final stop before leaving beautiful San Francisco.

This place was recommended me to me by a personal friend and it was well worth it!

The staff was super friendly and accommodating, we came in here with our bags and it was our last stop before catching our flight they helped us find a seat where we could safely put our bags away so we could enjoy our meal!

I ordered the chicken and waffles while my partner ordered their chicken sandwhich and I have to be frank, the chicken and waffles were a bit difficult to eat, most places I've had chicken and waffles serve the chicken boneless but here they served bone-in making it a bit of hassle to eat. Not only that but the chicken didn't have much seasoning and tasted a little bland. On the upside it was breaded perfectly so I'll give them that. The waffles were good but a little cold so the butter on the top of them didn't get the chance to melt and I found myself eating lukewarm waffles with cold butter. I took a bite of my partners chicken sandwhich and it was heavenly I just wish they would've used the same seasoning on my chicken.

Overall I would come again! But I wouldn't order the chicken and waffles
Ordered chicken and waffles for pickup. I was so excited because of good reviews but the food was very mid. It definitely needs flavor. Have had better chicken and waffles else where.

Good food and friendly staff.
We got Four chairs benny, french toast, volcano coffee and butterfly lychee.
Love their Four chairs bacon, just the right amount of sweetness. French toast came with warm syrup. The drinks were refreshing. Will definitely be back!!

Food/Drinks (5/5)
Came here after a foiled visit to Alnico (their wait list was closed). This place was a pleasant surprise! My friend and I both ordered omelets and Butterfly Lychee drinks. I enjoyed my Truffle Omelet though the truffle flavor wasn't particularly strong more so just regular mushroom taste. The potatoes were addicting! And the toast was good.
The Butterfly Lychee drink is an eye catcher for sure (the tables next to us asked us what we got haha), however keep in mind it's made with Butterfly Pea. If you haven't tried it before, Butterfly Pea is beautiful but has a bitter flavor, so you definitely have to mix the purple (Butterfly Pea part) with the lychee or else you'll end your drink on a bitter note.
Price (5/5)
An affordable brunch price for the area. Entrees are $15-20 and drinks are ~$7.
Wait Time (4/5)
With a party of two at weekend brunchtime there was only a short wait. However the wait staff were not very clear so we could have gotten a table earlier than when we were seated.
Ambience (4/5)
Nice restaurant, nothing I was wow'd by but had nice cozy vibes.
Service (4/5)
See under wait time. Staff was nice just confused us a little.
Parking/Access (5/5)
Pretty easy to find street parking. We parked on a side street behind the restaurant and walked a couple mins.

If you're looking for a brunch spot similar to Son & Garden but more low-key and casual, this is the place.
We had to wait 30-40mins but it was worth the wait! I order a chipotle Benedict with a cranberry mimosa and it was so bomb!

I was craving some chicken and waffles so I decided to check this spot out since it looked so good in the photos. Unfortunately, it looked better than it tasted.

Everything tasted fine at first but once I was full enough to stop eating with my eyes, I realized that the chicken, though perfectly crisp, was lacking in flavor. It had no flavor of its own without the waffle. Adding salt and hot sauce didn't help. That's how I knew for sure, it could have used just a tase bit of seasoning. I understand you don't want the chicken seasoned so much that clashes with waffles and maple syrup but it's should still taste good enough to eat on it's own.

The waffle, however, was good and was perfectly soft and fluffy with a little crisp on the outside.

I got full and had half of my order left but I didn't have an urge to bring the other half home (and that I rarely ever happens. If it's good, I always take the rest home.) That's how unimpressed I was.

The chicken & waffles is pretty popular though (I just wouldn't go back there for it) and they likely have other dishes that are good.

However, the service was good and I like their waitlist system (they use Yelp). ;-)

Food and ambiance were awesome. Get there early on the weekends because the restaurant fills up quickly! I shared the Creme Brûlée French toast, fried chicken and waffles, and a seafood Benedict (forget the actual name) with two friends. No drinks for us, though they were pretty to look at. Overall a good experience!

I recently had brunch here with my husband. The service was nice & the ambiance was chill. He had the chicken and waffles and I had the Creme Brulee French toast and it was delicious. I really loved my drink. It was the purple butterfly,so good! I will definitely be coming back!

I'd say four chairs is 85% worth the hype! Super aesthetic place with a good balance of asian fusion dishes. We came on a weekend at 1 pm, so had to show up to the restaurant to put our names on the Yelp waitlist. Got seated in about 30 minutes, which wasn't too shabby for a Saturday. Here's what we got:

- okonomiyaki fries: fries were thin and stayed crispy despite the excessive kewpie mayo. I prefer my fries to have a more pillowy inside, but if you like in n out fries maybe you'll really like it. 3.8/5
- crème brûlée toast: the inside was soft and soaked up the delicious sauce. However, the crust was super hard and dry. I also wouldn't be able to finish this as my own entree (my table shared it), since it's quite sweet. 4/5
- Korean fried chicken Benedict: the chicken was delish on this!! It comes kind of as a side to the 2 eggs Benedict's you get. The hollandaise sauce had a lemony spin to it, which some of us liked and some of us didn't. 4.5/5
- Korean fried chicken sandwich: HUGE slab of chicken. 5/5
- salmon benedict: nothing too special, it was a good classic Benedict! 4.5/5
- butterfly lychee drink: basically just sweet lychee juice. Not a complex drink, not much substance, but nonetheless was refreshing. 4/5
- mango/strawberry matcha: both good! 5/5
- volcano coffee: good, just more sugar than caffeine. 4.5/5

Overall, this definitely satisfied my craving for an Asian fusion brunch. Everything was plated beautifully and overall it was a good meal. I'd come back, but it didn't blow me outta the water!

Crme brle French Toast was everything I fantasized. Soft fluffy sweetness. Could use a few more berries. Toasts were thick and battered well. Definitely a shareable sized order.

Volcano Coffee was a good pairing to wash down after each few bites. Takes a bit of time to mix well as it takes a methodical careful churn to get the dense whip into the bottom of the glass. Creamy and a potent coffee taste.

Interior felt cozy with its decor. Service was prompt and attentive. Definitely felt the staff takes pride in their work. Restaurant was very clean, chairs aligned, table items neatly placed. Came before opening on Sunday. Wasn't busy at all. Got seated a few minutes before opening time and orders were taken a minute or two after proper opening. Drink only took a couple of minutes to come out and my order not too long after. I can see myself returning to run back the same order.
The best waffle, EVER! They serve big portions of well prepared breakfast, brunch and lunch food. Everything is delicious!

Wow!! It is not often that you have food that looks as perfect as it tastes but this is amazing! One of the best brunch spots I've had in my life! The chicken that comes with the chicken and waffles tastes like my grandma made it and it is sooo crispy but simultaneously tender. The K-Bomb Benny had an amazing chipotle glaze that blended perfectly with the hollandaise. The only brunch restaurant that was so good that I had to change my underwear afterwards! 10/10 give these people a Pulitzer Prize

Brunch here is top-notch in a trendy, modern setting, and they whip up some seriously fancy drinks.

My chicken and waffles were amazing--I got half a chicken on the bone and a Belgian waffle. And their bloody mary? Pretty darn good too!

Came here with friends for a Saturday brunch and thankfully I was able to carpool with my friend or else I would avoid as parking seems a bit difficult in the area. The restaurant wasn't entirely packed when we went and we were able to get a table relatively quickly. I found it a bit hard to hear my friends talk inside as its quite loud from the sounds of people chattering echoing off the high ceilings. I had the original benedict- yummy but feel like they skimped a bit on the side salad and the potatoes. Overall, a nice brunch spot but not super memorable in my books.

Be prepared to wait or joint the waitlist ahead of time, this place was packed on a Sunday for brunch. I will say they really get people in an out of here pretty quickly, but to a point where you don't feel rushed.

The volcano coffee was delicious. I still think about it to this day, and the Nova Benny was so different than what I am used to! I thought the smoked salmon and peaches egg would be a little weird but it was delicious. Can't forget those delicious house potatoes! I'll be back for sure.

Kind Staff. Indoor Dining & Takeout. High Ceilings with Airy Interior but Tight Tables Space. Aesthetic, Thai-American Dishes. Taste Not Too Memorable. Affordable for San Francisco. Various Forms of Payment Accepted. Waitlist and Reservations Available Via Yelp. Free Street Parking.

Came here to celebrate my friend's birthday. We waited an hour for a table for 5 on a Sunday afternoon, and it took another 40 minutes for our food to arrive.

Service was way too pushy; they checked on us three separate times within 5 minutes after we received the food. We hadn't even taken a couple of bites before receiving the check.

I understand it was busy, but it felt like we were being watched and asked to leave before we could even enjoy our meal. Shoutout to the busboy though!! He was amazing.

We wanted to eat the cake I brought, but they told us there would be a $10 cake fee if we did, so we decided to pack it up.

They also tried to give us another check. The waiter brought the payment machine and stood over us as we tipped.

The food itself was okay. We tried the mascarpone pancakes, chipotle benedict, and k-bomb chicken benny. I wouldn't bother waiting more than 30 minutes for it; nothing special.

Won't be coming back.

Good food, wait goes quick, fun drinks . It's a vibe ordered the leche drink and French toast friend had a matcha drink and some flavorful Benedict I don't remember the name but he said he liked it . Will go again

I loved that the French toast wasn't too sweet and there were plenty of fruits on top! I also recommend trying their volcano coffee, which is essentially a whipped coffee with milk. The portobello burger is also a must try, as someone who doesn't love the taste of mushroom, I thought it was delicious! The food came out fairly quick and I like that we were able to make a reservation through Yelp. The restaurant was pretty quiet and nicely decorated!

First day in the city and we were hungry for brunch. We had plenty options in the area not to mention Four chairs being adjacent to another restaurant. So what invited us in? A quick look at the menu posted on the window emphasized quality. We stepped inside and was quickly welcomed by the amazing ambiance. The liting, interior design, the music, and how clean it was enticed my party to have a table. I ordered the "Four chairs" and seeing the ingredients like Eggs Benedict, tomatoes, bacon, broccolini, etc. I didn't expect much. But when my food arrived I didn't realize breakfast could look this amazing. Not just that, all the ingredients tasted like local farm grown quality and the taste all blended so well. The price itself was fair; not too cheap, not too expensive but Knowing that it's from Four Chairs i would honestly pay more.

My first time here and I'm told they've only been open for a year. Came in at 11am and the restaurant only had a handful of customers. I don't know if it's usually that slow but knowing how much I enjoyed them I know those tables will be filled pretty soon. Come stop by as soon as you can!
The food was so good but portions were small imo. I got the omelette and my sister got the pancakes and she didn't get full at all and I was just satisfied.

The food was good overall, the pancakes and the strawberry lemonade were the highlights for us. I'd say these are amongst the best pancakes we've had in SF. The chicken and waffles were alright. The service was good, no frills; fast and efficient. Finding parking was a bit of a challenge but only took us about 10 minutes.

Overall, a solid place for breakfast and brunch. Would definitely return for the pancakes.

I was very impressed with the interior of the restaurant as it was very spacious and clean with lights hanging from the ceiling. I thought the menu was a little shorter compared to other brunch places in SF, but I was excited to try their dishes for the first time.
Items ordered:
- Chipotle Benedict ($18): I saw a lot of other yelp reviews recommended this dish, and taste wise, it was pretty good! I asked the server if it was going to be spicy since it came with jalapenos, but it wasn't that spicy overall. I like how it also came with both a salad and potatoes. The salad didn't have much flavor, but the potatoes were nicely done. Overall, I thought it wasn't the best benedict dish I had ever eaten but I do think it is a good dish to try if it is your first time at Four Chairs.
- French Toast ($13): The presentation for this dish was pretty with the layout of the fruits! I also thought this dish wasn't the best french toast I had ever eaten, but it was still a nice sweet dish to end the meal. I would have liked a bit more flavor in the french toast too.
The service also wasn't the best as I had to wait a long time for the server to come to our table throughout the time, and there were only a few other parties at the restaurant. Overall, I thought the food was decent, but I don't think I would go out of my way to come here, especially since there are a lot of other brunch places in SF to choose from, and parking is also pretty limited too.

They did not disappoint! We arrived 10 mins before they opened on a Sunday and it was full by the time it was 9:30. French toast was so decadent highly recommend and eggs were cooked nicely with butter and beef bacon was interesting but good. Love how it looks inside, it's a lot bigger than it appears from outside. Staff was so attentive checking in and quick with their service.

Highly recommend this place! Quick and friendly service with a nice ambiance. We ordered the K-bomb Benedict (a must) and the Mascarpone Pancakes and they were both phenomenal. The country potatoes are the best I've ever had and the Bloody Mary was nice and spicy! You won't be disappointed here.

Service was fast and everything felt very modern and chic. We got the Okinomiyaki Fries, Chipotle Benedict, and Citrus French Toast. We both agreed that the fries were the best (they were thin crispy and worked well with the sauce and bonito flakes). The citrus French toast was surprisingly both refreshing and decadent at the same time. The chipotle eggs Benedict lacked the pop of flavor that the other two dishes had but was still overall great!

What a great place to get brunch in San Fran! We stopped here before heading out to the airport and it left us nice and full. All the portion sizes are much larger than I expected, so we had to get a take out box for the leftovers!

As a starter, we had the okonomiyaki fries, which were delicious! They are piping hot crispy fries with bonito, kewpie mayo, and eel sauce. Definitely great for sharing with the table while the rest of your food is prepared.

For our main dishes, we had the chicken & waffle and nova benny (smoked salmon benedict).
