The chicken and waffle came with a nice sweet and spicy sauce in addition to the maple syrup and the flavors were so good! The smoked salmon eggs benedict tasted great, but was oddly cold--the home fries it came with were hot. I'm not sure if it was a one off, but regardless, the food was to die for.

If you come with a big appetite, you will definitely be leaving satisfied!!

Great food. Great service. Great space. The chicken waffles is THE beat we have ever eaten. The home fried potatoes are crispy and delightful. The kids menu has a generous Mickey Mouse pancake and a side . The Bloody Mary had bacon.....what more can I say:)

Come near 11 and the wait is shorter on weekends.

Weekdays they take reservations.

Yummy

We came for Sunday brunch and this has become my new favorite brunch spot. Every dish was beautifully crafted, decorated with petals and various garnishes, and everything was delicious. The portions were also huge. I think this place hasn't been discovered yet since the wait was unbelievably short- the waitlist estimated half an hour but it ended up being 10 minutes! Parking was a bit tough to find but if you wait a bit around the surrounding streets, something will open up. I'll definitely be back!
What's can I say the food, service, and ambiance were great. The drinks A1. Food on point and fresh. 5 out of 5. If you're in the city definitely come check out this spot.

We went on a Sunday morning ( memorial weekend). Not busy when they first opened.

Kids ordered the Korean chicken sandwich and regular chicken sandwich. Both were good according to them. They also liked the lemonade( not pictured).

Chicken waffles, Chicken had a little more batter than expected, but waffles were good!

good service!

Came here on a Wednesday around noon got seated almost right away and did not receive any food until almost 1. Not sure if it was an extra bad busy day, but the servers ignored us the entire time and were able to get other tables water and utensils while we had to wave them down to ask. After almost an hour waiting for our food we finally got it after asking a waiter about it. Got the k-bomb chicken sandwich and the crème brûlée french toast. Both were just okay, they were soggy and just overpowering along with dry french fries. The volcano coffee was good, it's just that it was mostly ice. Not sure if we ordered the wrong things, but not worth the wait, will not be coming back.

Really incredible food and wonderful presentation. I was wondering about this place at first, but their focus on a great brunch has worked out awesome!
Biggest challenge is they're so popular, but they do a great job moving folks through while providing a great experience.

Great vibes and service. Got chicken and waffles and pancakes. The chicken and waffles is a must have here. For drinks, tried the volcano coffee which is their take on dalgona coffee. Not too impressed by it- it was little hard to stir and overall messy.

This is my favorite breakfast spot right now. The lively omelet is my go to every time. The mascarpone pancakes were delicious. The chicken sandwich is also good. Fruit cup and eggs is exactly what it sounds like, plain but healthy. The drinks are fun and delicious. Volcano coffee is my favorite. The interior is nice and upscale. They are always busy, even on a Monday, but service still seems to be fast. Good to dine in or order on doordash

The breakfast was basic, I wasn't too impressed with it. What really sold me was the drinks and my friends chicken sandwich. If I ever come back I know to order that instead! The volcano coffee was really interesting. It's served all pretty but you have to stir it to drink it. So then it just looks like a regular coffee. Still fun nonetheless. The chicken sandwich though... mmm. Crispy chicken. Nice bun. Thin cut fries. I've never been so jealous of someone else's food before. Seriously, order the chicken sandwich if you come here. The restaurant is really cute but it was super loud I could barely hear the server or my friend sitting across from me.

good place to try! there was a bit of a wait on a sunday at 12 pm and the place was really crowded inside, but service was pretty quick! we got the Crispy Chicken Burger sub with Okonomiyaki Fries, K-Bomb Chicken Benny, and Mascarpone Pancake. we came here for the Mascarpone Pancake, but it was just ok. i thought the pancake could've been warmer and the mascarpone just tasted like a thicker whipped cream. but the rest of the food we got was good!

Great brunch spot for high quality food! We saw this place recommended on Tiktok so had to try it. Our group of 6 came on a Sunday during peak brunch time and there was around a 20 minute wait. Inside the restaurant, it is very aesthetic but loud.

The menu offers basic brunch things like omelets, scrambles, waffles, etc. I ordered the southwest scramble and some of my friends ordered the chipotle Benedict, French toast, and pancakes. The southwest scramble was loaded with bell peppers, onions, and tomatoes. It also came with roasted potatoes which were flavorful on the outside but pretty plain on the interior. Everything was so filling and we enjoyed every dish. We also got the butterfly lychee which tastes like straight up lychee juice from the can.

Overall, definitely recommend this brunch spot! It offers great quality food with good value and the environment feels very social and lively.

This place is very busy. Join the wait list or make reservations, otherwise there is a sign up sheet at the door. I had 1 marscapone pancakes w/side of fried chicken. Chicken is good with the sauce. The pancake was a little on the dry side. I would not order again. My friends ordered one of the Bennie dishes and they liked it. Definitely will be back to try something else. Give this place a try.

Omg! By far my favorite food in Bay area. I wasn't expecting this much deliciousness.. I ordered my favorite thing Salmon Egg Benedict. It was great. I love the patatoes. My friend got Chipotle Benedict and Butterfly Lychee. She loved it. It was so busy but we were seated so quickly and food came so fast. Just I wish they didn't give the check without us asking. We were going to order desserts but we felt like we were kicked out, even before our food finishesI understand they are busy but since we are already there, I would prefer them to focus on the seated customer and service. Next time hopefully I can try the desserts.

I had seen this place on instagram and thought the food looked amazing so I decided to try it out. The food looked exactly like the pictures I had previously seen and it was just as good as you excepted it to be. The service was great even though we had showed up a little closer to closing time. It was very cute inside and the presentation of everything was great! Definitely will be coming back to try more off their menu.

This place is very aesthetic. They are very busy as this is a very popular establishment for brunch. Parking is very limited so be prepared to look for a while and also wait for a while for your table. Our server was nice and the food is instagramable and was good. I don't think the plates are worth the price, but it is definitely an experience.

Great breakfast spot. Fun drinks. We had the pancakes, French toast and a couple other dishes. Everyone enjoyed their meal choice. We did have to wait for about an hr to get a table, nxt time we'll be sure to make a reservation. Would definitely come back next time we're in the city.

Four Chairs is a great brunch spot! I dined here with one of my girl friends and we had a great time! I ordered the chicken and waffles & she ordered the salmon benedict. The servings are definitely bigger than I expected, especially for a brunch spot in the city! The waffle was good. The chicken had great crispy skin and the meat was juicy. It was delicious!

The service was great as well! The waitress constantly came back to refill our waters and asked us how the food was.

However, there was a situation with a homeless man trying to get my girl friend and I'd attention. He came inside the restaurant and the staff did their absolute best handling everything. After a couple of minutes, the man was escorted out. The staff locked the doors to prevent him from coming back in. Unfortunately, he was waiting for us to come out of the restaurant and would not leave for 15 minutes. We eventually got escorted through the back exit by the staff which was super nice of them. It was an experience! Lol

^^ this was not the restaurant's fault at all--just sharing my experience dining that one day!

Me and my friend came to 4 chairs for the 1st time last month. I got the pancakes, potatoes, and beef bacon. She got the French toast and eggs. My pancakes were the best part of my meal . The fruit on the pancakes were so fresh and yummy. The beef bacon tasted like weird pastrami deli slices. I don't recommend it. The service started off really great until my friend realized the French toast wasn't fully cooked. The French toast was still doughy in the middle. We kept trying to get our servers attention but he was ignoring us. Our server didn't come back for 30 minutes. We were hoping that she would be able to get them remade but, after waiting so long we were ready to leave. We informed the server about the French toast and asked for the bill. He said okay and never came back. I had to ask the server and the manager several times for our bill while they got other people checked out or etc. It was a very frustrating experience.
Definitely worth the wait! Good and service was amazing. We ordered the crème brûlée French toast and k-bomb Benny
Four Chairs lived up to the high expectations I had. We had a wonderful visit, the breakfast was excellent and the service and ambiance were great! We will be back again in the future!

I haven't tried their dinner menu, but I didn't enjoy brunch here. The food was incredibly aesthetic and looked delicious, but both textures and flavors missed the mark. The pancakes were dense and flavorless (I had to drown it in syrup), and the smoked salmon in the benedict had an odd taste/didn't seem to be very good quality.

Sincerely, truly, and unfortunately, the only thing I liked were the potatoes and their Volcano Coffee (though it you're a coffee lover, you may not like it very much, since it's mostly very creamy/milky tasting).

The ambiance was just okay, it's just one giant room so when there's a lot of large parties and people talking, the voices echo and it's hard to hear. Tables are also smushed up pretty close against each other, so unintentional eavesdropping of convos is inevitable, lol.

I wouldn't go out of my way to eat here again with so many alternative options in the Bay Area, but I'm sure they serve their surrounding neighborhood well. Perhaps the dinner menu is where it's at?

Overall, 11/10. Pancakes 6/5, K-Bomb sando 4/5 - could of been a little more spicy for my taste but Is perfect for the average chicken sandwich enjoyer.
Drinks were yummy and beautiful. Will return soon.

Came here on a Friday afternoon and surprisingly there was no wait! We parked 2 blocks away but we found parking right away. We knew what we wanted so we ordered right away, we got the Hawaiian omelette and it was okay. Not great or bad. I do like the potatoes because they were super crispy. The fruits were also very fresh. Mascarpone pancake was disappointing it was too sweet and very dry. The drinks were yummy we got the butterfly lychee & volcano coffee. Service was fast & friendly. Bill total was $55 two drinks and 2 dishes very reasonably priced. Would I come here again? Sadly no :(
Great addition to the Mission neighborhood. Unique flavors, excellent service, overall ambiance makes it a great spot with friends or the entire family.

Solid brunch spot even though it's a bit far from the Valencia area. We put our name on the list when we got there and had to wait for like half an hour before our table. I'm would rate the food 4/5 I think it is solid but I'm not a huge fan of the Kbomb chicken I found it a bit too sweet for my liking. The drinks were good and pretty cheap. I like the mango and lychee drinks but the coffee tasted a little off

Food (4/5): I ordered the chicken and waffles, and my partner ordered the chipotle benedict. I went to this restaurant a month ago, so my memory is a bit blurry, but I remember my partner and I liking the dishes we got, but not loving them.

Service (5/5): We didn't have a reservation, but we were seated decently quickly for a Saturday brunch. The food came out in a decent amount of time as well.

Ambiance (5/5): The restaurant has a very welcoming vibe! Perfect for a weekend brunch.

Overall verdict: I would come back again to try some of the other dishes, but maybe not the two that we got!

Good breakfast spot, basic breakfast with a fusion twist.
Bloody Mary, and the Mimosa's were good. Service was good. Cool decor in dinning room and it was clean
Parking on Mission street requires feeding the meters but I don't mind.
I would come back.

I have no idea why this place isn't more popular for dinner! I've never eaten here for brunch (most of the pictures on here are brunch). I was so blown away the first time from their dinner menu that I came again a couple weeks later.

My favorites are the Okonomiyaki Fries, The Caribbean (I sub for their super fluffy coconut rice), and the Parata Lamb. Every dish here is executed with precision and with so much flavor/depth.

Staff are always friendly and the water cups also don't fall (attention to detail).

If you're in the area looking for a yummy + reasonably priced meal - four chairs has been my go to recently.

Classic Cheeseburger served on a cutting board with a thin rock slab where the burger and fries sat. The newspaper was good for catching the meat juices that ran out of the burger once I bit into it. Very thick and juicy. Fries were just a little skinnier than Golden Arches and so a little more crisp. Enjoyed the glass shaped just like the can of coke that came with it. It was like watching the liquid inside the can once I poured it. I guess if you're paying 20something for a burger lunch, it's gotta be this good. Was fun to treat myself but definitely not gonna be a regular place since I'm just not making that kind of money.
Decent brunch place, I ordered the pinky winky and chipotle benedicts, both have good flavors but wasnt exceptional. The place/food were very instagrammable. Wait was about 50min on a Sunday at 1pm.
The food here is incredible! The service was better than most and my only complaint is that I can't eat there every day.

Super happy that I found a new brunch spot! If you're tired of waiting in 2 hour lines to have some brunch then Four Chairs is the place to be. Not only was the service great, so was the food. The interior is also really cute!

Fantastic brunch spot with excellent food. Menu is up to date with photos so you can see exactly what you're getting. Wait time was extremely long but you can check into the waitlist via the Yelp app. Modern decor and well lit, though quite loud with the large crowds. Great spot for friends outings, would avoid if looking for something more intimate.

Foods looks very nice but had to wait for an hour to get in. After all I mean it kind of reduce the point here. I really enjoyed the cream Brle toast. But the other dishes they are okay, the k bomb Benny, the fried chicken is a bit too sweet for me.

Wonderful place for brunch. It does get busy so I do recommend to reserve especially for big parties. The food was delicious. We all enjoyed everything. The burger is huge so definitely good to share. My favorite was the bacon bene! That is a must get. The butterfly lychee was very good but a bit sweet which I added some water base of my sweetness. I still think you should get it since it is very refreshing. Unlimited coffee was really nice. The volcano coffee was also pretty good.

Overall we all enjoyed it and the staff was also very good.
everything was saurrrr good. Definitely join a waitlist in advance if you can. the food came to us really fast and servers were all very nice and helpful.

Came to Four Chairs for a Sunday brunch and was super happy to find a brunch spot which was really good and didn't have an excessively long wait time! The first thing that pops out are their "instagram-able" beverages, which have beautiful layers and garnishes. The food was also a feast for the eyes. The place was bustling and I also enjoyed the lively atmosphere. Two things to note, however, is that while the food and drinks are super pretty, taste-wise they are good but may not flavorful enough to warrant their high price. And since the place was busy, it took a while for us to get our check even after we finished eating. That said, this is a place I would bring out-of-town guests to enjoy an aesthetically pleasing meal.

Food: 4/5
Service: 4/5
Ambiance: 4/5
Great food! It's a long wait but worth it! My son chosen this place for his birthday brunch.

Came here to celebrate my friends birthday and was not let down! A pitcher of margarita was $35 great to share with everyone who doesn't want to drink too much. 5 people from my group was able to get about 3 glasses worth of the margarita. Very worth it!

Chipotle Benedict: 10/10

French toast: 9/10

Chicken & Waffle: 10/10

I tried the k-bomb chicken benedict, which was quite tasty and made me want to return. I also had their whipped coffee, and my partner had a matcha latte, the two of which I suggest. The only issue with this establishment is the wait time, and the location of the tables is extremely very close to other people. It's overwhelming at first, but once you start eating, I suppose it's worthwhile. Another disadvantage is how frequently employees reach over while you are eating, making you feel rushed to eat.

I'm giving this restaurant 5 stars but I wish there was a 10 stars option because this place it's AMAZING. Food just taste as good as it looks.

Food 10/10 , Service 10/10 , Ambiance 10/10.

This place has a really good design and you feel really comfortable in there.

I really recommend to get the Volcano coffee, you won't regret it and they are pretty flexible with any special request on your food.

I come here for their Crème Brulee French toast and Mascarpone pancakes. They are both absolutely delicious. One of my other favorites from the menu is the Chipotle Benedict. Great atmosphere and even better customer service. Excellent choice for a nice brunch or breakfast

This restaurant lives up to the hype; everything my friend and I ordered were delicious! We arrived around 11am on a Sunday and waited about 30-40 minutes after putting our names on a waitlist. The place was crowded, but once we were seated, service was pretty quick. We ordered K-Bomb chicken Benny and Mascarpone Pancake and not only were they beautiful, they were fresh and flavorful. The mascarpone pancake wasn't too sweet and was very fluffy. The K-Bomb chicken Benny was crisp and rich! Because these two dishes were so good, I am excited to go back and try their other dishes! I ordered the freshly squeezed orange juice and my friend ordered the dalgona coffee but they were nothing too special. Overall great environment and great food, would recommend coming in for brunch!

Best breakfast & brunch in the area !!
Chicken and Waffle
Citrus French Toast
Fried Chicken
Food was ok , service was friendly and ambiance was not great. Based on reviews I was underwhelmed but I would return to give them another try

I love it a lot here. Pretty much my new current go to breakfast spot. There's always a wait but it's super quick! Never waited more than 30-40 mins. They're very communicative with the waitlist. The food is always delicious, the K-Bomb Benny is too good. The volcanic coffee is to die for, I'm super caffeine sensitive but this coffee has never made me feel jittery. The environment is cozy and busy. The food looks exactly the way it's presented in the menu. As much as I want to gate keep. This place needs its props. Staff in genuine and attentive, you won't be disappointed.

LOVE this brunch spot!! I have eaten here a couple times, but I have also come other times and got unlucky with the super long wait so eventually left. The last time I came here, I came on a Friday, but I made sure to make a reservation as they only do weekday reservations. My party was seated, and we ordered the volcano coffee, mango matcha latte, creme brulee French toast, and chicken & waffle. We really enjoyed the drinks! The volcano coffee can get a bit messy when mixing, but the coffee taste is strong. The creme brulee French toast was a unique brunch item as I have never seen other brunch spots do it. I am a creme brulee fan, so I thought the creme brulee flavor was good with the French toast. Finally, the chicken & waffle was good. I like how along with the maple syrup, there was an extra delicious and savory sauce that was paired with the chicken that I really liked. Overall, I love Four Chairs, and I highly recommend coming on a day that you can reserve. Otherwise, there is a HIGH chance that you might have to wait.

Came here for brunch with a group of friends. The service was fine they were just really busy at the time. everyone in my group seem satisfied with their meal, I had the chicken and waffles. It was not good. Whatever breading they use is not good the chicken was dry. And it was cold or lukewarm.not crispy . The waffle is just fine. But the Fried chicken is not good . It was like it was premade not fresh

Me and my friends went around 10am on a Monday. The wait was around an hour but well worth it. The service was great as well as the ambiance of the restaurant. As for the food, it was 10/10, overall a great stop to add to your visit in SF!

Got there around 10:10 on a Monday and it was already full and there was a line! Moves a bit slow but it's a small space so it was expected. My party of two waited a bit under an hour to be seated. Since it is small it can get loud but not so loud that you can't hear the people at your table. The drinks came out quickly, the food took a while but they were very busy. It was definitely worth the wait. The food was VERY tasty and priced well too! :) Sweet service as well. I'd definitely be back and recommend this place to anyone looking for a good brunch spot in SF.

Everything is so good!!! We didn't respect it's going to be busy on Monday. The line wasn't that bad but still busy. Our server(she) is really nice and gave us a good recommendation about drinks and food. Everyone works hard and fast on it. We'll be back for sure.

First time dining here, and it was me and my friends' San Francisco trip.

This place had good reviews on yelp so I thought why not. I don't regret my decision. The weight was worth it, and the food was delicious.!!!!

Highly recommend

Service was awesome - everyone was so nice & we were seated right away! Food was delicious. 100000000% recommend the k-bomb chicken benny. The scramble was also delicious. Volcano coffee was good too! Make sure to mix it! Thai tea was yummy, did not taste artificial so that's good. Ambiance was nice, it felt modern and not too loud even though it was busy. Would definitely come back a
Instagram worthy food but that's mostly about it. The food doesn't taste as good as it looks. Similar the drinks are lovely to look at but don't taste as good.

Fortunately was in the area because I was unfortunately dating someone who lived in SF (I SF) Wandered across this gem on one of my morning walks. Short wait. Very busy but decent service. Great menu. So happy I got the chicken and waffles. A ton of food but super tasty. All the food and drinks were very fresh and there is a great mood in the restaurant. Highly recommend.

I've only been once and there was an hour wait. I don't know that I would wait that long again. My chicken Apple sausage scramble was just okay. It lacked a little salt and flavor. I would try it again because it's in the neighborhood and popular and try something different next time.

It seemed like there was only one server working very hard so it was a little slow. But the drinks came out in a timely manner which is good. The place is quite loud when full.

I'll give it another shot.

I came with two friends for a Saturday brunch at 11am! Very busy but not a long wait because the restaurant is very big with lots of tables. A very great ambiance with friendly servers. Food came out very fast and was one of the best brunch spots in the city!!! My favorite was the house potatoes and all these "instagrammable drinks" were so delicious. Loved how unique the menu spread was.

Came in around 10:30 AM on Friday and there was only one other table there. The atmosphere and service was good. They have a table big enough to fit eight, so coming here with a group for early brunch would be cute.

The food itself can be a hit or a miss. I ordered a Four Chairs Benny and I enjoyed it. My friend who ordered the French Toast and Volcano Coffee did not like the food as much. The French toast had a hint of citrus in it, which he found odd. The volcano coffee was too thick and sticky on top, and just milk on the bottom. It was more aesthetic than tasty.

Well where do I start this review the service was pathetic, the server was rude( coming from a former server)even if the establishment is busy I think you should treat people well, to keep business coming.

The food was "good" the K- boom chicken was delicious, drinks were good but that's pretty much it. The lively omelette was disgusting with no flavor and the bread was burn and they still brought it to the table like that very disappointing .

Adding to the service I asked the server if you could take some plates out of the way so we could enjoy the dessert, this woman rolled her eyes and said she would call the busser honestly poor busser that has to endure their coworkers not helping out.

been seeing this spot all over my social media, and I'm so glad my family and I got to try this place together, because I can never just choose 1 item. So we went OUT, we chose their popular items! First off We added our names to the yelp waitlist on our phone, but even then the wait was like least then 10 minutes on a Saturday morning! How amazing is that. We were so indecisive in what to get but the staff was super patient with us, for drinks we got a variety, I got myself the volcano coffee, which is you were on tiktok during the covid times, this is also a replica of the dalgona coffee, the coffee while was bitter, but I loved it mixed in with the milk. My sister in law got the butterfly lychee, which was super refreshing and was amazingly so LYCHEE like. And then the Pinky Winky, was like a strawberry nesquik but even better, and all of these were non-alcoholic! I decided to go for two options that I ended up sharing with my significant other, Ive been on the scope out for the best french toast in the bay area, and this one was pretty good, the citrust french toast, light and fluffy yet flavorful with variety of fruits, the butter dollop was saaaalty, so i avoided using that. I also decided to the nova benny, i love myself salmon and cream cheese. My bf and his sister got the k-bomb chicken sandwich, which was masssssive!! They both loved it! Not too spicy for them. And their cousin got a chicken and waffle which is just a classic staple to get! Overall super good vibes, lots of people seem happy and having a good time, will definitely be back!
WOW!!! All I can tell you is... Their food is DELICIOUS!!!!!!! Their Volcano Coffee... Chef Kiss!

I ordered a bloody Mary and added bacon it was delicious! I also, ordered the original eggs Benedict and wanted fruit just like the picture on Instagram. The eggs Benedict needed just a little more sauce which tasted unique a little sweet. Service was quick and friendly. I did not wait long to be seated and I was able to quickly order what I wanted. I would recommend this place and plan to come back soon!

I been seeing this place all over social media so my close friend & I finally got ourselves over to try it. The place is very Instagram worthy and filling. We both got a speciality drink and one of their speciality dishes. The mascarpone pancakes were very filling. At first I was worried they would be way too sweet but it wasn't. I would say it's a a good balance of sweet without feeling like it is overly sweet. I recommend sharing however because dishes are big!

Came on a Friday night around 7:30pm and there was no wait! Only one server was working at the time, but we always felt taken care of and the food came out pretty fast!

Food: overall large portions that left us all full Yellowstone was super delicious, but the parata lamb was definitely my favorite dish! The lamb was perfectly medium rare, the curry was delicious (not too heavy), and the vegetables (sweet potato, asparagus, potatoes, green beans) perfectly balanced the meal.

Would come here again and so surprised that it wasn't busy on a Friday night! Definitely a local gem.

Holy moly! I mean yes Please! Service was great, atmosphere was perfect, not loud at all like some reviews had mentioned. The food! The food was amazing! Food ordered;
Chicken and Waffles 11/10,
Chipotle Benedict 10/10,
K-bomb Chicken Sandwich 10/10
Classic Cheeseburger 9/10
Volcano Coffee 10/10
Strawberry Lemonade 11/10

We will be back!

Love the presentation and the options for breakfast!
Pancakes are a must try.
Coffee was great too!

I've been here many times and this place is always so good! I got to try their brunch, lunch and even dinner. The servers are super friendly and always recognizing me since I started becoming a regular lol. It's super cute and cozy inside, I love how they have it asian styled but also Americanized.

The food from lamb chops, chicken and waffles, to even Benedict's being so good! I literally ate everything when it came to the lamb chops entree. The meat was so good and those veggies almost put me in a food coma lol. The chicken and waffles are so juicy and tender, they cook it perfectly! I love their benedicts, there's so many choices to choose from. My favorite is the nova benny.

When I came when it first opened, the beers used to be $3 each. I'm not sure if that's the same price but I'm almost positive it's still nearly as cheap. The banana waffle just tasted like home, my grandma used to make it and it reminds me of her. Everything that I've gotten from Four Chairs has never failed me.

I've been here three times and each time has always been a hit. This hidden gem is amazing! It's so cute inside, spacious, with lots of natural lighting.

The first time I came here, I got the chicken and waffle. The chicken and waffles were so crispy. The waffle was soft on the inside and the crispy on the out. The chicken needed a little more seasoning (add black pepper) but with perfectly well with that sweet waffle. I was on my lunch break from work so I got a Stella Artois with this.. lol. It was a great lunch so I knew I had to come back!

I was so excited about this place that I decided to dine in again, but this time for dinner. I'm a texture person, I was so afraid but my gut said to go with the parra lamb. Not pictured was a side of pita. Honestly, this dish was chef's kiss. That lamb went perfectly well with the curry. I was a little boozy so I didn't remember if the curry was a Thai style or an Indian style. This plate was the best lamb curry I have ever tried. This dish made me eat my carrots. And I don't even lunch carrots unless it's dipping with ranch. I had some leftovers and took it home for the next day. It taste even better the next day... I was like wow, this is a hit. Shout out to the chef! After my dinner, we decided to go with the crème brûlée and banana with waffles. This was such a sweet way to end the night. You can never go wrong with desserts. So yummy.

It was lunch time so I decided to come back since the pho restaurant was closed. I'm glad I came in because I got another good dish from this restaurant and it just doesn't stop. The smoked salmon was so good with the hollandaise. The side salad had a lemon vinegar flavor which went really good with bite of salmon and egg. I love a good salad. Those potatoes were so crispy, just how I like them. Sadly, when I left I forgot to pack my leftovers... Wish I went back but was running mate for work.

I've been here three times and every time, I've always had a Stella Artois on the side. The food went so well with my beer. The food is so good. I definitely recommend this restaurant to customers who come into my place of business down the street. Every time they come to pick up their car, they always thank me for recommending this place. This restaurant is the best place to have brunch and especially cause you can eat good for cheap/ affordable cost, i can't wait go for back again and explore the rest of their menu. Especially the dinner one!!

Excellent service, the servers are so kind, and highly skilled. They are so good at knowing what you need before you even notice. Water half way gone? Immediately filled. Coffee half way? Refilled before you even notice.

The food is excellent, ambiance is great. But the staff are so genuinely nice, and kindhearted. Come to this place. It is excellent!

We went on a Sunday and there was quite a wait (around 45 minutes). We debated going elsewhere but decided to brave the line with a mimosa from a nearby bar. When we finally got the call 45 minutes later we rushed back and were seated.

The interior is compact but nice with vaulted ceilings so it isn't uncomfortable or loud. For the hype this place gets, I was surprised at how reasonable the prices were. They had a large variety of breakfast staples, and we got the chicken and waffles and a chorizo scramble. We also ordered a couple iced coffee drinks of some kind on the recommendation of the next table.

It was all delicious and the portions were very fair. Substitutions are frowned upon and they remind you of this several times on the menu. So give the menu a pre-glanced and make sure there's something on there that you will enjoy as is.
Delicious!!! Love the food and environment. Great service! Arrived early and was seated immediately.

10/10!! Four Chairs was such a pleasant treat! The mango matcha latte was my favorite! The place was packed and our food came out super fast. I can't wait to come back and try something else on the menu.
We had a lovely and exquisite date. Recommended for all lovers. I ordered my food and drink.

The food was really good! Really nice portions and everything was tasty. The pancake definitely stole the show you. Everything was nicely portioned as well. The only problem was they burnt my girlfriends omelette just a tinyyyy bit and also there were way too many scallions but the other food definitely made up for it. The plating and service was exceptional as well. Nice vibes and everything

Okay so I've been here for brunch and dinner and all I can say is WOW!

Four Chairs is definitely a hidden gem in the Mission serving Asian fusion food.

Brunch - so yummy I ordered their Four Chairs Benedict and Chicken & Waffles and heart eyes EVERYWHERE! Also their Volcano coffee is chef's kiss.

Dinner - also very good! I love savory food more and their Yellowstone dish with their fried chicken and curry noodles was out of this world.

Such an amazing place to bring your loved ones for a memorable meal together:)

Always a bit of a sucker for brunch and especially an Asian fusion brunch moment. A cute little spot down Mission street, it's unassuming from the outside, but had a beautiful and clean interior. Decor is modern, wooden, and feels so home-y and comforting.

My friends and I tried a couple items, but the Chipotle Benedict was definitely a highlight. The egg was perfectly poached and everything was so flavorful. The potatoes were perfectly crispy (as they should be) and the salad had a yummy dressing with some hint of sesame oil in it.

Although we just stuck with water, we saw a bunch of other groups sharing their mimosa pitchers as well as some of the other beautiful drinks on their menu, would definitely try those if I were to go back!

Although the food was great, I have to say the service was quite subpar. It took quite a while for our server to come over to take our order, and even so when my friend ordered a side of avocado, it was forgotten and never came. After we were finished it took even longer to grab the check, eventually I just needed to flag her down to get her attention. We also saw the table next to us waiting for a while to get their check even though the table was fully cleared.

Overall, a very solid spot for brunch, definitely tasty but I think a title of Asian fusion is a bit generous, just the standard twist on breakfast classics. The service at the end left a bit of a sour taste, I'd recommend if you're near by, but nothing to make the trek for!
Have been here like hundred times already. One of my most favorite breakfast places in the city. Two of my favorite things: volcano coffee and k-bomb sandwich

The food is amazing , best spot for brunch . The service is good , you have to wait a few minutes to be seated but over all a good experience at four chairs . I always recommend to my friends and family to go try it .

This place is GARBAGE; from the food to the "Instagrammy" drinks.
Rude service; I just didn't enjoy myself at all.
And the food portions were so small; I thought it was a joke.

We got there at 11am on a Saturday. There's only street parking and we saw a few empty spots. Signed in on the Yelp wait list located inside the restaurant. Waited for about 40min, so the wait list was pretty accurate. Tables were very close to each other. You look at the menu by scanning the QR code on the table. We ordered the iced Volcano coffee with oatmilk (+$1), mascarpone Pancake and the Korean chicken eggs Benedict on ciabatta. The volcano coffee is what I would like to have again. It was creamy, little sweet, and good coffee flavor. The two entries looked pretty good. My sis and I shared the entrees. They were good, but nothing to rave about. We both agreed that trying once is good enough.

We came at ~1pm on a Sunday and had a short wait. There was a yelp waitlist, though, so next time I'd probably add myself to that to cut down waiting time when I come back at a busier time. The restaurant was packed when we came, but place itself has high ceilings and is very spacious, so the vibes were nice.

We were able to order quickly and got our food maybe 20-25 min after ordering.

The food was simple but really good! Portion sizes were also good. I was very full after having the Benedict. The volcano coffee was thick and sweet! The salad dressing that came with the greens was delicious! The potatoes were just seasoned with salt I believe, but were also good. Overall I liked the flavors of the leafy green Benedict. The one thing I didn't like was that the eggs were undercooked. The whites were still pretty runny, so I ended up not eating some of the Benedict. When I go back (which I definitely plan to), I'll bring that up and ask that the eggs be cooked so that the whites are all the way done and yolks are still runny.

All in all, really good experience! Tasty food that is priced similarly to other breakfast places in the area. Can't wait to come back and try something else.

First time here, and we will be coming back for another great experience.
We only waited for 15 minutes To be seated. The place was clean and full of people. The waiter was very nice and we had our drinks on our table really fast and the food also arrived fast and wow it was Delicious!
The only down part here is the parking and the area doesn't look pretty, clean or to safe.

My gf and I came here for Sunday Brunch on Easter. We had a reservation ahead of time but they weren't incredibly busy. Based on other reviews you may want to have one in case. Cool spot that has the ambiance for a nice brunch with friends or a dinner for date night.

I got Chicken and Waffles per usual here and we got a pitcher of Mimosa for the table bc its Easter and why not. Their food has Asian elements to it which is delightful. The chicken was bone in and tasted like it was panko crusted with a Sweet & Sour dipping sauce for it. The Waffle had a lemon on top of it with some syrup on the side. I loved my dish and you have to eat the chicken with the waffle in the same bite as its the only way to properly eat chicken & waffles.

I will say the service was a little slow as I believe thee was only 1 server working the entire restaurant. Perhaps they weren't expecting that many people on Easter and I imagine its not a big issue at other times. We really enjoyed our food and the vibes of Four Chairs. Will definitely return here for another delicious brunch.

Great good and service! Located conveniently on Mission, across the street from a other favorite Pizza Hacker.
Been for dinner twice and Brunch once.

Dinner
Yellowstone - great fried chicken and egg noodles with curry. Ordered both times, it was so good
Golden bags - tasty
Crying tiger- very tasty, but cooked more than the requested medium rare
The Signature - good, but prefer crying tiger or the rib eye alone
Octopus balls - very good!
Tofu steak - solid, but wouldn't order again
Shrimp pumpkin curry- really good! Spicy too


Brunch
Crispy chicken sandwich - absolutely delicious
Fries - perfectly crispy
This place is as good as it was a year ago. Still has the best friend chicken sandwich in the city. Still hella understaffed but waiters are nice and attentive when they make their rounds

Overall, this place was pretty good and comparable to the other aesthetic brunch spots in SF. Their drinks were definitely the highlight of our meal and everything we got was delicious, especially the hot thai tea and the volcano coffee. The benedicts were solid but the hollandaise sauce does lean on the more sour/tart side. The mascarpone pancakes were good too. If you go early and join the Yelp waitlist at ~9-9:30am, there was no wait for us on a Saturday. However, if you wait until 10-11am to go the place does get pretty busy. The service could have been better but overall we still enjoyed our meal. Would definitely recommend trying!

Used to be one of my go to brunch places, but this place became popular and with that the quality of food and service has both gone downhill significantly. The food is too sweet/unbalanced, the place is extremely loud and packed now, and the servers are always trying to push customers out after an hour or so. The last two times I was there the server came up to us and said that there are a lot of people waiting so would we mind vacating, even as I was still working on my drink. One time I could ignore but when it happened the 2nd time, it was too much. This place is just not worth the hassle. The older good reviews are just not applicable to this place anymore

Be sure to get here early , seating gets filled fast. Food was good I got the chicken and waffles which had great seasoning. Wifey got the crème brute french toast which was alittle sweet but still good.
The French Toast is so good. Usually I find these things too sweet but it wasn't. I think it was because of the vanilla custard.

I went here with my family because I saw the pictures on yelp and I was pretty disappointed when I bit into my food. I feel catfished⁉ in a way. My omelet had no flavor and was pretty underwhelming and the burgers we're just not seasoned at all. To prove that I didn't have covid and couldn't taste, I had my parents try everything as well and they agreed. This place is good for aesthetics and yes they do make their food look really good but for taste it's simply not it.
Great brunch! Tasty selections. Excellent service. Perfect for small groups (we were six). Would definitely go again.

was super impressed by this place! it's a bit out of the way in the south part of the mission, but worth the trek out. overall, the food was delicious, the portions were great, and the prices were good (much cheaper than other mainstream spots in the city).

we tried their special, the KFC Benedict, and it was so good. the chicken itself was juicy and crispy, while the sauce was that perfect Korean blend of sweet, sour, and spicy. the interior was beautiful & comfortable and the servers were attentive.

definitely recommend coming out here for a well-priced, comfortable, delicious brunch!

food: 9.8/10
- AFFORDABLE, flavorful, perfect sized portions, colorful
- drinks are delicious and pretty

ambiance 7.5/10
- tight areas
- small room, so it gets really stuffy and hot
- not too loud

service 6.5/10
- they don't open their yelp waitlist on the app so we had to go add in our names in person then waited 45ish min for a table of 3
- waited 10 min before being greeted by our waiter
- food came out in 15
- nice workers
- service could be better but the food makes it worth the wait

I had the chicken and waffles and was disappointed...I hate when places precook they're fried chicken!!!! If your not going to do it right, please don't do it at all!!! Stop being lazy or greedy???
Your waffle was good but the chicken was dry and tough because it was precooked!!!! People will wait 20 min for quality! I gave 2 stars because staff was polite
Great food. Waitress was awesome and insightful. Would definitely go back again for the potatoes.

Went to Four Chains and the interior was spacious but there was a decently long wait. I would say it was worth the wait! Very unique brunch place with a fusion of items. Would recommend coming early because the line was insanely long by the time that we left.

Rating the food items we tried:
- Butterfly lychee 7/10 - the drink was good but sweet and I wasn't able to finish it.
- Mango matcha latte 9/10 - I really liked the mango hint in the matcha drink. I actually prefer this drink to other matcha latte's that I've gotten at cafes. One thing I would have asked for is less sweetness.
- Chipotle Benedict 8/10 - Was very flavorful but also just enjoyed the k-bomb Benny much more. This was comparable to other eggs Benedict I've had.
- K-bomb benny 10/10 - Rating this restaurant as 5 stars specifically because of this item. Was a perfect brunch meal with soft eggs on the toast, salad, and then Korean fried chicken. One of the best brunch meals I've had in SF. Will be going back just to get it.

We went on a Sunday and it was pretty busy so we waited around 30 minutes, not too bad for the bay! The space is very lively and the area is decent for the city. The food was very delicious although the pancakes did come out smaller than we expected nonetheless they were very tasty. Altogether it was a pleasant experience and a cute brunch spot!
Crème brûlée French toast is the best thing ever!! It was so delicious I would come back again just for that
Lovely ambience. Good food and drinks. Wait was not too bad, but waiting for food and check was long.
Food is great fast and prices not bad at all BUT FOOD IS COLD :( EGGS OVER COOKED am sure they can do better:)

Came here for my birthday brunch and it Did not disappoint!! As you can see, the pics came out so IG worthy and tasted delicious as well!! The price was also extremely affordable and service was all around amazing.

Made a reservation for brunch and did not disappoint. The service was fast and efficient. We ordered the bottle for mimosas with two juices. Great presentation.
The chicken and waffles was so good. The chicken was fresh and crunchy. The waffle was flavorful.

Will definitely go back again!

great food!! this place was super aesthetic, they even have a spot on the menu called "instagrammable drinks." i loved it! only downside was there's just so many people in a confined space, but the restaurant is just THAT popular!
My favorite! Food is amazing, service is always great. No long wait times. We come here frequently and everything is always perfect.

Grabbed dinner here on a Saturday night. Food was absolutely delicious! Looking forward to coming back to try out brunch.

We had the following tapas: golden bags, tofu steak, and ceviche mixto. All were great, but the standouts are the entrees.

We shared the following entries items: Yellowstone, the signature and pumpkin curry. The fried chicken in the Yellowstone with the curry was perfectly fried and juicy inside. I haven't had anything like it before. The steak and coconut rice in the signature was also amazing.

Amazing food, service, and value. Coming from Denver, we are used to random additional charges (kitchen fee, server fee, municipality fee) in addition to insane prices, taxes, and tip demands. This restaurant had none of that. Service was friendly, quick, and generally fantastic. Can't say enough about food quality either. Large portion size and amazing flavor.

Amazing! I was watching as the server placed my friends' meals in front of them, sad that I ordered a salad (have to stick to my Keto) but once I took the first bite, my eyes widened cause this salad is the sh*t! Flavorful, creamy, the perfect ratio of avocado to grilled chicken. I'm writing this review as I am eating because this could not wait! My friends are all enjoying their meals- the Benedicts and the marscapone pancakes, delicious! We ordered drinks also and had ordered alcohol to be added. The butterfly lychee, mango tango, volcano coffee, and I ordered the Pinky Winky which I requested soju to be added! Apparently it's never been done before and the server had me name it, so if you wanna try it, which you should cause it's DELICIOUS- order the Freaky Winky ;) You're welcome ahead of time!
long line but the food was good. came at 1pm on juneteenth and got in at 1:50 ish. despite the long wait the servers took our order promptly. bathroom is clean!

Highly recommend this place! It's a new restaurant and their breakfast menu caught my eye. They still have a soft opening sign outside their place. The ambiance is so nice and modern and they play great music to match the vibes lol.

But for the food: my bf and I got the French toast and four chairs Benny to share. I know there are a lot of brunch places in sf that is pretty similar (Blackwood, kitchen story, qnd sweet maple). The four chairs Benny had that millionaire bacon that those other brunch places had but I found four chairs to be a tiny bit sweeter which I liked to balance out the saltiness of the dish. And their bacon isn't hard to chew as some other millionare bacon I've tried. It actually had a good texture to it. The French toast had a citrus hint and slightly chewy which I prefer and enjoyed. It also had fresh fruit on it also.

Overall I would recommend this place as a new brunch spot to check out. Vibes, ambiance, good food and good drinks (they even gave us dalgona coffee as service!!). Definitely check this place out!

Metered parking in front and 2 hour street parking Mon-Fri a few blocks down

Stopped by last weekend for a last minute brunch. We got there towards the end of their lunch hours so it had started to get less busy. We were seated within a couple minutes after but somehow they forgot to send someone to attend to us for a while as the servers were busy wrapping up the service. I had looked at the reviews beforehand and were really wanting to try the Four chairs bacon which I was told is no longer on the menu so that was a tiny bit of a bummer. I ended up ordering Chipotle Benedict and my friend got their new Korean fried chicken sandwich. He also got the volcano coffee which is a kind of Dalgona coffee if you've ever had. The cup was full to the brim so it was hard to stir the foam into rest of the drink without spilling. The breakfast potatoes with the eggs were fantastic and so was the chipotle sauce. My friend also like his sandwich which was a tiny bit on the sweeter side. Overall, the food was good and staff was courteous. Restaurant is well spaced and decor was simple but pleasing.

Came from out of town & this place gets packed in the afternoon. We waited about 20 mins. I loved the kbomb Benny 10/10 for sure!! The fusion was well down between Korean and American food. I can never finish a full plate but this was definitely a first for me to push myself to finish it because it was that GOOD.

My bf got the Chipotle Benny which he rated 7/10 bc it was like any other egg Benedict. However, you cannot go wrong with this one.

I paired my meal with the lychee drink & it reminded me of the jelly lychees that I ate as a kid. Not overly sweet & easy to drink! 10/10

We loved it so much we came back the next morning before opening & there was no wait for the hour we were there.
Literally the best brunch I have ever had. It was fast service, clean atmosphere , and the meal was 10 out of 10!!!

Delicious Brunch. Amazing dishes, very creative chef.
Best brunch we had in a long time.
Great and friendly service.
Specialty drinks worth it.

We had a nice time at weekday brunch. The dalgona coffee is a must- it was a highlight. I tried my friend's pancakes and those were also great. The Korean fried chicken Benny was pretty good, and I enjoyed it but it wasn't so memorable. My other friend's chicken and waffles- the waffles were a 10/10 light and airy and crispy, but the chicken a 5/10 due to really lacking in flavor. Overall would come again!

food was good the only issue i had was the service. the waiters were constantly coming to ask us if everything was ok and kept creeping up behind my boyfriend. then before we were even done eating they handed us the bill as if they were in a rush to get us out of there. i enjoyed my meal but i would not come back

Blast of flavor! Asian Fusion food done right! Service is fantastic and if there is a better, more descriptive word than fantastic then I would use that for the flavor explosion in my mouth for every bite I took. The atmosphere (you know, the ambiance) was exactly what I was looking for when eating dinner with my wife. The restaurant is called Four Chairs, but I don't think there were even four chairs that were empty. This spot is that good. I recommend you go, eat, and then try to tell me (with honesty) my review is wrong.
I can't wait to go back.

This place was super cute. We didn't have to wait and were seated right away. We came around 10am on a Sunday and was surprised it wasn't packed yet.

French Toast: Super good and thick. It had a hint of citrus flavor to the French toast, but it wasn't too strong. It really balanced out with the fruit.

Four Chairs Benny: The bacon was thick and huge! It wasn't salty at all. The potatoes were super crispy, which I really liked. The only downside is it didn't have any seasoning, but the crispness made up for it.

Mango Tango: The drink wasn't too sweet and was very refreshing. It was a bit carbonated, but not like a soda. The mango bits in it were good.

I love coming to this hidden Gem when I visit the Bay. There is no long wait for a table, you get seated right away. They are busy during the weekend but no long waits. It's the perfect place to enjoy brunch with your loved ones. The food is phenomenal you must try the chicken and waffles. Parking is easily found within a block's distance or at the Safeway store. Customer service is great and very clean place. Very simple place with amazing food.

I went on Christmas so it was quite lively which was nice. Menu is electronic. The coffee was interesting since it's whipped; flavor was good. The k-bomb chicken benny was kind of chaotic as the plate had different flavors. I enjoyed the very crispy potatoes. Decent spot for a filling brunch!
Great food and great service. The only complaint is the very long wait for a table, and also that the Yelp waitlist functionally seems to be hit or miss.
Wait was worth it. Service was good, our party got seating in a timely manner, very organized for promising a party of 10. Vegan options! Quality food. Aesthetically pleasing.

Hands down, it was the best dining experience. The atmosphere was nice and comfy. Very spacey and Love all the decorations. Our server was very friendly and made us feel warm welcome . The food and presentation, as you may expect, was spectacular.

Overall, we had an astounding time and this experience definitely changed the way we view food. I feel love every single dish that we had. Thank you to the chef and all the staff that provide the best experience and the service.

If you ever get a chance to visit this restaurant, I say go for it as it is an unforgettable experience.
Very crowded on weekends for brunch. Tasty food and decent service. A short walk from our daughter's condo so we will be back.
Decent food just south of the Mission area of San Francisco. Almost always a waiting line and I don't think they take reservations. Sunday brunch is espcecially usy.
All the above....it was worth the wait & food was scrumptious delicious only minor problem "parking" other than that service was will be back
DELICIOUS BREAKFAST!!!!! Fast service. I drive 16 miles to eat breakfast here. Georgia girl here and this is the exact southern breakfast I love!!!

Their famous colorful drinks are to die for. Many brunch options from your classic eggs benny to French toast. Love the vibe and ig worthy place. Service could be improved with faster service and more check-ins with customers.

A great spot to have breakfast if you're in the neighborhood and looking for elevated breakfast fare. We had friends meeting us who had a layover at SFO and we appreciated their flexibility in letting us get seated early to order for them. They have a 90-minute limit, but are reasonable and allow you to enjoy your meal without feeling rushed. The Loco Plato omelette was outstanding - great presentation and the shrimp were fresh. We didn't love the Volcano coffee. The whipped cream ratio was overpowering and it seemed that there was maybe 25% coffee. It's also incredibly sweet - so we'd definitely pass on that in the future. Overall, a good breakfast and no reason to not give it 5-stars despite us not prioritizing a return!
The food is amazing and very aesthetically appealing, although I'm not sure how the service works in this place. It's really hard to get a hold of someone to order from

4.5 STARS

Soft opening stage still but I was definitely impressed!! Seems like they do brunch for the first half of the day then close and switch over to an Asian fusion dinner menu at night. We went on a Saturday night around 8pm and only one other table around. Although I do believe this place will be craaaazy busy once word gets out, I was delighted to eat indoors with only one other table and I appreciate the well spread out layout. Was pleasantly greeted and seated upon entry, however one suggestion I would make though is to check vaccine cards as it says on their Yelp page!

Anyways, I got to order the Four's Company as my main entree and it was sooo delicious!! Shrimp, mussel, scallop and calamari with coconut sauce and coconut RICE for a coconut and seafood lover like myself, THIS was perfectttt! My partner also got something with coconut, so I cannot speak on behalf of the other main dishes, but we were both fans of their coconut dishes and cant wait to come back to try the other items. As a millennial, I also enjoyed the presentation as everything was well plated. The ambiance was dim and light, calm easy music playing. Service was warm and friendly.

It must be difficult opening a new restaurant in SF during a pandemic, but I believe this place has a lot of potential! If you're thinking of going, please do try them out! Even if it's to go orders :)

Earlier today we decided to try out Four Chairs Restaurant. They recently had a soft opening on Jan 2 2022. Since we made a reservation we didn't have to wait to be seated.

The restaurant has a swanky cozy vibe. We tried :
Mocktails: Lychee Butterfly and Mango Tango - both were refreshing and not overly sweet or tart.

Chicken and waffles - Solid dish came with a side of little pot of maple syrup and sriracha Mayo dip.

Four chairs omelette, served with home fries and a slice of ciabatta toast.

Overall a great meal and we will definitely come back and try their dinner options.

No reservations over the weekend but it was super quick and easy to just put your name down and wait. It went by quicker than the expected wait time which was pretty cool. Food came out pretty quickly and it was aesthetic but already cold by the time it got to us. Portion size is good and the staff is friendly, I'd come again!
the place was cozy and cute. very good food it was also pretty unique. They make a perfect matcha

What an incredibly romantic and cozy restaurant and hidden gem here in the town.

Now, let me get to the food!!!

Every single item we ordered from the menu was spot on and felt specially curated. This is not your average Asian fusion food. This is an authentic meal with rich flavors and fresh ingredients. Here are my recommendations for ordering..

Summer Rolls: These plant based summer rolls were so fresh and tasty. Fresh cut veggies and a peanut sauce have this appetizer a WOW effect. This is enough to share between 2-4 people, it's a must imo!!

Thai Iced Tea: This was just delicious and very creamy Yum!!

Candy Calamari : DELICIOUS and nuanced. This was a perfect tapas ever.

By the bay : This is what my entrée . I loved every bite of it and finished it with relish. Salmon was fresh and perfectly cooked with flavorful white wine creamsauce . I really love it .

Okonomiyaki fries : impulse decision because we were hungry and saw another table order it. They were the perfect amount of sauce

I highly recommend this restaurant if you're looking to have Romantic night out or want to try delicious American Asian fusion food. Enjoy!!

Had a great time here ! I recommend making reservations before hand to avoid the wait line . Once you get there you check in and let them know you've arrived and get seated within seconds ! The food was really good and flavorful !! Recommend the French toast to share for the table or the pancakes ! Definitely won't disappoint! The k chicken benny was delish , chicken served on the side bread was not too thin or thick ! Burger was well fried and seasoned and the chx & waffles !! To die for . The waffles were crunchy on the outside yet soft and fluffy on the inside ! They give you a syrup & sweet & spicy sauce as well ! Iced drinks are also very refreshing although on the sweeter side ; which I don't mind . But keep that in mind if you don't like your drinks too sweet . Overall will be back ! The place is not too big and some of the ya les are a little close together . On a hot day like today it can get stuffy so I recommend sitting by the windows.
good ambiance and service. we got the chicken and waffles and they were nothing special. i got the matcha mango drink and did not like it at all, but it was very pretty.

Came here around 11:30 on a Sunday - there wasn't a wait bc we joined the waitlist 15 min before we got there. I got the Volcano Coffee and K-bomb Benny for my meal! As pictured, the dishes are all very beautifully presented - including the drinks. The coffee though was a little hard to mix since it just kept spilling over the cup :') but it tasted super yummy. As for the k bomb Benny, the potato and salad on the side were pretty good and the chicken was tender as well. The okonomiyaki fries were good, but idk if it's really worth $10 unless you're splitting with a group of 4 like we did. Overall, the food was good but not necessarily amazing or exceptional - I would bring a friend here for the vibez though for sure. Rating overall - 7.5/10

The chicken and waffles are my favorite. Everything on the menu is good especially the drinks. Most importantly the service is great. If you have questions about the menu they will be happy to answer. If you decide to go on a weekend, make sure you make reservations.
The wait was pretty long but always worth it. This is my second time here and it did not disappoint! I love the volcano coffee, service was great and efficient!
10/10 definitely check out!!! waitlist went by fast and omg the pictures speak for themselves. food and drinks were very flavorful as well!!!

First time in San Francisco. This place was highly recommended and it was really good. Pricing is a bit high, just keep that in mind. Waiting time wasn't long at all. Highly recommend the pancakes and volcano coffee. Really good but not out of this world amazing! The environment there was friendly, service took awhile for us. As well as waiting for food.
Best breakfast food I ever had, if your ever in San Francisco you must give this place a try
Well worth the wait. The creme brûlée French toast is incredible. I had never had beef bacon, but I liked it.

We had to try it at least once. Luckily, we made reservations for 10:30 am. brunch on a Friday morning . Surprisingly, the establishment was packed. An hour later, there was a waiting line outside the door. Our initial impressions were positive. The menu offered many choices, but we decided to share 2 breakfast specials; fried chicken and waffles, and creme burlee french toast. Btw: i like lychee, so also ordered the butterfly lychee drink. The french toast was oustanding. I was expecting buttermilk brined fried chicken with waffles, but expectations did not match reality. It was good but IMHO, it was outclassed by the french toast. We also noticed from previous Yelp reviews, that dinner was served. Their hours are now limited to mornings and afternoons. I'm assuming that their success now dictates fewer hours for the same profitability? If you hate lines, I would highly recommend reservations! We will return soon and expand and taste other notable menu items we missed.
Good stuff! Eggs Benedict with 3 poached eggs. Where can you go wrong with breakfast like that? We drove south from Sonoma County based on the reviews. It didn't disappoint.

Kept seeing Four Chairs on TikTok -- so yes, we gave in and had to try it. We went about 45 minutes after open and got seated immediately. Not even 10 minutes after we sat down did the line begin -- I cannot imagine how busy this place is on a weekend. Food was AMAZING!!

Food is spot on absolutely fresh and amazing flavor. I ordered the French toast which was the lightest crispy is French toast I have ever had it needed very little maple syrup. It was top with fresh fruit which made it even better. I could've skipped the turkey ham. It was on the dry side. I also ordered the salmon omelette, smoked salmon omelette, my omelette was over cooked. I was a little disappointed in that however, I would definitely be back you must try the earl grey tea. It is superb looked it up on Amazon. It's rather pricey and I understand why my husband had the chicken and waffles he was happy as well. The place was very clean. Service was fast friendly reasonably priced. Good location, I do suggest trying to get there as soon as they open because they fill up fast. This is a neighborhood Jewel one thing I would like to suggest is that they add Crystal hot sauce. You cannot have fried chicken and not half crystal hot sauce Tapatío just does not do it, nor Tabasco.

The food is great but the matcha strawberry kinda tasted weird like there was barely any strawberry taste. It was more matcha than strawberry. I also enjoyed the service cause it's fast and the servers were easy to talk to. The overall layout of the restaurant was nice too, kinda wish the place was bigger because of how popular it is. Parking there is a pain but other than that the restaurant is nice and would go again by bus or Uber.

hi my name is paulina and i just wanted to say i really enjoyed this meal, as a kid i was forced to eat dirt because we were really poor and that is all we could afford and eating this really opened up my mind about the food around me and the impact it truly has on other people. Also i made that story up but for reals though the food was good so come.

My first time and it won't be my last. I've been telling coworkers and friends about the food,
Excellent excellent excellent .
Highly recommend! Food was great for a brunch spot in the morning. Wait time can vary depending on the days but they attend fast. Great customer service and everyone is so nice.
The volcano coffee was incredible and the cafe is really cute. Would definitely recommend if you are in the area.

My new favorite lunch spot! Came today with a friend and service was fast and food was exceptional. The chicken and waffle was much larger than expected and the batter was so crispy and light! The French toast was good but not as good as the chicken and waffle. The waitress was extremely attentive and filled my coffee multiple times before I was even done with my cup. Would absolutely return time and time again

a very cute brunch spot in san francisco. they have a good variety of selection on their menu. we came for a weekday brunch and there was no wait time. would definitely want to return to try their drinks.

The space is beautiful and it was great to pop into a brunch spot on 10:30 on a Saturday and not have to wait in line for an hour. However, I'm not in a rush to come back to Four Chairs.
What we ordered:
Chicken & Waffles: We enjoyed the waffle a lot. The chicken skin was nice and crispy but the meat didn't have much flavor. They provided a chili sauce that helped a lot.
Chicken apple scramble: The sausage in this had a really chewy and grainy texture, and the eggs came out lukewarm. The potatoes that were served with it were just bad. Maybe they mixed up the salt shaker with sugar? They tasted like they had been doused in sugar and had the weirdest fruity flavor to them. While they were fried perfectly, the flavor was just wrong and I didn't want to eat them.
Yummy. I was looking for takeout but decided to sit and eat. They did not disappoint.

Great service! We called ahead and we're told there was no wait. Walked in and requested a window seat but a couple ahead of us had already been promised the seat. We figured that's definitely fair.

I ordered the house eggs benny, with a side of French toast,and the volcano latte My friend ordered the volcano latte, as well, along with her food. Not only was the food and the service incredible, they comp'ed us one of the volcanoes.

The place has a wonderful setting, even on a stormy and gloomy morning.

I highly recommend this spot; I'll definitely be going back!!!

It has most of what's expected for a brunch place. Nice crowds, the day we were there the place might have been under staffed so the staff were working hard to make sure everyone was being taking care of. Personally I do not care the water bottle, condiments, and utensils on the table. The food was tasty.

The perfect spot for BRUNCH! I got the chicken and waffles and my friend got the french toast. We also tried the lychee drink (MUST TRY), and the volcano coffee. Waffles were so good and the friend chicken very flavorful and crunch. The lychee drink was also very refreshing, tasted like lychee and rose water.

I love the food! The butterfly pea lychee drink, the pancake, chicken and waffle and the burgers are really good. Everything on menu is great and there isn't a wrong choice. Service is amazing and quick. Its not a big restaurant but the seating and lighting is decent. Favorite brunch spot in SF!
Great brunch, I got the K Bomb Benny. The place tends to get very busy so be prepared to wait in line!
we come every single time we're in the area! quick service happy welcoming staff and AMAZING FOOD! highly recommend

This place is fantastic. It's clean, the food is good and very fresh. Terrific truffle omelet and my partner had a veg Benedict with Meyer Lemon Hollandaise, which was excellent. I loved that they had a beautiful assortment of fruits. Service was friendly and fast. What would I change? To make it 5 star for me- would be more veg options and to have sourdough bread! And an espresso machine maybe or at least English Breakfast tea.

I stumbled upon Four Chairs after seeing it on Tik Tok and I'm glad I decided to give it a try. Unlike most brunch places, Four Chairs accepts reservations, its a nice open space you don't feel super cramped. The prices are pretty reasonable. The drinks are very aesthetic and taste great. Food is solid.

overall i think the aesthetics take over the actual food taste. it's absolutely beautiful from the inside and definitely very "instagrammable". i decided to get the french toast w/o the crème brûlée, the bread itself was incredibly dry and didn't taste like much. just pure bread. also the french toast came with just the french toast. had to order the bacon on the side. my husbands eggs benedict came on just one piece of bread instead of their usual two. the people working were really sweet and didn't rush us at all. food came out pretty rapidly. solid 6/10
Was very good we had French toast and chicken waffles both delicious definitely the I'll come here again
Good food chicken waffle delicious and fr much toast was good definitely will go again
Tried to go here turned away at 2:15 when clearly on the door closing is at 2:30, I even asked for to go order and still refused. After hearing how they rush people out I will not bother to return.

Yes yes yes! If you have been wondering if you should come here....COME! Service was great even though there were only 2 servers! They did awesome! The vibe of this place is top tier as well. Drinks and food came quick and was delicious. Will be back here when I'm in the city again

The food is great in this place! My new favorite brunch spot in San Francisco! Totally recommend you check it out for their famous and delicious chicken and waffles but try to avoid coming in after 2pm on weekends because it gets really busy and the waitlist could take about 30-40 minutes waiting time to be seated! The ambience is great and relatively loud, but not so much that you can't have a conversation. Definitely recommend to come here way ahead of time to avoid waiting an hour or more to be seated and served for your food. I think their organization and prioritization for serving food needs more work. Since the tables have no numbers, It seems that they served people who were here later than us a lot faster.
The food was amazing. It's such an unassuming look from the street but once you walk in it's a vibrant atmosphere with great people.

In my single visit, Four Chairs demonstrated why it has nearly five stars. When I arrived, I found that the host had held my spot in the Yelp line even though I was somewhat late. The restaurant is a pleasant, open space and was not overly crowded.

I ordered the Leafy Green Benedict. It was not perfect, but, overall, it was the best florentine benedict I have had. The Meyer lemon Hollandaise sauce is a huge improvement over the typical version, which does not thrill me. The flavor of the eggs and biscuit was enhanced by well-seasoned spinach and slightly cooked grape tomatoes, as well as fresh parsley. On the side were crispy, delicious home fries and a little salad with an excellent sesame dressing. As for the imperfections, my poached eggs were just slightly undercooked relative to my preference and the restaurant standard, and the regular, drip coffee is an over-roasted variety.

We went on a holiday and there was quite a bit of wait. We ordered the scrambled egg and french toast; they were both great. The customer service was amazing with friendly and responsive staff. The volcano coffee was basically Dalgona coffee and it tastes great, a little on the sweeter side but I was in love with the strong coffee flavor.

Lemonade and the waffles were sooo good!! chicken was alright but the pieces were HUGE def made it worth the price. This is really the place for brunch because they accommodate to every palette I already cant wait to come back.
Went during the week and were seated right away. Service was good and food was great, worth checking out.
Excellent service and food. We had the chicken & waffle and the chipotle eggs Benedict. The atmosphere is lively and looks nice as well as very clean!

We were visiting SF and wanted to grab some breakfast/Brunch. The wait was not long got there before 12pm, it got pretty crowded and the service was a little slow. The food was great! The chicken and waffle were just okay. The non alcoholic specialty drinks was good see pictures. Our server was nice, but disappeared several times. I really enjoyed the experience and foocan't wait to go again

5 STARS ALL THE WAY!!! I've been here for dinner 3x and they never disappoint me/us! I recommended this restaurant to my friends & family and they loved it! Will definitely keep coming back. I honestly don't know why it's always empty whenever we come here. I think that this place deserves more customers!!!

The waiter named Pun is so nice!! :)

This place has been an excellent addition to the neighborhood! Really tasty food and drinks! Friendly and attentive staff. I have not waited in the long line that is typically present. I went during the week towards the end of their service. Got a nice table by the window. Food was really, really good so we'll be back!
Great eggs benedict best I've had so far, freshly made orange juice not the carton stuff.
The food was good and the ambience is great except for the long lines of waiting. But pancakes is amazing

"We went there for the brunch on Sunday morning around 12pm as a group of 10 people. The restaurant was really flexible in terms of the change in the number of people and some of us were really late to the brunch but they seated at the long table so everyone can join with no problems. The menu was pretty big with all sorts of typical brunch items such as scrambles, omelets, egg benedicts, waffles, french toast etc. and we all got different dishes. All the dishes looked good and were nicely plated - especially the fruit pancake and the fried chicken waffle! The taste was also good and I liked how the muffin for the benedict was not too thick and too much filling so that I could enjoy the entire dish. I also liked how the side was also not only potatoes and it came with fruits and salad, which you usually have to ask (and sometimes pay) for the alternate.
Some of us also ordered drinks including the classic bottomless mimosas which came with cute flower with stylish bottle. The orange juice for the mixer came with separate bottle so be careful not to drink just straight champaign! The other drinks like thai tea and butterfly pea lychee tea was also good - maybe it could be less sweet.
Finally, the ambience was really good too with very bright and open space, comprehensive furnitures and wall decorations. I was actually really surprised that this place is not that well-known (maybe because of the location which is a little far from the downtown mission) and this could definitely be one of the popular brunch spots for 20s ladies."

We bumped into this restaurant and decided to give it a try. We ordered many dishes which I couldn't remember them all( I took a few pictures of them) They were all surprisingly good. Overall a great experience with the food and the staff was very nice and attentive. Highly recommended!

This place did not disappoint, I can't wait to come back. Absolutely everything we had was incredible. I don't know how they made home style potatoes taste so good. Run dont walk to this place. And have the coffee drink

Four chairs is slowly becoming my favorite brunch place. It's my third time coming here and this review is definitely delayed. We came on Sunday at 1:30 and it was about a 10 minute wait.
