We ordered the mango tango, volcano coffee, kbomb chicken benny, and portobello chicken sandwich. The food and drinks are always consistent and come out very quickly. The non coffee drinks do tend to err on the sweeter side. The portions are also quite reasonable for the price and I always have leftovers. The servers are attentive and they always ask if everything is ok during the middle of the meal. The music is not too loud and its overall has great vibe for brunch.

We came at 10:45 AM on Sunday and there was no line, but there was a really long line shortly after. Our whole party needed to be there to be seated, which was understandable. The food was really good but I wish the mimosa pitcher came with more OJ! Service was great and I understood that they were trying to get people in and out for others waiting, and I didn't feel overly rushed. With drinks, it's pricier, but solid brunch food.

Came here for a quick brunch since we were in the Mission District. Overall, the experience was pretty mediocre. I was expecting the food to be more fresh. But feel free to check out my ratings on the below. I would come out and try out the lunch/dinner, heard it's amazing.

Ambiance: 6.8/10- wonderful lighting. seating is great as well. Good for small parties and couples

Food: 5.8/10 - ordered chipotle eggs benedict and french toast. The french toast was pretty dry, it had too much of an orange zest flavor to it. The benedict was the best out of the two. Unfortunately, it was cold.

Service: 4/5 - server was great!

Went this afternoon around 12pm. Was seated immediately for a table of 3. First off who told them it was ok to have such a beautiful ass restaurant. Love the decor and the space. Was served by a friendly waitress with a pleasant smile. She took out order and we received our food 20 mins later. More people came in including a party of 6. The food was very good and unique. Beautiful plating and presentation. The shocker was when I was heading to the restroom I looked in the kitchen and there was only one chef. I gotta give this man a cause he literally made all our food fast and efficient. Even my husband was satisfied and he's a chef whom is rarely satisfied when we eat out. The food was great. I would definitely be going back. 14R, 49 goes right by this eatery

Came here for new year morning brunch , very good food , extremely tasty and Fresh.
Reservation through Yelp is recommended
Otherwise big wait.
We were very happy with the service.

Great drinks, great food.. I've been thinking about their pancakes since.

You aren't able to make reservations, but if you can get on their yelp waitlist early, it should be ok
Good food with an intsagramable twist! Service Good /fun experience overall. It was pretty busy for a Friday afternoon.

I guess I allowed the name of the place to influence my thoughts on what the space would be like, I imagined a small cozy cafe where my cousin and I could chat and catch up with each other. but... It's more like a hundred chair cafe with an incredible amount of people packed into a small space. It was too loud to talk. The food was average. We won't be going back.

Did they run out of salt?

I didn't realize the only bacon they had was the millionaires style bacon, which ends up leaving a coat of sugary mess on everything, including my tongue. It's terrible sweet when you don't use salt.

Also, I don't want undercooked sweet bacon.

I thought the lack of flavor might have been a one time incident with this restaurant, but after reading other reviews, it seems like salt is not a common used spice at this location.

Quality of ingredients and the actual presentation was fine. Just please get some salt.
The food is good but definitely isn't worth the price! Nice decor but tables were cramped together, barely any room to move around. Servers were friendly.
The pancake was not sweet. Just the right amount of cream. Butterfly Lychee was nice but too much ice. Service was okay. Only two servers for the whole restaurant on a Monday midday.

The food was very delicious! I ordered the southwest scramble and the serving size was enough to get you full but not stuffed, which is good. The potatoes that came with the scramble were nice and soft, not dry at all. I ordered the volcano coffee and boyyyy is it strong! Once I mixed it together, the flavor was consistent.

Excellent spot! Food tasted as good as it looked and service was great too. The Chipotle Benedict and French toast is some of the best I have had. It's usually a feat to finish brunch at most spots because portions are huge but we managed to here as everything tasted amazing. The dressing on the salad was distinctive and I really liked the sauce on the benedict, it was spicy! Also loved the zest from the lemons in the french toast, it was fragrant and had a solid citrus punch on each bite. The only negative was the maple syrup, it felt basic and not of the highest quality. Service was quick.

Way too pricey for what they serve, pictures on Google where misleading. But I enjoyed my first time having eggs Benedict. I would have to really be wanting them to go back. Service was ok we didn't get a pitcher of water like other tables. Ambiance was quiet, clean place.

Amazing service and food was extremely delicious. Food was aesthetically dressed but don't let that fool you because the food was just as great. The ambiance is very relaxing. I ordered a crispy chicken sandwich and house coffee was really good too (I know weird combination).
This one is one of my favorite best place for chicken and waffles matcha latte mimosas but my top two are definitely the beef bacon and the breakfast potato's!
The food was delicious! The service was fast, I would definitely go again. I tried something new, whipped coffee and now if I see it on a menu anywhere I will order it.

The food was okay and the servers seemed really overwhelmed. Everything except the drinks came out really fast. It's a trendy food spot right now but would be surprised if they had any true regulars. There's much better places in SF

Best chicken and waffles I've ever had! We picked this spot randomly one day and I am so happy we did. The chicken was fried to perfection. The waffle was light and airy. I was so surprised at how delicious everything was. We had to wait a bit for a table which was annoying but once the food came I completely forgot all about the wait. Definitely try the chicken and waffles if you go!!

Delicious food with no need of a reservation! My family newly moved to the Bernal heights area and this place is so cute and close to that area. The food is fresh and authentic with lots of options for vegetarians. I think the most famous section here are the drinks! All the way from fresh mimosas to cool fusion lemonades to even their volcano coffees, the drink section is a must. Try this cute spot out!

Four Chairs is a new restaurant in Bernal serving American brunch during the day and Asian fusion dinner by night. I've been here for both brunch and dinner and they have tasty options for any time of the day.

On my first visit we came for dinner, it was pretty easy to walk in and grab a table for two. We ordered a few dishes to share: 1] Four's Wings - crispy chicken wings with house glaze sauce. 2] Fours Company - shrimp, calamari, mussel, cherry tomato in a coconut stew served with brown rice. 3] Yellowstone - crispy fried chicken served with cabbage pickle, red onion, with flat noodles in the house curry sauce. All the dishes were tasty, especially the Yellowstone dish.

On my second visit we came for brunch and made a reservation for four. We tried a few dishes: 1] Okinomiyaki Fries, 2] Chicken and Waffles, 3] Butterfly Lychee and Volcano Coffee. Fries were solid, chicken and waffles were standard, and the drinks were tasty.

Overall a great new spot for brunch or dinner in Bernal!
A lovely place!, the food is really good, drinks, you feel comfortable it's a cozy spot to expend time with friends or relatives!

We had the volcano coffee! So creamy and delicious either lick the coffee mousse and/or mix it together...no matter how you drink, you'll enjoy it coffee lovers! The mushroom omelette and French toast were incredible! Service was amazing! Can't wait to come back and try the K-pop Beni

We were quoted a 60-75 min wait but only waited 35 minutes. Staff is friendly but did not feel as they were very attentive after imputing our order. The food and drinks tasted good but not what we were expecting. I personally think it's more of a one time experience for me but this place seems very popular. I think our biggest dislike was how compact the entire restaurant is. Everyone is packed into this small space like a can of sardines. We were sat at a community table with little to no room and the people next to us kept elbowing my friend. All the tables around barely had any walking space so don't be surprised that it's a tight space.

Service was good, polite staff and you can check in yourself at their kiosk. Food was delicious and the whole atmosphere was good too. Only wish they had some vanilla creamer for the coffee and it would be nice not be charged extra for orange and apple juice refills, you know the normal breakfast drinks.
I saw a lot review on Yelp, so we decided to go there on weekdays. It's took about 30 mins for order to serve.

The kbomb bunny is the best also the strawberry lemonade was amazing and the fries are amazing as well I tryed the French toast crème brûlée i didn't really like it cause the crème brûlée was not think and sweet enough and it was too runny and when I put syrup on it tasted okay but the brûlée overpowered the whole thing but everything else was amazing and the lines is long cause that place is not that big!
Great service, great food, BEAUTIFUL PRESENTATION!! would recommend & would come again. Waitlist does not take long at all

I went in today to dine and try out this restaurant cause it looked so cute. I was seated immediately and then upon reaching the table I noticed our table was directly next to an open big window that was making us pretty much sit outside... then the sun was completely on us and the shade was hitting my fiancé constantly. We were not greeted for about 10 minutes as we finally decided to leave.

Visited this spot while I was out in SF, I made reservations the night before & showed up like 15 minutes late but when I walked in the host told me to sit down anywhere I'd like, the tables were really small but it was fine. It's a very busy place so the waitress take a minute to get to you but our food did come out pretty fast. The food was delicious the fruit was fresh & the pancakes were so good. The Lychee drink was pretty good but the volcano coffee was a bit to strong for me maybe because it's hard to mix. I overall enjoyed it & would come back!

I've been going to Four Chairs since they opened. The quality and presentation of the food is top notch, the servers are always friendly, and the service is fast despite an often packed house during weekend brunches.
Really good place. Can't wait to go back again. Food was delicious and staff is very friendly and helpful.
Enjoyed the food and the drinks. I'll be back for more on another visit. The Benedict was good!
good service, very attentive. best french toast of my life- it was so good i had to come back a second day to order it again!!!

I walked in at 2:15PM and I was turned away because they close at 2:30PM not sure why they would post 2:30 and tell me there closed at 2:15 I even asked if I could get to go and the server told me no, that's okay after reading the reviews I'm glad I was turned away.
This was really good food and a pleasant place to eat in a slightly dicey part of the City.

Food is good and very instagrammable but we had to wait for more than 40 minutes to get a table since you can't book a reservation. My friend's order came out wrong and she was disappointed. I'd go again, though.

We were able to get seated easily by joining the Yelp waitlist ahead of time, even though it was super crowded. Even though the restaurant is on the larger side, our waitress was very attentive and kept checking in on us. Their fusion food items were very creative and I loved the ricotta pancakes. The portions were also really reasonable, and we overall really enjoyed what we got. Will definitely be coming here again!
First time trying this spot and it was delicious. No complaints, food was great and drinks. It was just hard finding parking. Not busy at all for a Sunday either. Will definitely come back
I honestly feel like I just wasted money - the food was bland. Tasted like cheap ingredients with no flavor. The chicken was ok but everything else was bad.

Great waffle. Nice servers and accommodating. When this place is busy it is very noisy, so we try to go on weekdays. Wished they had lattes and decaf Coffee. Not a fan of their specialty whipped coffee drink. This is just a preference as it was pretty and created with care.

Great place to eat, good ambiance. Every minute was worth it. We went today with my family, take us about an hour for taste that amazing food, it was not only delicious the presentation was amazing a 100 to the chefs and bartenders, the service was very good (I hope the waitresses have more help in the future because they were only 3 serving today and the place was packed, but they did a good job). As soon as you arrive, you have to check in on Yelp for to get a table. 100% recommended!
Food is delicious. The chicken and waffle was good. We also had the egg scrambles which was also delicious. Good selections and good breakfast. Staff is friendly and attentive.
Food was very yummy and the service was fast and friendly. Will definitely be coming back for the whipped coffee and pancakes!

Super cute brunch spot! My boyfriend and I came here and it was sooo packed, but I could understand why. The food and drinks were amazing plus the service was really fast and kind to us. There were so many good things on the menu that we plan to come back to try more!
The food is the best breakfast food ever. It is also kid friendly . It was Sunday morning and there was a line out the door . The service was very good. The vibe was chill.
Small portions but good. Slow service and understaffed. Plus chicken was over cooked.
cute place for brunch, fun drinks and mid to good dishes. definitely only need to go once, nothing worth getting again. wasn't the fastest service but it was a busy sunday
One of most satisfying meals ever in the mission area. Wonderful food and services! Nice place to check in.

I really wanted to like this place but it simply was not good. Service was super slow, I know it was a busy weekend but if staff can stand around laughing and ignore you, that's a problem for me. Our food came out over 15 minutes apart, I had to walk to the back and try to find out where the food was! I ordered Chicken and waffles and the skin was so hard, I couldn't bite it. The chicken was cold and overcooked. Super disappointed in a meal I was really looking forward to!

Omygod come here before this place blows up, which it definitely will. The food is so incredible, found out its a very expert experienced chef of 20 years who cooks here. The vibe is immaculate. They were nice and let us order off the dinner menu at brunch around 2 so we got to taste both! So lucky. The coffee is amazing too. See our pics and you'll see what I'm talking about!

Ordered the volcano coffee (aka Dalgona coffee), Four Chairs Benny, and Chicken and Waffles for dining in. Proof of vaccination was required for dining in.
My sister said she liked the volcano coffee. The coffee layer was thick and kind of sticky when mixing it up with the milk.
The poached eggs in the Benedict were runny and soft. The bacon was thick cut, sweet, and smokey. (Because of this bacon, I think this restaurant may be managed/owned by the same people who operate Kitchen Story, Sweet Maple, etc.) The cherry tomato halves gave a nice pop of acidity. The potatoes were crispy and tasted good with ketchup.
The fried chicken was good-moist inside, slightly crispy on the outside. It wasn't overly salted so I enjoyed it with the slightly spicy aioli. The waffle was crispy on the outside, a little sweet, and paired well with the maple syrup. However, the underside of the waffles was a bit too dark in some patches (didn't notice it until I was eating it because the "pretty" side was presented facing up.
The restaurant opened not too long ago. The decor looked modern and clean.
Excellent food, good service, and decent prices - what else could you want? Well, maybe a more generous seating policy and/or outdoor seating? That's be asking too much!
Shout out to Bam & Nat our servers who made my partner's birthday memorable and special!

I'm definitely giving this place 5 stars.This cozy place has a beautiful interior design. Staffs are friendly and very attentive. I recommend chicken and waffle. The waffle is so good since the texture is not too heavy. I also got house coffee and very fresh squeezed orange juice. They're open for dinner too. Would love to go back and try their dinner menu!

I love this place, the atmosphere is so relaxing. I love that it's super clean. The food is absolutely delicious. The wait staff are always friendly. I have gone here multiple times for breakfast. I need to come back for dinner an

Holy cow this place is great. First off since they're new, you get the same delicious quality of all the brunch places like black stone without the long wait. Ordered the four chairs Benedict and French toast. Both were amazing. Starting off with the bene, you get a side of potatoes that are crispy and topped with parsley. You also get a side salad drizzled with vinaigrette dressing and slices of baby tomatoes. The eggs bene is layered with slices of roasted baby tomatoes, their four chair bacon, and topped with a poached egg topped with hollandaise and cayenne pepper. The bacon was delicious, the savor flavor is well balanced with the maple? Whatever they used it was a good balance between savory and sweet.

The French toast had fresh fruit and was dipped in a citrus batter which created a unique and delicious experience. The syrup isn't very sweet, reminds me of an organic agave. The fruits used were strawberries, black berries, and blue berries. Topped with whipped butter and rosemary on the side as garnish.

Lastly the gave a complimentary dalgona coffee. As a coffee lover it was a very pleasant gesture. It was nice and creamy. Not to sweet and the caffeine was definitely there.

Setting was nice and clean. Service was good. Will definitely come back.

Some tips, your menus is nice and simple. But yiu can share more details like on your yelp menu.

The food and service was very good. The volcano coffee was amazing. The waitress was very attentive and brought whatever we needed. She replaced our with volcano coffee made with cow's milk with almond milk after she was told about it after the fact.

I really wanted to love this place ! I will
Start with what I really liked about it , the ambiance, was great! My whole family came my kids enjoyed the ambiance and the decorations a lot, My food was ok maybe because the service was not great our waiter was not in the best mood which I understand life happens, our food was cold you can tell it was sitting for a while and we
Didn't come on a busy day there were 5 people in total at the time, we asked if we could get it re heated and you can tell our waiter was annoyed, so we asked for to go plates and the plates never came so we just asked for our checks and paid and left. Overall our experience wasn't the best which made everything worse.
Nice place. Good food with decent prices. Friendly efficient staff. Spacious. It's on Mission Street so parking is tough

Took the kids here this morning and had breakfast. First, the place is clean which is always a plus. Second, the waiter and and waitress were extremely nice and friendly. They made us feel like we want to come back again and again. And third, the pancakes, french toast, waffles with fried chicken, fries and the drinks were very tasty. The kids loved it. Definitely recommend coming here for breakfast or lunch.

Wandered in here for dinner with cautious optimism as it's a new Thai place with few reviews. I am currently blown away. The menu seems to be a Thai fusion themed, with many of my favorite dishes + a unique local Cali ingredient flair. The $2.50 draft special is unbeatable! The Lamb curry dish was perfectly cooked: the Lamb medallions tender on the inside and crispy on the outside - same with the Brussels AND asparagus! The sweet potatoes or yams and Rainbow carrots were popping with sweetness and perfectly tender. The flavor of the Mussamun curry and the ingredients played beautifully off one another. My only critique would be the pita was not fluffy or homemade and seems extraneous. I know it's probably the Paratha part of the dish but ditch it I say. For $27 pretty reasonable given the ingredients seem high quality and execution in point.
My chipotle Benedict was alright, the ground turkey meat was not interesting and dry. My volcano coffee was way too sweet, they didn't not ask me for my preference In sweet level.
This place is soooo good!!!! Good bang for bucks!!!! Great ambiance! Good portion!!! I would give it 10 stars if I can!!! I am so coming back to try more of their menu!!!!!

Found this place while visiting , all the food looks very well served and fire , everything I ate was really good would definitely come again when I come
Back

Beautiful and tasteful space, with food and service to match. There is great attention to detail throughout, and with each dish served.

The food is a mix of elevated brunch fare and some asian-influenced dishes as well.

I went by today, but closed on Tuesday for now. Highly recommended.

Leaving a follow up, because it's warranted. I had such a great experience last Thursday that I decided this was where I wanted to have my birthday dinner tonight.. Party of 9 and of course.. was not disappointed. We were hosted by Chef Chris and his wife and I'm so glad we got to try so many you more dishes. Calamari, brussel sprouts, the rack of lamb, takoyaki, etc. Everything was delicious and well presented. Thanks for a memorable birthday experience and looking forward to returning to soon!

Great service and amazing food. We were to our surprise served by the chef himself (Chris) and everything was delicious and he was delightful. We had the ribeye, tom yum, ceviche and ribeye salad. This was accompanied by a pitcher of sangria and the fried bananas and ice cream.

Would definitely come back and recommend you check em out!

Recently opened and seems like no one knows it's here. The Thai/European fusion is a unique addition to a city full of of Thai/Californian/Brunch spots.

Really enjoyed the Signature (the light curry sauce was great with the coconut rice!) and the smokiness of the Weeping Lady was a great twist on a classic combo of chicken and eggplant.

Enjoyed my chat with the welcoming owner and wishing them lots of luck on this opening!

My new favorite place for breakfast! I highly recommend the eggs benedict! Perfectly poached eggs, extra crispy potatoes, and fresh salad! Nice interior and very friendly and attentive staff. Clean and quiet space. Definitely coming back here when I'm back in the area! Check it out!

It was such an amazing experience! The decoration of the restaurant is really nice and fancy. Food are all great and tasty, and the service deserves 5 stars. I recommend going here for good food, and to take some nice pictures.

Went there for brunch on a Sunday - it was pretty deserted at 1030 (only a couple of other tables were being used). I had the volcano coffee and truffle omelette with a side of the four chairs bacon. Volcano coffee was amazing - it's a dalgona coffee with a great coffee-tasting syrup. The truffle omelette was very good and the four chairs bacon is very unique - it has a rosemary glaze that gives it additional sweetness.

Definitely looking forward to checking this place out for dinner soon!

New Asian Fusion on the block! Very nice decor and ambience for date nights and groups of fours or more; hence, four chairs. =) (probably not what it meant lol)

Our party ordered several dishes to try and all of them were very flavorful and tasty. The salt and pepper beef strips were crispy which paired well with beer. The four chairs signature Ribeye steak was a bit salty by itself, but with the coconut rice... perfect balance. YELLOWSTONE was definitely the highlight of the night as the chickens were crispy, tender, and juicy at the same time. Noodle texture was my favorite, not too soft or soggy even with the sauce.

The staffs were very nice and attentive. Will definitely go back to try their brunch menu!!!

Really delicious breakfast choice, and a short line before 11AM on a Father's Day weekend! I had an egg white chicken apple sausage scramble, and my daughter had the pancakes which she was obliged out of filial duty to share.

The definition of the restaurant is American + Asian fusion. Me and my girlfriend tried to find something new to eat and this restaurant come up on yelp. The type of food is perfect combination between American and Asian. I had a Tofu steak with peanut sauce and Golden bags for appetizer. They were so good. My entree was "Yellowstone" ( Eggs noodles with yellow curry and fried chicken) I loved it so much it reminded me of the food named Kaosoi in Thailand. My girlfriend had a dish name "By the Bay" ( Grill Salmon) she really loved it. The salmon with white wine sauce was perfect. Oh we had a drink called Butterfly Lychee and Mango Tango were amazing!! We definitely come back again for sure.

Walked in for brunch and got a table. Clearly they were understaffed that day. I mentioned that I was going to wait 15 minutes before ordering to wait for my cousin and that was fine. When my cousin arrived, it took around twenty minutes to order even though we mentioned that were ready twice. The person who took our order never apologized for the wait. People were standing in long lines without being greeted or acknowledged at the entrance.

The food and drink was good but the service definitely needs to be fine tuned.

It's fun going to a restaurant in the soft opening stage, and as a local to the area, I very much want to see this difficult part of Mission thrive and businesses succeed. So I persuaded my husband and daughter to come out and try a new restaurant, and we were all happy with the experience.

The dinner menu is Asian fusion, with Thai ingredients and Asian-Western cooking styles. We felt it was very similar to nice modern restaurants in Bangkok- the dishes are very well cooked and plated (Thai cooking is amazing) and the food is pleasingly crisp and sweet. The restaurant is extremely relaxed and comfortable, and details and glassware well chosen.

My daughter loved the potato croquette, and I most liked the Golden Bags tapa (irresistible!) and the Himalayan Tofu. The menu is family friendly as adults and children can find something to eat- basically, we need restaurants with both potato/rice dishes and more elegant food for adults. My only request is to make sure that both savory and sweet palates can find something- next time I'd like to try something spicier than what I had.

Cute Instagrammable drinks and food, good customer service but the food wasn't tasty at all! The fried chicken in the chicken and waffles was dry and the coating left a weird batter-y taste in my mouth like it wasn't fried all the way. Waffles were okay, they were definitely on the fluffier side. The butterfly lychee drink was watered down, barely tasted like lychee and it was 90% crushed ice. The pinky dinky drink tasted like straight up pepto bismal!!!!!!

Really lovely thai-adjacent cooking. Sleek, peaceful interior and beautiful, creative dishes -- both the food and the ceramics on which they're plated.

We stopped in for dinner. Lots of unusual small plates on the menu (most under $10!), and the Tom Ka soup really floored us. Will try the mains next visit. All the food was composed with care inside and out. And loved the tap list with unusual IPA's and a breakfast stout, I'd come in just for that.

Oh, almost forgot, the fried wings! Not a typical order for us, but will be a part of every order in the future. Delicate-crisp outside, perfect inside, stacked high like a Jenga tower of taste.

As of this writing they are in soft opening, so stop by and welcome them to the neighborhood.
Super cute. Food was yummy. Staff was very friendly. I loved that the mimosa pitcher comes with the OJ on the side

Wow! Wonderful food, service, ambiance and location. I randomly found this place which is still in its "soft opening" phase. I'm telling you, get there before you can't get a table.
We ordered the popcorn chicken potstickers (delish). The truffle, garlic edamame (addictive). The naked wings (crispy with excellent dipping sauce). Crying tiger steak (so tender with tasty sauce). I think that's the best thing we ordered.
We did not order the Four Chairs wings with sauce, but Chris, the owner, brought us some on the house and wow, crispy, not too spicy, not too sweet, just right! Chris also brought us desert which was a spin on a bananas foster. One of the best most original deserts I've had in a long time.
We enjoyed a bottle of wine and pretty much everything else about this little place. I rarely leave reviews but was completely motivated after my experience.
They also serve brunch and I can't wait to go! 5 stars, looking forward to my next visit. Thank you Chris!!

Delicious food! Decently priced! Friendly staff!
Overall definitely come here :) the salmon was nice and juicy and same for the steak! Good place to fill up on appetizers or for a nice date night dinner.

Brand new place in mission district. We went opening day Sunday January 2, 2022 for brunch this is an Asian fusion restaurant with pretty normal breakfast items but the dinner menu looks really nice. We had two omelettes garlic truffle and nova. Nova had a generous portion of lox which was a nice change from others that give you a tiny portion. My only thing I would ask of the owners is to try to look outside the box of normal breakfast items and get creative.
But overall I would recommend this spot especially since there are not brunch places in this area

This is a gem on this side of Mission Street/District: the restaurant is airy, light-filled with high ceilings making it feel spacious. This setting you might not immediately associate with breakfasts and brunches (more for dinners).

Initial thoughts on food was that it might be too 'artsy' and unnecessarily fancy. Sure the presentation was artistic but the food was good - I especially enjoyed the chunks of lox alongside the perfectly-made omelette. Quality and Taste of the coffee not so good, however...

Food was great (can't recommend the chicken and waffles more, insanely good) but service was truly so disappointing. My table was also told they "ran out of forks" when it was 12pm... not sure how that happens at a brunch restaurant but it resulted in waffles being eaten with spoons. Waitress looked more confused than I was when I asked "what do you mean you're out of forks" so that was funny at least. Very crowded dining room, don't think it's going to be a cozy experience eating here.
It's a beautiful place the service is greater I had the chicken and waffles my husband had the Santa Fe all be back. Bathroom are clean Love it

Food was Amazing The waffles were fluffy and food was fantastic!!!!! Poached Eggs were crazy!!!! The prices on plates are fairly reasonable. Everyone is different with their service but other than that I highly recommend!!! Especially if you are just looking for a place to eat breakfast or brunch at in SF

My party and I arrived a little after 10am (opening time) and were seated right away. We ordered chicken & waffles, marscapone pancakes, nova omelette, and the chipotle benedict. Overall, the food was really good, but came out lukewarm? Servers were nice and quick.
I cannot be more happy with 4chairs! This is an excellent place to go eat with friends or love ones! I love everything in here!

Restaurant is super clean and nice. Service was amazing there was only one waiter Lid catering to everyone and he was great. Now the food usually I am skeptical about fancier restaurants I feel as if the food won't be very good and that we just pay for the ambiance but the food was out of this world. Super fresh made in good timing and flavorful. I wish we had a four chairs in Sacramento. This will definitely be somewhere I visit when in San Francisco again!!

Ordered the money bags, wings, and Yellowstone (basically khao soi with chicken). The wings were super tasty and crispy. The Yellowstone was incredibly flavorful. The waiter was friendly and the service was quick. Definitely coming back.

My friends and I went on a Sunday around 11:00ish and it was popping! So many people. When we got our food, we understood why!

Our meals were: chicken and waffles, two chipotle benedicts, two eggs and bacon, pancakes,southwest omelette, volcano coffee and cranberry mimosa. Everything was soooo soooo good. We were all very happy with our meals. I would highly, highly recommend getting pancakes for your group to share. It was soooo worth it. Will definitely be going again!!
The pancakes are delicious!!!! Everything else was also really good but I love the pancakes.
Amazing place for brunch, we ordered the signature french toast and pancakes for the table and they were delicious! Mains were decent with the usual brunch fare and service was nice.
Wow - SO overrated. Nothing was great, everything was mediocre. Pancakes were dry and lacking flavor; both bennies were not great. Nothing was well seasoned. Would not go back.

Have no plan where to eat. We were walking past this new place. The restaurant looks nice and modern so we decided to give it a try. We ordered the salmon and yellow curry noodles with fried chicken dishes & butterfly lychee and mango tango drinks. Both taste and decoration were terrific. The food is American Asian fusion. The servers are so nice and friendly. I'm definitely coming back!
Food was delicious we went for breakfast! Although service was slow we didn't get checked on throughout our meal and it was hard to get their attention when we needed something.
Bussin bussin bussin bussin and even more bussin this place has the best fried chicken
Made a reservation for 2pm and got there within 10 minute and got turned away because the kitchen was closed. Maybe changing the reservation to stop accepting anyone until 1pm would be helpful

My absolute favorite dish the chicken and waffle. It has so much flavor. The star of the dish was the chicken of course that had a lot of seasoning on the breading and it was so juicy!!

The waffles has a cinnamon taste that was sweet and completed the chicken nicely. Waffles are usually bland but these waffles were really good!!
Very busy and the service was awful. We waited 45 minutes to get our food. Pancakes are too sweet!

This might be the best breakfast place in the city! Generous portions and great service in an inviting space. We will definitely be back next time we're in SF. The pictures don't do it justice, just check it out. You won't be sorry. As a word of advice, try and get here when they first open, as it gets busy (even on a Monday morning).
The foods are so tasty and yummy. Umami tastes indeed. The signature ones are Chicken&Waffle, and four chairs Benedict. The chickens are so crispy.

Stopped in for a solo lunch on a quick stop in SFO. The neighborhood was not impressive but once I stepped into the restaurant, I forgot all about the slightly shady surroundings. Tables were spaced nicely- no frills. ...I have a high bar for chicken and waffles and was afraid they would disappoint (and was in no mood for a bad lunch) so I went with the Chicken sandwich instead and it was absolutely deeelicious! Piping hot battered fried chicken, crispy bun, fresh lettuce and tomato.. aioli was on point. Missing a little spice/heat but yummy nonetheless. Side fries were also a yes; crispy goodness. Washed it down with a strawberry lemonade, which was superb. My server was attentive but not annoying.. just the way I like it. Definitely a gem.

It was a good meal, but nothing special about it. I had the chicken and waffles, which was cooked well. But the waffle and chicken were both bland as far as seasoning. They definitely are playing it safe in that regard. Service and overall vibe were laid back as expected on a Thurday morning. I was given a glass for water, asked what I'd like, it was given to me, then the bill came. So a very normal experience overall. I was hoping for a little more based off of the other reviews

Presentation is beautiful. Ordered the Southwest scramble, Nova Benny, Citrus French Toast, and Mascarpone Pancake and all were really good! I thoroughly enjoyed the pancake as it was not to sweet. Service was great and had a good ambiance, I love how you can't hear others conversations as the space was big
Was surprised in their pricing for a SF restaurant especially for how good it is! Fast paced and delicious but don't expect private seating ofc you'll be right next to someone!
Very good food! We had to wait 45 minutes but it was Mothers Day Weekend and we got out of there super quick.

This is the best breakfast place ... The restaurant has a clean home feel airy so openly like a zen feel to it . The service was so attentive . The selection . Eggs Benedict with Korean chicken so crispy and flavorful the eggs Benefict was cook right and the mascarpone waffle was light . The drinks are so unique . Brought my family and we were so delighted . Would definitely cone back

I told you guys I'd be back for dinner I was on my home ... when I made a random decision to check Four Chairs on Sunday .... I was far from the location and it was closing @9 .... I was tired hadn't eating lunch so I was really hungry ... to my surprise I was treated like VIP because I was the only one in there so I could eat in peace and quite and give my honest opinion about the food ... and WOWzers !!!! Lid and the others made my evening and a experience to remember... fore sure my friends and family is coming next to visit keep it up

Coming back soon for more surprises Breakfast was bomb sadly I forgot to get pictures of the French toast which was delicious .. can't wait to see what dinner is all about at this establishment... keep up the hard work
Food was incredible. Definitely order the chicken and waffles! Service was quite accommodating too; will be returning!

We went on a Sunday for brunch and it was also Daylight Saving Time (March 10), but nonetheless, we had perhaps the worst dining experience of our lives. We waited over an hour for a seat. When we sat down we were already hungry. A server came by... I spotted a neighbor's meal and was still trying to decide. I asked for one second and she left and said, "sorry... I can't take your orders until you both decide." That person never returned. We waited ten more minutes before someone else took our orders. We waited... and waited... we saw someone near us who came in AFTER we did, get served. I had to make eye contact and flag someone down to find out what was going on with our order. They made some excuse about how a large group ordered just before we did, which did not explain the people who came after us. Then we waited some more. We considered leaving, and we nearly did (and we definitely should have) before our food came. The food was OK... but not good enough to justify the wait time. We ate fast, because we were HANGRY by this point. And then we waited for our check to come. It didn't. I had to turn around and try to make eye contact with someone to bring us our check. They brought a check to a table near us, but never even saw that we were waiting or looking for some help. At NO POINT did ANYONE come to our table to see how we were doing. The whole ordeal took TWO HOURS. I have never felt so TRAPPED and HELPLESS at a restaurant. I wanted so badly to get out of there, but couldn't. I hope this place finds a better way to deal with its customers. It's far too popular to be this awful. I would rather eat gas station sushi than come back here.

yum yum yum!! i rarely give 5 stars reviews because i am always uncertain but i'm definitely certain about this. the chicken was amazing - the crunchiness and flavor was to die for. service was great as well and the vibe was cute! the seating was a bit close but definitely worth it! excited to go back.

3.5 stars there wasn't really anything wrong with this place I guess.

This is a great place to go if you're in the neighborhood(this is almost the outskirts of the hubbub of the Mission so are you ever really in the neighborhood?) or if you need a brunch spot with near-guaranteed seating or a short wait time because the original place you decided to go to turned out to be 1hour+ long wait. It's a place I would try once with some friends but not a place I would take someone visiting from out of town.

Waited less than 10 minutes on the Yelp waitlist at 1pm on a Sunday. Dishes did take a while to come out after ordering, I nearly finished 2 bloody marys by the time they brought us our food and I was trying to save the drinks for the meal. I ordered the salmon benedict which was fine, nothing special, nothing that stood out to me but it did the job. Potatoes on the side were also nicely cooked. My friend ordered the fried chicken and waffles, which came with A LOT of chicken, so I guess it was worth it?

Overall, this place did not leave an impression on me, nothing glowingly positive but nothing negative either!

Came from Sacramento and was seated within the first minute since we came as soon as they opened. Server was very kind and made sure everything was good. The French toast was amazing, not overly sweet or heavy, it was perfect and very light, even the syrup wasn't too sweet. My bf got the four chairs benny, the egg was perfect. The drinks were so pretty and refreshing.

AMAZING!! The drink was so flavorful and fresh, the fries were umami and perfectly seasoned and crispy, the pancakes were perfectly balanced! We liked how the pancakes didn't make us feel heavy after! GREAT and fast service and cozy spacious atmosphere!

My boyfriend, sister and I are always looking for good places to eat. We're foodies and hate being disappointed.I don't like to judge restaurants by their aesthetic, we've been to beautiful restaurants were their food and drinks were absolute garbage. Four chairs is both a beautiful vibe and yummy plate. We called to make a reservation, we were sat promptly upon arrival and food came out fast and fresh. This was our 1st time and we will definitely be going back.
Best Korean bbq chicken!! So good 10/10. The pancakes were also very good 8/10. The service was great, the employees were all very nice.

Went on a weekend, there's a little wait time of about 10-15 minutes but line moves quickly. Love everything we ordered and huge plus that they are so kid-friendly. Ambience is geared towards more on the young adult audience but even with kids, we still had a good time. Will be coming back!!!

This place is good but I definitely tried better! I ordered the chicken and waffles with a mango tango. I enjoyed the mango tango but next time I'd probably try the Iced coffee. Service was great and the interior was aesthetically pleasing.
I went there at noon, no need to make an appointment, there is a seat as soon as I arrive, we ordered four kinds of food in total, my favorite is waffle chicken drumsticks, I will go again next time.

Beautifullyb presented food . Fresh ingredients. Loved the K Bomb Benedict. Service was good. Great vibe. Lots of families with kids. So glad it was open on Mondays. Pretty decent lunch crowd. Please support them !!
food here is always delicious!!!! the mascarpone pancakes are a must there!!! the wait is a little insane on the weekends but if you can go on a week day the wait is not bad.

The food at Four Chairs is amazing and would recommend the Chipotle Benedict, Chicken and Waffles are delicious. I would also recommend their Volcano Coffee yum! Their service is top notch and are very friendly and even offered complementary orange juice for my two daughters.

Good food! Great service! Reasonable prices! We came on a Saturday morning right when it just opened so there was no wait. The food came out quickly. Easy street parking about a block away. Definitely another great brunch option in the city!

Just had breakfast highly recommend. Good service fantastic menu and great selection of drinks. For you coffee lovers try the coffee volcano. I had the southwest scramble delicious. I actually can't imagine anything not being good there.

Tried this place out for brunch for the first time and representation of the food was great. Found parking right in front. Nicely plated and colorful. Really liked how the butterfly lychee drink looked and tasted, was straight up lychee juice. Service was great, food came out reasonably quick.

You're gunna wanna bookmark this hidden gem for brunch. They have aesthetic affordable delicious Asian Inspired brunch and the best part is that I never have to wait for a table here. Nothing on the menu is over 22$. You've gotta try their chicken and waffles here!

Very disappointed with their signature Four Chairs Bacon. An order of 2 strips will cost you $10. Got mine and it was way under cooked. They refused to take it back and cook it a little longer. Was not going to eat it almost raw and risk getting sick

I don't give many reviews, but Four Chairs deserves a great one. Consistently delicious meals served speedily with great service. Usually come here on the weekends and are seated quickly even with a wait. Love the classic chicken and waffles and the Much Room salad. A real gem
The food was amazing, only thing I can say negative is that it is way too loud in there. You can barely hear yourself lol service was good, friendly staff. Coffee is a bit overhyped for my liking.

The food was good but the service was not what I expected. As soon as our food was brought to us no one checked in on us to see if everything was ok. They gave us the smallest amount of water and didn't come to refill my drink. Lunch the waitress seemed busy also bussing tables but I just wasn't happy about not getting a single check in when we needed napkins and more drinks.

The mascarpone pancakes where a bit dry of and they where too much smothered in cream sauce. The over hard egg was perfectly cooked. The service was fast and friendly. The regular scrambled eggs had no salt or seasoning. The price over all was too expensive for the service goods. Nice presentation of food and drinks.
This place was made for photos and instagram but not taste. The food came out luke warm not hot and tasted sub par. Pretty big disappointment would not recommend.
Excellent service, excellent food, awesome place and the rest well lets say ,,, very good

Service was very terrible , she was rude when we were ordering and didn't have patience. Their food is pretty decent they just make the drinks so you can post on Instagram. If you don't know the exact one no patience. First time here and they don't answer the questions you have .
Delicious brunch place and very attentive staff. Enjoyed the eggs Benedict and the burger very much.

Not worth the hype or money. Butterfly lychee is aesthetically pleasing but does not taste good. The k chicken sandwich is too saucy and no balance of other flavors. Adding cole slaw to the sandwich does not make the sandwich better. My fries were cold and the benedict was mediocre at best. I don't understand the hype and would not recommend. Food is edible but not memorable nor good.

After always choosing the delicious breakfast items, I finally got this yummy B.L.T.A. Sandwich. It was great, and in true Four Chair style, it was gorgeously plated. Even the salad was scrumptious! Always a pleasure to come here with the friendly staff, amazing food, and great atmosphere! It's my mission to try everything on the menu so I will definitely be back soon!

Love love love this place! I have gone twice now, once for appetizers and once for brunch. Both times were incredible! Chris is very kind and talented and everything I have tried so far is delicious! The simple beautiful touches really go a long way from fruit served in the mimosas to the different dipping sauces including the soy vinaigrette with the popcorn chicken potstickers and my favorite Golden Bags with plum sauce. I'm already looking forward to my next visit!-Michelle
cute vibe. food on point! fried chicken looked hella good. need to get that next time! ill be back for more.
Great food, beautiful ambiance, and even better service - thank you Belle! Came for San Francisco Restaurant Week, and will be coming back (and bringing friends) in the future for sure.

We decided to check it out for brunch (4 people total), called ahead and was told there would be a few minute wait. That's fine. We were seated within 5 minutes, which was great. We sat for roughly 10 minutes before we were asked for our order - we did drinks and food right then. Drinks took at least five minutes. Then entrees came out one by one, five minutes apart. I was last. Everyone was almost done by the time I started eating. We had two benedicts, one chicken and waffle and one southwestern scramble. The food was good, the service was slowwwww.... like to a ridiculous level. The coordination in the kitchen needs major work. Not sure I'd go back. Also, very curious about the 60+ 5-star reviews. This is a restaurant that clearly doesn't have it's act together.
Just exceptional food. Ordered the chorizo Benny and the truffle omelette. incredible. Very nice spot and amazing service.
Atmosphere was nice, food was good. The wait wasn't too bad. Chicken from the chicken and waffles was prepared well.
The ambiance was very cute, loved how the plates looked but the food was honestly mid for what you're paying.
Best brunch in the city ! The eggs Benedict was so good, the drink was cute and tasty, the inside is cute and great ambiance. Love this place !
Great restaurant ! Came here & tried the eggs Benedict and it was one of the best Benedict's Iv had in the city . Will definitely be coming back here for breakfast again

Great presentation but taste was so-so. The fried chicken batter was a little "pasty" (too much flour?We also had chipotle eggs Benedict which was a mix of flavors that don't seem to sing or blend together. The waffle was okay. We did like the softness of the scramble eggs and the crunch of the potatoes.

Amazing, amazing, amazing.
Service is astonishing, food is beyond DELICIOUS. Hidden gem for sure. This place is a MUST GO if you are in San Francisco. Perfect for a date night or family dinners! Thank you, Four Chairs
Good ambience, food was delicious & service was fast. They have mimosas which is the cherry on top! I will be back...

I gave it 3 stars only because the burger and eggs Benedict were decent. My mom ordered the chicken and waffles and the chicken was NOT fresh! It tasted and looked like it was boiled,battered and fried.. I was super disappointed, asked the waitress if the chicken was fresh and she replied yes.. asked her to take the food back and she did. She was nice about it. Got only a 5% discount for the plate.. I doubt I will go there again.

I love Four Chairs so much that I had even gone three times on one week.

Our first visit was an accident. My partner and I were walking around the neighborhood after visiting Bernal Heights Park and found a sign for beers on tap for less than $4. A Sunday morning and a fresh pour? Say less. Immediately walking in I was taken back. The decor was gorgeous, open, modern, and well-thought out - a vibe that I felt had been absent from the area until now. We were quickly seated and did not hesitate to get comfortable. We ordered:

- Hot Black Coffee (basic but refillable, sold!)
- Chicken and Waffles (perfectly cooked, highly under-seasoned chicken)
- Four Chairs Benedict (love, love, love, love, LOVE)

While I loved everything we ordered, I felt the chicken needed seasoning incorporated into the batter or to be tossed in the amazing sauce they already served on the side. On my second visit, I wanted to check out the evening menu and boy are there gems riddling the entire page.

- Lamb (solid choice, perfectly cooked, complimenting curry)
- Ribeye (I could just melt into it)
- Sliced Ribeye (just as good as the ribeye but tossed in a thai curry, yum!)
- Salmon (another solid choice, cooked to perfection)

On my third visit, I made it a point to come back for the ribeye personally. I had already sneaked a piece of my friend's and was completely blown away. This time around, our food took long enough for us to slowly finish three rounds of drinks. Of the five ribeyes ordered at our table, four came back well-done despite our individual preferences. How painful is it to be served a steak that is no longer juicy and tough to chew... I haven't been back since but I do hope the kitchen works out their small hiccups.

I'm not sure what happened but here's the story. We came on a Wednesday around 1 pm didn't need a reservation they were not busy we got instantly sat. Waiter was nice for the most part it seemed to be one or two that day on the floor. We ordered the Citrus French toast, chicken apple sausage, eggs- pancakes, beef bacon, and the fries (breakfast potatoes). The food came out and I had to send the apple sausage back because it tasted like they had it sitting in the freezer for too long and it got old. There was no flavor other than freezer burn. My French toast was not cooked, you use raw eggs making these so that was beyond me. I was going to try to order something else but the waiter did not come back to check on us. 36 minutes went by before we were able to grab him. I told him I would have ordered something else but it had been so long we just want the check. Another 15 minutes passed by and we even asked 3 more times. Once he handed us the check it still took us calling him to get take the payment. He had checked out other customers and cleaned tables while we went steadily paying for parking. So yes no food and bad service after saying something wasnt good was not what I expected from this "instagramable" place. It seems they care more about making everything look cute. Drinks were good, friend said pancakes were good.

New restaurant in Bernal alert! I've been walking by this place for a few months now and finally decided to give it a try for lunch. I had a business lunch here during the week and it was quiet inside. Boy are people missing out! We chose a nice and sunny table right by the window. You can do a lot of people watching (and watching people check out the menu). Service was good - attentive but not overly in your face and had the right timing on ordering and getting the mains out. I had the nova benny and it was delicious! My lunch partner had the portobello mushroom burger and it was huge. Basically we did not leave anything behind! I had a coffee to drink and it was tasty, the pint glass for beer had their cute little logo on it. I'm definitely going back , the crispy chicken burger def caught my eye.

Delicious
Asian cuisine with lots of options
Beer and wine :-)
I felt like it was very easy to order and get exactly what you want
Clean aesthetic design and very hospitable management
This is my new favorite brunch place! We had the spicy chorizo and four chairs Benedicts. They came with crispy potatoes and salad. It was so appetizing that we forgot to take photos.
holy sh- this place is AMAZING!!! came for a brunch and it was soooooo gooooooooooddddddd!!!!!!!! ambiance is chill asf too .

We came on Monday around 11 am and it was pretty quiet. We were seated quickly and was taken care of immediately. Inside is very warm and welcoming. I ordered Lively with the drink of Butterfly Lychee and my husband ordered Loco Plato with an Orange juice. Absolutely delicious!

Will I come again? YES!

All I have to say is delicious. Everyone was very kind and friendly. I ordered the Korean chicken eggs, Benedict. Wow it was amazing. They have very unique and colorful beverages as well. Service was prompt and professional. You must check this place out.

Went here for brunch and was not let down! Had their Chicken and Waffles the chicken had to have been on steroids because the chicken pieces were so big it was a huge leg and a huge thigh quite filling in itself ! The waffle was fluffy and I believe they used Vermont Maple Syrup so good! The place was so clean with a sleek setting and did I mention the bathroom was immaculate as well!! Our waiter was Lid and he was very accommodating ! We will be back to check out some other finds on the menu!!
There was no wait to be seated. Service was great and very nice people. Food was delicious and everyone in our group was very happy. Plenty of parking was available.

I had a great brunch experience here. We were seated very quickly. Food portions are good with pretty low prices for SF brunch.

The lychee drink is amazing, you must try it.

we were seated immediately considering it was pretty packed. staff was nice! i got 2 eggs any style which wasn't anything special, french toast was pretty good, but my friends and i lovedddd the chicken and waffles!! chicken was well seasoned and the waffles were perfect. the strawberry lemonade was pretty good too

My friend told me have one new restaurant on mission street ( near my house) will be soft opening today. It is Four chairs restaurant. I asked my husband to take me and my daughter there to check it.
They open at 11 am - 3 pm & 5pm - 9pm
The interior is clean, nice and modern. Special, I love lavender here.
The owners are kind, friendly and very welcome us.
We came at lunch time. We order drink first: jasmine tea, blueberry tea, and Fresh orange juice for my daughter. She said so fresh and yummy. She likes it
After checking the menu. We decided to ordered brunch: Hawaii omelette, four chairs omelette and Crispy wings.
The food is so delicious and nice decorate. I like the toast , it is crispy and fresh. The bacon is quite big and tasty. We loves the wings. It is crispy, tasty and easy to bite ( I think they cut it) . It is good for lady and Kid when eat the wings. I like the way they do it.
In my opinion it is 5 stars for everything and 1 more star for the owners ( when they decided to open restaurant during pandemic)
Also, I saw menu dinner look great. I'm sure for coming back for try dinner menu.
Thank you very much for service well us today ( we are the second table for soft opening )
Hopefully, your restaurant will be busy and b
I Hight recommend this place to everyone.

This is a must go to restaurant!!! Nice decor and great food and the restaurant was SPOTLESS! Go for Sunday Brunch and you"ll want to order everything ! Our waiter, Lid, was so nice. We had a few questions the first time and he was so helpful and very polite. Have been four times now and WILL go back!

I've ordered delivery from Four Chairs a few times and finally decided to check it out in person. I'm beyond happy to see a good brunch spot by Bernal heights. It was so needed as there were no other good Benedict spots in the area. Not only the food was delicious (both to go and dining in), the presentation was so nice too. So was the service. Can't wait to see this place all busy and loud!!

Honestly the food was so good. I got the salmon eggs Benedict, came with potatoes and salad. Everything was delicious. The presentation of the food was good too. Went with 3 friend's and all of them were happy with their orders. Server was nice. If I lived in San Francisco I would go again.

Good food! Had an omelet with some seriously fat and delicious bacon in it, a whole slice, and delicious veggies as well. Good sweet drinks for kids. Nice space, friendly and quick service. I recommend!
Came here for the weekend and also as many people back to back because we actually enjoyed breakfest !!
The food is very good with a quite varied menu - large plates come (eventually) ... the table and service wait time are still getting ironed out.
Awesome place! Very well designed and feels like it should be more expensive than it is. Perfect for brunch

If you're looking for fresh takes on an asian-inspired menu with crisp veggies, amazing flavor, and excellent music...then you've got to stop at Four Chair. Its an odd name, an odd logo, in a random place of the mission but the food is worth every bit of that. I've been here for brunch for the Four chairs bennie and it's the best bennie combo of flavors I've ever had. I got the tofu skewers and yellowstone for dinner. Both with great and vibrant flavor. And the price feels wrong, its too good. Will always come here when I'm around
Food ok , nothing special. Gets crowded and busy on weekends, other than that it's good to try.
Food was amazing, I felt like my time was valued and wasn't being wasted can't wait to comeback for happy hour
Amazing and fast service and the food is absolutely delicious. Never gets old. I can't wait to go back again!!

Ate here on a Friday night with a friend. We are vegetarian and really enjoyed the food. It's interesting that they don't serve noodles or many of the Thai dishes were used too. Not many people inside -- food came out quickly and fresh. We got the shaking forest and the Himalayan tofu (it was so so good).

Price was good. I would definitely come here again.
Food was bland and not much flavor . I got the chicken waffle and the waffle was hard.

Really nice little restaurant! The food was wonderful, the atmosphere was nice (you could actually hear the people you were with), the decor was lovely, and the service was excellent. Highly recommend.
Everything was amazing. The food, the customer service, the ambiance. It was all super amazing. I keep coming here. Love it!

Have had both dinner and brunch here. Both fantastic! Brunch was perfectly cooked eggs Benedict with lemon hollandaise and a salad with thick, sweet bacon.
Dinner included tasty coconut rice with chicken and eggplant. Also very tasty.
Drinks are currently non-alcoholic but very pretty and delicious.
Try the fried banana for dessert if you're into bananas.

Had to try out the new restaurant that just opened up in the neighborhood for dinner and we absolutely LOVED it!!

Host was super nice and attentive and everything we ordered absolutely hit the spot from the tapas to the entrees. We'll absolutely be back to try more from the menu. We're equally excited about coming for Brunch, feels like it has all the makings to be the next hot Brunch spot!

Good food! Good service! Amazing Coffee
We ordered Crepe and fried chicken! So tasty!
The environment and the food are amazing, we did the shooting for them and tried the culinary arts from them, their food is literally amazing.
This place is amazing!! The food, the service, the happy hour menu. We've gone for dinner and brunch and it doesn't disappoint!!
Delicious chicken and waffles and Thai iced tea. Will definitely be back to try more.
Great food! I'd get the chicken n waffles next time instead of loco moco. The space is small so seats are kind of close! Other than that , I would go back
Tofu steak is a must try. It's come on top of cucumber salad and peanut sauce on it. Also I ordered a lychee drink. It's come very cute and very refreshing.
Over hyped. Poor customer service. I called the waitress because I needed to order additional items and she completely ignored me. The food is very bland

The food was delicious and the customer services was great! Cute atmosphere with a upbeat vibe. I can't remember if music was playing or not. But the chatter from all the customers talking while dining gave a family table talk experience.

I went here for the first time last night with a few friends and was blown away by how good everything was! The food was also aesthetically pleasing. We tried few different appetizers and entrees and I'm just so impressed with the food quality as well as the friendly service. Will definitely be going back to try their brunch as well.

Great service, SO clean and delicious food! We were there for dinner and we started with the roasted Brussels and the pumpkin strips, which were both very tasty. Then I had the Yellowstone, and I highly recommend it!
Awesome fried chicken and waffles! Love the touch of rosemary too. Been here lots of times and the food is consistently great.
Long overdue re-up on my initial, soft-opening first impressions: Four Chairs is still every bit as good, with tasty food and consistently attentive, friendly service. Such nice people.

I have been to a few soft-openings and always anticipate highlights and a few glitches and disappointments. If my experience at Four Chairs is any predictor, however, look out for this crew because they know what they're doing. The restaurant is stylish, clean and comfortable and the food was spot-on. We tried their Crispy Chicken Burger, Four Chairs omelette and Naked Wings (chicken wings with basil) and were happy with all three. Service was not only prompt, but SUPER friendly and attentive--reason enough to come back. We look forward to trying more items on the extensive breakfast and dinner menus to confirm our initial impression, but what we have seen so far suggests a lot of heart and soul going on here. In a foodie town, during a pandemic, in a tough industry, Four Chairs deserves a round of applause for stepping up with a new offering for Bernal and San Francisco. Best of luck!

Literally just so good, from the atmosphere to the food / food presentation
:
:
Nova benny

I normally like to cook my own food. So when I eat out, it has to taste like it came from "the kitchen". This surely hit the spot! I came back again, the next morning... Both times I ate alone, because my husband was working, but I felt safe here. Atmosphere and food is top quality. I'm grateful.
I'll definitely be coming back! Intriguing menu, excellent attention to detail, refined flavours, and very reasonable prices.

Loved every dish we ordered and the ambiance was perfect. Chicken wings were outstanding (crispy, sweet, and not too spicy) and I had the chicken wonderland which was excellent - my husband had the lamb which was saucy and delicious. Definitely will be back!
Their waffles were some of the best waffles I've ever had. The taste, texture, crispiness, and syrup, all were amazing.

We have eaten here for breakfast and for dinner recently. The food is delicious. The menu is filled with vegetarian options but we chose the salmon and the rib-eye to go along with incredible fresh French fries for the kids. The Tom Yum soup was also very good. Don't hesitate to come here. It's very good.
Wanted to like this place as the interior is comfortable. However, food quality was lacking in taste for the price. Service was also slow.

Pancakes were dense as if you were eating a large slice of cheap cake from safeway, and you can taste baking soda on taste buds as well. Scramble was undercooked with the sausage and over cooked the eggs. Definitely not worth the price and would not go back.

This place is lovely on a street that, well, you have to hold your breath while walking there. The chicken and waffle are amazing. The cistrus waffle is so so. The drinks are beautiful to look at but expensive :) the servers are nice and we are just very glad to have this respid in a but of a crazy neighborhood.
The food here does not disappoint. They have the best eggs Benedict. Every time my boyfriend and I come to the city, we always make sure to come here for brunch.
I rarely post but wanted to highlight this new addition to the neighborhood! We had the four chairs Benny and chicken and waffles. So delicious. The volcano coffee alone is worth the visit.
We ordered a few signature entrees and tapas. Everything is phenomenal and beautifully presented! Definitely coming back to try more dishes.

If you love Kitchen Story or Sweet Maple, this place will not disappoint! The service, food, and drinks were 5 stars! I had the Four Chairs Omelete and the portions were large enough for a hungry or hangry person! I couldn't even finish it. The drinks includes Butterfly Lychee and Arnold Palmer. Super cute preparation made for an IG post dream! Highly recommend and so excited we have this nearby!
Best omelette and breakfast potatoes ever. Nice ambience, pretty dining area. Friendly staff.

Great food , fast service. The first time ever in a restaurant- they couldn't do a special order as it was too busy. All I wanted was my egg poached hard on my Benedict. As with most hip and trendy places the acoustics made it too noisy for an enjoyable meal. .
Food was good. But the customer service wasn't great! Very nice associates but not super attentive. Cute ambiance and vibe to the restaurant.
I so enjoyed the portobello mushroom burger with a salad instead of fries. My kind of food! The service was good. I'm definitely going back to try more.

My friend and I had decided to try this place for the first time, since we are always looking for good establishments that we can frequent, add to our go-to list whenever we meet up over the weekend, and to recommend to others as well. Unfortunately, our initial experience did not even allow us to get a table.

In order to get a table, there is a kiosk where you input your name and phone number to be added to the waiting list. My friend had inputted his information and confirmed his spot on the list. There is a "host", and I mean that in quotations, since based on my observation, is the assigned person who will check in the next party and also wait on tables, alternating between roles.

We ended up waiting for a little more than 30 minutes. When we noticed that people who had arrived before us were being seated, we decided to wait for the short woman with glasses to ask about our table. She proceeded to show us the list on her device and my friend's name was no longer there. She kept scrolling up and down and repeated herself stating that the name was not there, to which we had to let her know that we understood that my friend's name was no longer there. My friend confirmed his name clearly displayed on the list, asked if she recalled calling his name and perhaps made the error of allowing other people in by error, if the name was mistakenly selected to be cleared, or if there was another group under the same name. Again, she repeated herself saying that the name was not on the list. She proceeded to tell us how to input our information in the system (we're tech savvy so I found that odd), and then confirmed she remembered seeing us. Perhaps multitasking is not her strong suit, or perhaps, they really just need an actual host.

Given our wait time and the poorly handled conversation, we simply decided to leave and never come back.

We were not on their list, and so, they will not be on ours either.
All the food was amazing, the service was quick and the place was really clean. Love how the seats are so close and we get to interact with other people

One of my favorite spots in the neighborhood! Great service and quality food every time we come. This time we ordered the chicken and waffles with the egg scramble, super delicious. The portion sizes are also quite large and you can tell they put a lot of thought into how they present their dishes. Would definitely recommend stopping by.

This place was over hyped. The wait was supperrrr long when online it said it was only gonna be 6 min and we put our name on the waitlist before we got there. Chipotle Benedict was not very good but the potato's and salad was good. My butterfly lychee drink was pretty good. Chicken and waffles was good. Service was good but nothing special
Great food and fast service. Came to town for niners game and this place was a win that we found in searching for a good breakfast/brunch spot. Would highly recommend

Four Chairs is such a wonderful addition to the neighborhood. A subpar ramen restaurant used to occupy this space. Went for dinner and had a pleasant evening. I was surprised by how empty it was at 6pm (only 3 tables were occupied). Our waitstaff was gracious and polite. Highly recommended: fried calamari, Four's Company, and Basil Basil Prawns. I'll be trying their brunch next!

Obsessed with this hidden gem in the neighborhood! Has such delicious food, is so reasonably priced, and has a lovely ambiance. My poke salad and Tom yum soup were fabulous, and my fiancé raved about his "Signature" rib eye. They also have a great special on draft beer. So glad we stumbled upon this place - we'll be back!
Outstanding service, modern environment inside the restaurant, food is above average and price is reasonable. You wont disappoint.
food and service were excellent. The inside ambience was cozy. Crew were always smiling.

I believe this spot is one of the best spots, in San Francisco.
